reviews.title: Luxury, Views & Relaxation at The Palms.
reviews.text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ A Perfect Las Vegas Stay! Luxury, Views & Relaxation at The PalmsWe had an absolutely wonderful stay at The Palms Hotel in Las Vegas. From the moment we arrived, we were impressed by the free parking and the wide range of high-quality dining options available right on the property. The buffet deserves a special mention, despite the huge variety of dishes, everything we tried was fresh, flavorful, and well-prepared. It’s rare to find such consistency in a buffet of this scale.Our room in the new tower was spacious, modern, and comfortable, with an unforgettable view of the Las Vegas Strip. We spent hours just sitting by the window, watching the city come alive, the lights, the movement, the energy… it’s something you simply can’t look away from.Each morning, I’d take the elevator downstairs to grab a great cup of coffee from one of the coffee shops in the hotel, and we’d enjoy it quietly in our room while taking in that spectacular view. Las Vegas is vibrant and full of life, but at The Palms, you can also find peace and relaxation when you need it.The service was friendly and professional, and the rooms were spotless. It truly felt like the perfect balance of excitement and comfort. We’ll definitely stay here again!

reviews.title: Pre-Trip Customer Service Review
reviews.text: I have yet to go to Vegas, but I am very excited to. I have been wanting to stay at the Palms forever. My trip will be in January 2026, so stay tuned for my review.HOWEVER, I wanted to drop a review because of their great customer service just by booking my stay. Lorraine was the representative who assisted me while learning more about the hotel and booking my stay. Her service skills are phenomenal and next-level.From the moment Lorraine answered, her energy was welcoming and professional. She didn't rush the conversation, taking the time to thoroughly explain the different room options, amenities, and current promotions relevant to my January stay. Her knowledge of the property was impressive; she clearly articulated the unique selling points of various suites, helping me narrow down my choice based on my preferences for views and space.Booking a trip can sometimes be stressful, but Lorraine made the process seamless and genuinely enjoyable. If the on-site experience at the Palms is even half as good as the service Lorraine provided during the booking phase, I do not doubt that my first trip to Vegas will be unforgettable.

reviews.title: Palms Resort Mommy and Daughter Time
reviews.text: 5 Stars ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Thank you so much for a relaxing stay the weekend of Babyface's concert. My daughter and I travel from Louisiana to see Babyface in concert, and Palms Resort has been great. Miss Syreeta took great care of us for Mother's Day weekend, and again, she didn't disappoint. Babyface was amazing as always. From the food, concert, comfortable bed, hot showers, I look forward to coming again and again. Thank you, Miss Syreeta Ellis, and your front desk team for taking care of me and my daughter. My daughter said she was going to do a review, and I told her I needed to do a review too, lol. My name is Bethley, and my daughter Gina Norton has brought me to see Babyface at Palms Resort three times, and we stayed the second and third time (May and November) at the Palms Resort.  I see that my daughter already did her review, and it looks like she misspelled her name 🤭😂 her name is Gina Norton, not Gins Norton. Thank you, Palms, for making my stay in Vegas so nice. I hope my daughter brings me again in 2026 for Mother's Day. The only thing I wish is that  Palms Casino Reward Center would  load the free play for out of town guests at the same time as your local customers. Some of us have to catch planes EARLY, and we should not have to wait until 2 pm for free play to show on the players' cards. That is not a good thing to do to your customers from another state. I hope that will be different when I come back next year to see Babyface. Other than that, I had a great weekend. God bless, see you again soon. Bj Kesire.

reviews.title: Our Second Stay at Palms Resort Las Vegas
reviews.text: I had planned to write this review during my stay, but I was having so much fun, I decided to wait until I got back to Louisiana. I absolutely have to tell you the manager, Syreeta Ellis, is TOP TIER. November 2025 is our 2nd stay at The Palms in Vegas. There was an issue with the bathroom in our room back in May 2025 (our first stay) . Syreeta was very professional and so kind, she quickly had us moved to another room, which we loved so much that we requested the same room this time in November, and Syreeta remembered us from our first stay. The room we requested was available, and Syreeta honored our request. We were in the same exact room!!! How beautiful is that!!! Syreeta was once again so kind and professional, we love her hospitality and look forward to seeing her every time we come to Vegas! Our stay was wonderful! Syreeta's kindness was a great start to 3 nights of fun, fun, fun! We dined at both the A.Y.C.E Buffet (Janice, our server for brunch was outstanding), and the Scotch 80 Prime Steakhouse ( Danny and the entire bar crew are outstanding as well, we told Danny we would see him next year). My mom and I enjoyed Babyface in concert Friday night, and I enjoyed Babyface again on Saturday night. What a treat! I need to mention that we brought Team Babyface some homemade pralines, and Syreeta followed Palms protocol so precisely, and Babyface sent his team members/security staff to your front desk and securely delivered our holiday pralines to Team Babyface. We got several thumbs up from the stage that they enjoyed the Louisiana treats. Next time, we plan to bring a batch for the Palms front desk staff because everyone is so polite, professional, and helpful. Syreeta Ellis, you have set the bar high in our minds, we will stay at The Palms every time we come to see Babyface in concert. What a time! Excellent hospitality, thank you so much, Palms Resort!! Until next time, wishing your entire staff Happy Thanksgiving, Merry Christmas, and a very Happy New Year! Gins Norton, Hummingbird Promotions LLC.

reviews.title: Disrespectfully  thieves
reviews.text: The lack of help and the disrespect I received after checkout was unbelievable. I was invited for a complimentary 2 night stay. While checking in I slid my license with a $100 bill under it to the young lady and asked if there were any upgrades available. There was and I also paid the $51.00 a night upgrade fee. I walked into a two bedroom suite that was over the top. The room was beautiful. I enjoyed the stay, enjoying the time spent. Winning and losing while gambling I lost about ,$2,000 but had fun. After I checked out I got my deposit back the next day. That night my card was charged another $72.00. I called to inquire about the charge and nobody had a solid answer for me. After getting the run around for days and multiple calls to the Palms and a few calls received and after speaking to the managers of multiple departments I finally had an answer. I was told that during my stay a charging stand for one of the tablets that operate the room was missing. EXCUSE ME??? Why would I take a charging block for a tablet I have no tablet for? This is a $50 charge and since it is through the butler service it also has a tip automatically added to it. So I was called a thief and I also tipped for this experience making the total 71 and some change. I disputed this charge to everybody I could and I was not heard in the least. I got nowhere. I feel so disrespected and powerless. I had a great time and spent money there over the 2 days I spent there. To be so disrespected after my checkout blows my mind. I’ve been going to the Palms for 25 years. My brother was the hotel manager for years and I will not be going back there. I will also be posting this review everywhere possible. How disrespectful !

reviews.title: Bodily fluids and filthy hotel
reviews.text: I’m so sad to be writing this, but the Palms is unclean and horrific. I stayed here back in March and brought MANY guests with me for me for my wedding. I had very special memories with this hotel. I booked with the Palms again for Halloween weekend and had the worst experience at any hotel. Our 1st room had AC that did not work, as well as bodily fluids stained all over the floor and furniture (see photo). We kindly asked for the AC to be checked, hours later it was not fixed, and we were moved rooms. The 2nd room seemed okay until we discovered sewage overflowing into our sink. Yes, that is other people’s vomit in our sink. We had to throw out toothbrushes and wash items near it as the whole room smelled disgusting. Very frustrated we asked for help and were placed in a new room. We had brought friends with us who also had blood stains, no AC, and also had to move rooms 3 times. It was incredibly embarrassing but most embarrassing of all was how the assistant manager Bita treated us. She did not apologize for any of the problems we encountered, told us we were not deserving of our room being comped and only offered to cover resort fees (pools are closed & half the restaurants are closed) and a single $50 food credit for our entire 4-day stay. There was no empathy, and most concerningly, there was no shock or even interest in looking into what is happening with these rooms. This whole thing is SO sad because our amazing memories are tainted by this. We ourselves work in customer service and couldn’t imagine treating customers this way. Especially returning and loyal customers. Please stay elsewhere if you do not want to be at risk of bodily fluids including blood, vomit, and private fluids.

reviews.title: Safety Concerns and Dishonest staff.
reviews.text: Stay at the Palms Casino Resort – 9/26 through 10/1Rooms: 16201 & 17202I booked two rooms months in advance for a company work trip. About a week before arrival, I received an email from the Palms advertising a 5-day promotional rate. Out of curiosity, I checked — and found the rooms were listed at roughly one-third the rate I had already paid.I immediately emailed reservations with screenshots, and they told me to call. When I called, the reservations agent said they could cancel and re-book at the lower rate, but it would be “better” to just wait and have the front desk handle it when I arrived later that week. This was on a Tuesday; I was set to arrive Friday.Check-In and Room IssuesWe arrived Friday around 1 pm (two adult couples). I went straight to the front desk and explained the situation to Manager Luz Corona. She asked me to email her the screenshots, which I did on the spot. She told me she’d call me back with an update. She never called. Two days later, I went back down to follow up and was told to text the screenshots to another number. (Palms, if management is reading this, it was a company phone — I can provide the number to confirm.) Again, I was told someone would call me back. Again, no call ever came.As for the rooms themselves:My room was ready around 2 pm.My parents’ suite (Fantasy Corner Salon) was not ready until 4:30 pm — even though we were told multiple times it would be ready by 3. At one point, an agent admitted that the delay was because “VIP guests” had blocked other rooms and my parents’ room was still being cleaned. My parents are in their 70s and have trouble standing/walking long periods. Watching VIPs who hadn’t even arrived be prioritized over paying guests physically waiting in front of the desk was insulting and disappointing.When my parents finally received their key:The suite was missing towels and washcloths. They had to call to request them.The bathroom doorknob literally fell off, making the bathroom unusable. It took a full day to repair.We were told the delay “would be compensated” with a $100 resort credit. This never appeared on the bill.Safety IncidentOn our third day, while we were napping, an employee walked directly into our room. No knock, no explanation — just walked in. I stopped him, and he quickly apologized and ran out. I immediately called the front desk, waited on hold for 20 minutes with no answer, and finally walked down myself. (There was no line when I got there.)After explaining the situation, I was told the employee “didn’t speak good English” and had mistakenly been told to clean carpets on another floor. That excuse didn’t line up — he wasn’t carrying carpet-cleaning equipment. I was told the resort fee for that day would be credited. Again, this never appeared on my bill. When I called after checkout, the incident wasn’t even documented — meaning no record of an employee entering a guest room unannounced and uninvited. That’s not just poor service — it’s a major safety and security concern.Billing ProblemsWhen I finally received my bill, there were three separate minibar charges for items we never touched. When I called to dispute them, I was told they couldn’t remove the charges until the minibar attendant confirmed the items hadn’t been used. So the Palms’ policy appears to be: charge first, verify later. Guests are effectively billed for whatever’s missing at the moment of checkout, and only refunded if someone verifies later.Overall ExperienceTo be fair:The rooms themselves were nicely designed and comfortable once issues were addressed.The views were great.Gambling at the Palms was excellent — among the best anywhere.But none of that outweighs the repeated dishonesty, lack of follow-through, and safety failures we experienced:Multiple broken promises (rate adjustment, resort credits, compensation).Delays and excuses that left senior guests waiting hours for their room.An unlogged, uncorrected incident of an employee walking into our room uninvited.Incorrect minibar charges treated as valid until we proved otherwise.The Palms clearly prioritizes VIPs over paying guests already standing at the counter. And while mistakes can happen, the repeated failure to follow up or honor commitments — paired with a total lack of accountability on a safety incident — makes it impossible for me to recommend this property.The amenities were not enough to outweigh the lies, dismissiveness, and security concerns. Unfortunately, I will not be staying at the Palms again.Imagine a female alone here and someone entering their room while they are sleeping.   Then there be ZERO documentation of the incident.

reviews.title: Sad to leave
reviews.text: I had a fantastic stay at the Palms last week when I flew in from Florida for a company convention. Check in was very quick and I was able to get to my room quickly after arriving late the in the evening. The room was very nice. I had an ivory king standard suite. The only negative thing was that my remote was not working that well, but I called to have it replaced and it was eventually, after sending someone to check it out. I did think it was a little strange that there was no shower door in the bathroom, but not a big deal. The bed and pillows were fantastic and super comfortable. The view was spectacular and checkout went smoothly. During my stay there, I had such an amazing time at the convention I attended. The Palms is literally the perfect venue for our event and is why our company has already chosen to have next year's convention there as well! The Pearl theater was very nice and Kaos nightclub was absolutely wonderful! The ballroom was perfect for our other convention events and meals. Everything was amazing at the Palms and I am so looking forward to coming back again next year!!

reviews.title: Pleasantly surprised at our stay
reviews.text: Hotel was not far from airport. We had a package deal due to the casino we frequent at home. Have come to Vegas often but never stayed here. Rooms were nice and comfortable . I just wish more hotels had a microwave and fridge. When you always have leftovers from restaurants it would have been nice to warm up food or keep beverages cold but I guess you wouldn’t buy food often or drinks . Hotel was clean and you always saw people cleaning . Casino-was easy to navigate . Large and every game you could think of . Always spots open I just didn’t see alit of people winning or getting excited because they won. The high limit room paid out quick for a jackpot. The one thing I didn’t like was the players desk. We had free play added to our cards and free buffets but if you didn’t swipe your cards at the kiosks you wouldn’t have known to activate. They just weren’t forth coming with info . A lady who was In line told us how it worked after the second day . Would have been helpful to haven someone explain how things worked and gave out free cards . Pool -people were always walking around for drinks and food . Drinks crazy expensive . 20.00 for a regular size cup. Food was very high as well . It was very hot and not a whole lot of umbrellas . Nice music and vibe though.you do need to watch what door you have to go in and what door you come out of. This needs to be labeled better. Buffets- very good food and service . We only went for breakfast and we had a buy one get one coupon. Crab legs and steak were hot and flavorful. Loved omelet station . Expensive if you didn’t have coupons . Long gone are the days of cheap buffets . 42.99 brunch, dinner 46.99. Lobster was 80, and prime rib and crab day was 52.99 a person .

reviews.title: Run! Don't waste you money!!
reviews.text: Congratulations! This hotel has truly redefined what “hospitality” means. I always thought Las Vegas was famous for its impeccable service, but you’ve proven me wrong in ways I couldn’t have imagined.Let’s start with the front desk experience. I arrived late at night, exhausted, expecting a warm welcome. Instead, Arianna greeted us with a glare and an attitude so unfriendly that I genuinely wondered if being an Asian guest made me unworthy of even basic courtesy. Watching her warmly interact with other (non-Asian) guests later only confirmed that suspicion. The fact that she “accidentally” assigned us two completely uncleaned rooms at 11 PM feels less like a mistake and more like a deliberate insult. When I came back to complain, Nicole, instead of helping, was too busy laughing and chatting with other staff to even acknowledge us. Is that your signature service style?We were then “upgraded” to a room with a broken shampoo holder and a delightful lingering stench, just to remind us of your attention to detail. A quick glance at Google Maps shows Arianna’s name proudly mentioned in multiple negative reviews—proof that this isn’t a one-off but a consistent pattern of poor service that management clearly ignores.As someone who has worked for Marriott, I’m truly shocked. I thought this brand stood for excellence, but this property seems to specialize in discrimination, neglect, and indifference. Based on our treatment, it’s clear that Asian guests are not valued here; we’re just a revenue source you don’t even pretend to respect. Maybe that’s why your team doesn’t bother replying to complaints or reviews—when you’ve decided some guests don’t matter, why engage with them at all?If your goal was to make guests feel invisible, disrespected, and unwelcome, congratulations again—you’ve achieved it. Unless someone enjoys paying premium prices to experience racial bias, broken facilities, and indifference, I’ll be sure to warn them to book anywhere else but here.

reviews.title: Did not feel safe was ripped off.
reviews.text: We booked a stay for 4 woman 2 of which were 21-year-old, daughter and 21-year-old friend. They had a room on the 15th floor and the other on the 12th floor. The first day there the 2 young girls returned to their room to find 4 men standing in it unannounced saying they were fixing the Wi-Fi. regardless of what they were there for they should have permission and not just enter a room were 2 young woman are staying.  We had them moved to the 12th floor after that we had the same issue with people trying to enter the rooms to fix Wi-Fi??   Had a room cleaner just open the door and walk in unannounced when I was standing in a towel looking for something she left behind. Other security issue involves the pool area. On the Sunday it was overcrowded with people who were not staying there but had a day pass. One of which was aggressive and vulgar, and we had to get security to remove him. We felt un-safe while staying there.The hotel charges 48 a day in addition to the nightly rate as a resort fee for the pool, Wi-Fi and parking. For that fee the Wi-Fi should work and you should be able to have a place to use the pool.   They charge you for coffee in the room.They charged us for mini bar and snacks THAT WE DID NOT CONSUME. Beware that each time you even touch or open the mini fridge you are charged. There are way too many choices in Vegas to choose Palms only to be left to feel un-safe and ripped off.

reviews.title: Quick Stay At The Palms for Beyonce Weekend!
reviews.text: I enjoyed my quick stay at the Palms! It's an older property but I did like that the rooms have been updated. We stayed in the Ivory Tower which overlooks the pool area. Major downside was that the DJ starts planning house music at 10am and you can hear the base very clearly in the rooms in this tower. The music goes non stop until 5pm. This might be fine for some but when you have late Vegas nights, being woken up at 10am with quick thumping is not fun lol. Otherwise, the dining options were plentiful and I loved that the food court area stayed open super late. The staff was very friendly and always helpful. Lastly, Ghost Bar was a GREAT vibe to start our nights off. The views were amazing and the service was great. Overall, I'd stay at the Palms again but in the other tower, when I didn't need to be right in the mix of the strip.

reviews.title: Disorganized and disappointing for a milestone celebration
reviews.text: I booked a group spa’rty for my 40th birthday — my first-ever spa experience — and left feeling disappointed, stressed, and honestly embarrassed for choosing this place.The issues started early: no response to my outreach for two days, and when I finally got someone, they booked six of us together but left the seventh person scheduled 90 minutes later. She felt uncomfortable and canceled — which should’ve been my first red flag.Despite multiple follow-ups with several different staff members (I spoke to eight in total), we never got the picnic info or food menu we were promised. On the day of, we arrived to confusion and zero communication about what the $20 spa’rty upgrade even included. Turns out it was just an eye mask — which one of my guests who didn’t even pay for the upgrade also got.The food situation was equally bad. We were told we couldn’t order anything unless we left the spa (in robes!) to pick it up ourselves. Eventually someone brought us a printed-off internet menu and a blank piece of paper to write on. We gave up.Two hours in, we still hadn’t been offered the champagne that was supposed to be part of the spa’rty. Someone finally remembered while we were in the sauna. It was laughable by that point.Also, the hot tub was out of service — something I was never told when booking, even though reviews now show it’s been down for months.The massages and facials were great — no complaints there — but everything else was disorganized, poorly communicated, and far from the elevated experience I was promised. For the price we paid, I expected a lot more.The staff did remove the spa’rty charge and gave a small discount, but that doesn’t make up for the lack of communication, missing amenities, and overall awkward vibe (including being stared down by a staff member when we left).If you’re just looking for a massage, you’ll probably be fine. But if you're booking a group or expecting a special experience? I’d look elsewhere.

The casino was wonderful and the waitstaff serviced us frequently.  There are several eating options from casual to fine dining and the restaurants we tried were great!  We never went to the pool, but it looked clean and inviting.   They also have a spa for massages and facials etc. If you’re looking for a budget friendly place  and can overlook the dated rooms, this is a great stay. I always know I’m in good hands when I book a stay at The Palms.

reviews.title: Drinks and fun
reviews.text: Had a great time at the Palms! We hung out at the shark bar in the middle most of the time. The DJ was awesome played some great music and was good at reading the room. Summer and Beto are awesome! They made us laugh all night long! The bar manager that night Casey was very nice! Everyone we ran into took good care of us! When we roulette Misha took great care of us sweet girl! You guys just have a great team!

reviews.title: Ruthless and Discriminatory Customer Service
reviews.text: June 17, 2025Palms Casino ResortGuest Relations Department4321 W Flamingo RdLas Vegas, NV 89103Subject: Miss Behavior Management Staff Regarding Disrespectful Customer Service and Misinformation at the Rewards CenterDear Palms Casino Resort Management,I am writing to formally express my extreme disappointment and distress regarding a recent interaction with your customer service team at the Rewards Center on Tuesday, June 17, 2025. The experience was profoundly disrespectful and unacceptable, particularly given the high standards of customer service expected in the Las Vegas hospitality industry.My issue began when I approached the Rewards Center to inquire about misinformation concerning promotional points I had earned. I was not provided with clear information regarding the promotion's terms and conditions beforehand, specifically that my earned points would not qualify under your rules. As a loyal customer, I believe it is incumbent upon Palms Casino Resort to provide complete and accurate promotional details upfront.What truly escalated this negative experience was the subsequent handling of my inquiry by your staff. The supervisor, Medalyn, addressed me with a ruthless and disrespectful demeanor. When I respectfully requested to speak with a manager, Roslyn, the situation unfortunately deteriorated further. Roslyn appeared to take my explanation of the situation as a personal attack. Instead of offering a clear resolution or engaging in a productive conversation, she threatened to call security and summarily dismissed me without providing any satisfactory answers.I was made to feel incredibly small and insignificant, as if I were a pauper begging for a trivial gift worth no more than $10. In my many years of experience within the hospitality sector, both as a customer and observing industry practices, I have never encountered such a profound lack of respect. I have always held a strong belief in treating all individuals with respect, which I consider a fundamental aspect of customer service. Roslyn's behavior made me feel akin to someone homeless, undeserving of basic courtesy despite being a patron of your establishment for several years. While I may not consistently spend millions on gaming, I frequently visit your property with family and friends to dine or watch movies.The way Roslyn held a grudge against me while I attempted to explain the situation was appalling. Her comment, implying that this was the "first time Medalyn did that," suggested that she believed I was fabricating the incident and merely seeking a "cheap gimmick." As a manager, her conduct and communication skills fell far short of the professional standards one would expect from a leading hospitality establishment.I have never felt compelled to file a complaint of this nature before. While I believe this specific incident may not be representative of the entire company, a repeated pattern of such dismissive and disrespectful behavior from both a supervisor and a manager is deeply concerning. If this is the prevailing work ethic and customer service standard at Palms Casino Resort, it severely undermines your standing in a city where exceptional customer service is a cornerstone of our economy.I am extremely upset and feel profoundly disrespected by the behavior of your employees. Their conduct is unacceptable at any level. I urge you to investigate this matter thoroughly and take appropriate action to address these serious deficiencies in customer service.

reviews.title: Rude woman ROSA at Serrano Vista Cafe
reviews.text: The Palms has been my go to casino and enjoyed the staffs services. I normally  give good tip. However, one time having ran out of cash due to playing, got some coffee and ROSA RUDELY and loudly said, "Today we received nothing but Thank you!!!."

reviews.title: Gaming Fun
reviews.text: Meily and the Server Team were Excellent/ I love Gaming at the Palms. It is a not so hidden Gem! I will be back soon more sun and $ Fun!

reviews.title: Went to Palms to gamble
reviews.text: Andi our cocktail waitress went out of her way for us she made sure we always had drinks and brought a new drink I never had before and it was awesome !! Thank you Andi Palms is fantastic had a great time.

reviews.title: Andi made our visit
reviews.text: Andi was our cocktail server! She was so friendly and made our visit great. She was so fun and attentive. She took great care of us

reviews.title: Amazing!!
reviews.text: Andi is absolutely AMAZING!! She made our experience so much fun and added to our family fun!! So glad we met her at the Palms!

reviews.title: Free parking
reviews.text: Second time staying at The Palms this year. First time during MLK weekend, we got 2 queens in a corner suite. The door was massive like a private entrance. It was a corner unit with large windows over looking The Palms towers. This time, Memorial weekend, we got a king bed in the Fantasy Tower.It’s clean, modern, bright beige color palette. The digital clock has a wireless charging pad. The mini fridge is not for personal use. You must request for a fridge if you want one. Otherwise, it has a timer and will charge you if you remove items or open for too long.Although slightly off strip, the advantage is free parking, cheaper gambling, and better blackjack odds. Next time, we will need to try AYCE buffet.

reviews.title: Ignorant Front Desk  Person
reviews.text: On June 4 we checked in at Palms Casino Resort as part of the celebration of my girlfriend's birthday. During the checked in we requested a room facing the view of Flamingo Road so that we can take a picture of Las Vegas strip during the day and at night.  The clerk that did the Check-in was a guy named KEN and attached was the view from our room. IT WAS NOT FLAMINGO ROAD AND NOT THE STRIP.When we went down to complain, the clerk named KEN  response was "we should have clarified what Tower we want."  This was ridiculous!  As customer, we don't have any knowledge which tower of the hotel are facing  a specific road or a view.  Hotel personnel are the ones that has this information.The  guy was very rude and ignorant.  He should not be working at the FRONT DESK.  He does not have a good representation of the hotel.  Fron

reviews.title: Bita the incompetent/lying front desk manager
reviews.text: We checked into the Palms in Vegas & they gave us the wrong room. Instead of admitting it or saying sorry and offering to switch the room for us, the manager tried to cover herself by saying that room doesn’t exist. We told her we’ve stayed in it before, she tried to convince us we hadn’t. We showed her pictures and confirmation numbers from last time, she still didn’t believe us. She kept telling us “there’s no need to switch rooms.” I said, “to which room? The room you’re saying doesn’t exist?” She said if we wanted to wait another day, maybe someone would check out and we could take their room. So I said, “the room you’re saying doesn’t exist?” I asked her to confirm the larger room exists, she said she couldn’t confirm that because she “hasn’t personally seen every room of the hotel.” I told her the room was available & showed her on my phone that it was still available online. She said the website must’ve made a mistake. She then admitted that sometimes the overbook. I asked what would happen if I bought the room right then online, and she said she would have to give me a refund because they were sold out. She tried to cover herself because she knew she was caught lying to our faces. We stayed at the Palms for about an hour and a half just to fight with Bita- the manager. She said the best she could offer was to check us out. Worst customer service ever. We checked out immediately & are never coming back to the Palms. This incompetent manager, Bita, says she’s worked there “for over a month,” as if she clearly knew what she was talking about… she couldn’t even print out our receipts, forgot to give us a pen to sign them, and had to ask the other front desk employee for help several times. These are the differences between the two rooms. one is considerably bigger, the other has a smaller couch, lower ceilings, and only one restroom. We will be suing the Palms for false advertising, specifically because of Bita- the incompetent manager who lied to our faces. She eventually admitted she found a confirmation number confirming we had stayed there before, but offered no apology, no discount, nothing. I only wish I could personally sue that lying incompetent waste of breath- Bita, for lying to our faces, gaslighting us by trying to make us believe we never stayed in the hotel before, and offering the best she could do- to check us out immediately. We’ll never stay there again specifically because of her. Do yourself a favor, take your business somewhere else where you won’t be lied to your face by Bita.

reviews.title: Favorite Resort in Vegas!
reviews.text: The staff are all so great, they are so friendly and helpful. They have a great selection of slot machines and table games and the restaurants are all delicious. If you go, be sure to visit The West bar and Tonic bar, they have the best bartenders!

reviews.title: Awesome cocktail waitress
reviews.text: Meily,You are truly an awesome cocktail waitressAlways all smiles and brightens my day when I see you You are always a ray of sunshineThank you for making me feel comfortable every time I’m here Keep doing you girlThank you for being so Amazing Xoxo Diane

reviews.title: Only Very Dry Complementary Wine Choices Served
reviews.text: The complimentary wine selection is AWFUL.  Very dry white and red wine. I was able to get a glass of White Zinfandel or Pinot Grigio in the past.  Not anymore.  But you can go to Gold Coast, The Orleans, Red Rock Casino, Palace Station Casino and ANY local casino and you will get complimentary White Zinfandel and/or Pinot Grigio while gambling.  There are Great bartenders at The Palms Tonic Bar - Elias, Enrique, Tracee, Kim, Omar, Danny, Angela, ect.  They said they tried and was not able to get a wine back behind the bar that was not so dry and nasty.

reviews.title: Fantastic stay at the Palms!
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience at the Palms Resort and Casino! From start to finish, the staff was friendly, welcoming, and made me feel right at home.A special shoutout to Ame T, one of the hotel receptionists, who was incredibly kind, professional, and accommodating. He made check-in smooth and stress-free, and went out of his way to make sure everything was perfect. It’s always a great sign when someone at the front desk sets such a positive tone for your stay.I stayed in the new tower, and the room was spotless, modern, and very comfortable. Everything felt fresh and well-maintained.Throughout my stay, every team member I interacted with—whether at the front desk, in the casino, or elsewhere—was consistently courteous and helpful. The Palms truly delivers excellent service across the board.Highly recommend this hotel for anyone looking for a relaxing, enjoyable, and memorable Vegas stay. I’ll definitely be back!

reviews.title: HORRIFIC
reviews.text: ABSOLUTELY HORRIBLE IN EVERY WAY!! We checked in and got to our room after riding on a squeaky questionable elevator. The “Fantasy Suite” smelled like old cigarettes The ice machine on our floor wasn’t working so we called the front desk and instead of helping they wanted to tell me how much a bucket of ice and delivery would be? There’s a coffee pot in the room with cups that had Starbucks pods in it and water. No sign, no censors but then they tell you the pods are 3 dollars and the water is 5 dollars? So so guess you get a suite with a coffee pot for looks. After spending money at The Palms we decided no more and went to Cesar’s and gave them our money. I went to VIP services to explain our disappointment and her response was I’mNot losing any money so I don’t care!!!! We didn’t even stay long enough to use all our dining voucher. That’s how bad it is!! I run  a business and we were dumbfounded and honestly couldn’t wait to leave The 1 star is for 2 workers that were kind. One of them AMAZING!! Otherwise I would  have given ZERO stars!!

reviews.title: Having an enjoyable time.
reviews.text: Amanda the cocktail waitress was with it a doubt the nicest person I've met while gambling in Vegas. I'm a local that has lived here for fifteen years. I've never written a review in my life. Even though I was losing money she made my time at the palms and experience I still enjoyed. She was very friendly, polite, and promptly brought me drinks.

reviews.title: Jerry at Palm Player Card Rewards center
reviews.text: I've been going to San Manuel/Yamava since 1997 California then moved to Las Vegas September 2020 Summerlin. Yamava bought Palms 🌴 casino 2022 and I appreciate how Yamava runs Palms 🌴 casino and this is my main go to casino in the entire Las Vegas strip and local casino's.Having been to many casino's in California and Las Vegas player cards rewards centers I have been pleasantly surprised with the professional service from Jerry at Palms Rewards CenterThis man needs to be Rewards Center Manager someday. He is great with people and very knowledgeable of their computers systems along with understanding of offerings, player points, promotions, etc given by Palms 🌴 casino.

reviews.title: Palms Eats
reviews.text: We had a wonderful meal and experience at Serrano Vista Cafe. We were greeted by Dan and seated. Vanessa came and took our orders and our meals came quickly! All I can say is melt in your mouth delicious! We had breakfast and everything was cooked perfectly! Because of Dan and Vanessa and the delicious food its a definite yes to a return here!

reviews.title: Uncomfortable accommodations
reviews.text: The hotel was clean and I guess newly updated. I enjoyed the fitness center and the pool area wasn’t busy during the week. However I guess they regulate their AC. They don’t get cooler than 72 and that is HOT if you are a middle aged female. I slept awful and will never stay there again.

reviews.title: Not pleased
reviews.text: The casino was beautiful. However the room wasn’t what I expected . It was cleaned properly . And needs new furniture the bathroom needs updated as well. And wasn’t the cleanest! The price didn’t not match the value. Also was located off the strip.

reviews.title: The palms needs assistance.
reviews.text: So first off... who doesnt wanna drink in vegas right? I get it.. mini bar rocks except itll cost an arm and a leg! And if u open the fridge it automatically charging ur room. Whether u drank anything or not.. WHAT?! Also, i live in a state where it rarely sees 75! And i come in 90 degrees and cant keep anything cold bc there is no access to a fridge! Totally sucks!  Specially traveling with kids and need to keep water/milk fresh and COLD! No customer should have to pay to use a fridge.. period! We checkd in which went smooth minus the 90 something resort fee AND a 200 hold fee... then we get to headin to our rooms with our bags..  security wont let u thru unless u show ur key card... ok, let me empty my hands to dig in my pockets for u....  they have 1 ply tp.. sad times.. and no trash bags in the rooms. Also sucks u cant even use the coffee machine to make a cup when u wake up.. its 10 bucks for 1 cup outta a kuerig! The parking lot and elevators were dirty and had glass everywhere. Another thing.... why are we a smoking ok environment??? I wouldve stayd elsewherr with my kids had I known the casino was ok for smoking. I will say the room itself is big and spacious. The bathroom is very nice as well. However, we will never stay here again.

reviews.title: Palms Casino Resort 4321 West Flamingo Road Las Vegas, Nevada
reviews.text: This is in regard to the NFL Raiders Draft Party on Thursday 4-24-25. I spent $3,400 on tickets for this event for me and my 3 friends. It was out at the pool, and it was so jammed pack you could barely move. The beverages were free, but we stood in line for over a half hour to get our first drink and they had a limited beverage menu. One of the rounds of drinks we got were from a cocktail server. We thought it was better than standing in line. When she came back, she told us she works for tips and waited for us to tip her while staring at us. She was plain rude. I had some choice words for her, but my friends said let it go. We then went to get some food and had to stand in long lines. They ran out of food very quickly and most of the time half the serving dishes were empty. They also ran out of plates, so we had to wait again. Of course there was nowhere to sit. Halfway through the first round of the draft they shut off the audio and blared music way to loud. Some of us were there to enjoy the draft announcements. For the money I spent really this is the kind of service you get. Whoever was in charge of this event failed on all levels. NEVER AGAIN.

reviews.title: Stay where you feel at home and welcomed .
reviews.text: I have been staying at Palms Casino resort for over 20 years. There are many options in Vegas to stay at. For me , it’s about the staff and the service . I recently stayed at Palms and had a great visit . The staff in the vip services department really set the tone for my stay. In particular Desie and Valerie. They were very welcoming and helped me get settled in. I will be staying at Palms this summer without hesitation and highly recommend this property !

reviews.title: Liberty rocks give her raise
reviews.text: Liberty helped me tremendously she rocks I  gamble here and frequent numerous restaurants at Palms she is awesome: wish more locals are like her please promote to ceo asap or I will  spend my money at Harrahs much closer to my home happy Easter God Bless

reviews.title: Uh-Maz-Ing!
reviews.text: Everything was amazing! From Valet, to check in, our stay and to check out was smooth and wonderful. Desie in the VIP Lounge went above and beyond with the "Red Carpet" treatment and hospitality. Started our day with refreshing cocktails at the Laguna Pool at Palms Place, had a late lunch at the delicious Tim Ho Wan restaurant and then danced the night away with a beautiful view of the Strip at The Ghostbar. Everyone was courteous with great customer service. Highly recommended to stay here and definitely returning. Summertime at the pool will be fun, yet relaxing. A great getaway to escape for a while. Thank you, Palms Casino Resort!

reviews.title: Nice hotel, nice casino, good times!
reviews.text: Lovely rooms, good size, comfortable bed, clean and tidy, good bathrooms, nice mountain views.Complimentary valet parking was great.A little outside noise can be heard at night. Nice casino down stairs.Lovely roof top bar, good views and they gave me a ticket for a free glass of bubbly.However, because my husbands shorts didn’t have belt loops he had to change…. He wore lovely smart black shorts, but had to change to ripped skinny jeans that had belt loops….. silly (only for the rooftop bar).Busy pool with a nice bar and good vibes. Unsure why they only had 1 pool open, this meant many people had no where to sit so couldn’t stay at the pool. Good food options available.We really enjoyed our time here.

reviews.title: Palms  casino becoming less local friendly
reviews.text: The Palms when it opened was the best place for locals to gamble . New managers and marketing  are dropping the ball with the offers/ customer service . The highest player card was sent 5$ offers which is down right insulting not a good incentive to keep customers coming back. Lots of changes and cut backs are noted plus I see lots of people resigning . That personalized experience being greeted with a hug or handshake is gone . VIP players got to know the general manager as well as managers from all departments now everyone is MIA .

reviews.title: Sing Noodles
reviews.text: Went on our weekly Palms jaunt and had dinner at Send Noodles. The restaurant was full with the exception of the 3 tables which hadn’t been cleaned yet. The take out line was long so Jessica the Hostess was assisting them and let us know waiting in line for a table she would get the tables cleared soon. The take out orders were all picked up but the tables still hadn’t been cleared by the wait staff so Jessica asked us to to give her a moment and went and got a tray then began cleaning a table for us. We thanked and tipped her and said we know it isn’t her job to do that but we appreciated her helping the team.  After she sat us, she went and cleared a table for the next set of guests waiting in line. I asked another employee if there were comment cards but he said to leave a review on here. I hope management sees this and recognizes Jessica for her positive attitude and willingness to help.

reviews.title: No class for a high limit room stay away! All they do is stand around and not work and talk and ruin guests experience.
reviews.text: No class for a high limit room stay away! All they do is stand around and not work and talk and ruin guests experience.

reviews.title: Great birthday celebration
reviews.text: Celebrated Jaime’s 50th Birthday for 2 days with friends & family.  Thoroughly enjoyed the rooms, cabana/pool, hanging out at the casino, Mabel’s, and kudos to Kevin who helped with all accommodations. The entire staff were friendly & professional. This 50th birthday party was such a success, thanks to the Palms. Can’t wait to go back!

reviews.title: Best time
reviews.text: My Las Vegas favorite luxury hotel. Not being on the strip, still vey close, is a blessing. The view from the room is beautiful and breathtaking: the Red Rock mountains and a snowy landscape.The room is great very spacious and I really appreciate the modern design.A special thanks to Desire at the VIP reception. She is always gracious and helpful, making you feel appreciated and welcomed.

reviews.title: Personal touch in Las Vegas
reviews.text: The room was spacious , super clean, wide TV screen and specially a great shower. Desire at the VIP reception is the most of the host. She makes you feel welcome at the second you step in the room and will go above and beyond to accommodate your needs. Definitely will be back for another great experience

reviews.title: Another Satisfied Customer
reviews.text: The hospitality at the Palms Casino Resort is second to none. Checking in was a breeze with the friendly staff. We had a blast at the poolside cabana during the day. The servers took care of us - took care of our drinks and appetizers, and the were nice enough to help us get the March madness games we wanted to watch on our TV in the cabana. Dinner was great, we enjoyed some good BBQ at Maybels, even got a tour of their smokehouse. Our rooms were perfect, my brother was celebrating his 50th and the penthouse at the Palms made us feel like royalty. What a fun weekend, thanks to all of the support staff from top to bottom that took the time to make our stay a special one!!

reviews.title: Perfect Surprise 50th Celebration!
reviews.text: We spent the weekend here to celebrate our friend's surprise 50th birthday, and every aspect of our experience, from check-in to our pool cabana and the various festivities, was exceptional. Kevin, the manager, ensured that all our needs were met, and the service at the cabanas was outstanding. The food and drinks were abundant, and our dinner reservations at the barbecue restaurant were equally delightful. I highly recommend this venue to anyone visiting Las Vegas or looking to celebrate any special occasion.

reviews.title: Kimi deserves a raise!
reviews.text: Kimi at the front desk provided some of the best customer service I’ve ever seen. Vegas has gotten really greedy and corporate but the palms and specially my experience with kimi was flawless. I had a tiny issue with my room (not the palms fault) and kimi fixed it and provided a solution immediately. Incredibly refreshing experience.

reviews.title: First-time Experience
reviews.text: As a first-time card member, I'm extremely satisfied with the outstanding service of Ms Shirly Manuel at the Rewards Club - she's the 'manuel' labor that makes customer service shine brighter than the Palms Hotel's bright lights. She went beyond her customer service by giving me and my sister the options about the hotel promotions, and was diligent and very detailed, explaining the offers with the precision of a hotel 'check-in' genius. Thank you Palms Hotel for making our stay a delightful experience that was the 'pick' of our vacation. We will definitely be back for a 'suite' deal.

reviews.title: Good stay
reviews.text: The room was comfortable with a good view. Sarah Alcantara cleaned our room during our stay. Very clean and very put together. I’m only giving it 4 stars because the A/C did not cool the room enough so we woke up sweaty both nights we slept there. Bathroom was beautiful and it was very comfortable.

reviews.title: Cafe staff is awesome
reviews.text: Every morning I come down and have breakfast at the cafe. Mike/Michelle runs the counter area/bar. He is really the center piece of the restaurant. He really does an awesome job, super polite and helpful. Stop by and say hello to Mike/Michelle

reviews.title: Outstanding stay.
reviews.text: My husband and I celebrated our 46 wedding anniversary.Our room was beautiful and our housekeeper Violetta Osario was outstanding!She was very friendly and very detailed oriented. We enjoyed all of the restaurants here at the Palms, great service, and outstanding foodWe enjoyed our stay at the Palms.

reviews.title: Excellent staff
reviews.text: Outstanding staff.  You gave certain expectations of a Las Vegas institution, and the Palms did not disappoint.  The bartenders and security staff were friendly and helpful.  None of us ever felt like a burden to them.  Would happily return to this hotel again.

reviews.title: Highly Disappointed
reviews.text: The service, cleanliness, and maintenance were seriously lacking.  The resort felt like a motel 6 resort compared to the other resorts on the strip.  My room had cobwebs, nonworking hair dryer, road noise from outside, smelled of weed throughout the hall, and my door wouldn't deadbolt.  The staff checking in was less than friendly and even making the reservation to stay there was difficult.  The bell people were kind.  Skip the buffet and take a taxi to the Bellagio's buffet.  For $6 more you get amazing selection and great food.  The Palms buffet lacked heat (temperature) and options.  Couldn't even get the correct soft drinks or get them refilled.  I hope I never have to stay there again.

reviews.title: Palms Casino Resort/Las Vegas
reviews.text: My experience with VIP for the 1st time went smoothly.  Desi checked me in and out. My room was very spacious. My bed was very hygienic! I was able to loge at the tower of choice. Noise level ws none! My shower was excellent. I also had brunch and breakfast at the Laguna Pool House & Kitchen. The food was excellent. The staff was A-1. The view of the pool and amenities was excellent. They also have excellent wine choices too! I also dined at Scotch 80 Prime. Go there with a big appetite. The food was excellent. Small bites were served, but looks are deceiving. You won't have room for dessert!

reviews.title: 6 Fabulous days @ The Palms Resort @ Casino
reviews.text: We had an amazing experience staying at the Palms Resort & Casino.  The resort, casino, staff, cleanliness and luxury features of the room - were all incredible.A special shout out to Ice from the front desk who was exceptional and went above and beyond in making us feel very welcome.

reviews.title: Amazing Stay!
reviews.text: I am so impressed with the cleanliness and attentive staff at the hotel. We stayed in a suite in the fantasy tower that was spacious and well appointed. They have top quality restaurants and the best gaming experience I’ve had in years. The Palms is the best value in Vegas!

reviews.title: Fun and relaxing
reviews.text: I am a local, but did a stay vacation Our room was very spacious.  (IVORY Tower) The cooling system might be a little old school, but it worked! My biggest thing was how attentive the bellman, valet and housekeeping were. My only thing was wishing they had mini fridge and microwave in room. Everywhere we stay normally does. Even the older hotels in Laughlin.

reviews.title: Great service and hotel
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel room’s spacious and clean customer top notch restaurants very good great place for off the strip but still close to strip highley recommend the quost bar rooftop best view of all Las Vegas would return again the cafe is great for breakfast and the steak restaurant is to die for we wish we was available for the wed  or thurs lobster steal all you can eat buffet but didn’t make reservations in time and we had a show it was only $65pp I heard next time I will definitely do that one I like lobster and the hubby loves steak

reviews.title: Great Service!
reviews.text: Reservation and bell desk were exceptional! Pleasant, helpful, competent, responsive! Special kudos to Rean and Maria Galang - what professionalism!! Team was patient and polite. Additionally I appreciate the fact that he asked Maria for assistance when he was posed with a challenge! I would be more hopeful for the hospitality industry if all of the representatives behaved like Rean!!!

reviews.title: Great experience and value
reviews.text: Overall good experience for someone who has never stayed at the Palms. We stayed from a Monday to Thursday so the experience may be different during a weekend but overall it was a great experience. It's off the strip but close enough to drive to anything on the strip. I would recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a good spot with access to good food, entertainment, spa, and value.

reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience at the Palms Hotel. We enjoyed the steakhouse Scotch 80 Prime, the buffet & the Serrano Vista Cade. We had a fabulous room &the staff were all great, especially Paige working the check in desk. Look forward to visiting again.

reviews.title: Palms PERFECTION. !!!!
reviews.text: Superior service by geraldo or was it gerardo , you’ll see in pic . always a bright smile and knowledgeable about the casino . He remembered me from “Sammy’s ISLAND “ opening . (sore going to miss that EXCEPTIONAL POOL ART DECCO AND FOOD MENU . only ther kitchen was too limited on hours but all else was SENSATIONAL !!!) at Stuff i forgot , Holly and her co workers made sure i did NOT forget . went away with very comfortable and matching attire and answered my questions w prompt service . look 4ward2 coming back !!!!

reviews.title: Big money players go somewhere else
reviews.text: As a Vegas local, Palms started out with generous free play, prizes and slots.  However, as of February 1, 2025. If you are big money players, I'd recommend somewhere else. Sure the little 88 cents hit small amounts, but not big 880 players. They have become so tight, you could stick a piece of coal up the CFO and it'll come out a diamond.  Rooms are nice in Fantasy tower.  Older tower, not so much. Recommend, based on my experiences the last 3 months,  if you are on the strip, no need to come to palms for slots.

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: In all honesty, I was on the fence about staying here but I had a wonderful stay. The room was beautiful and the staff was lovely. The hot water in the shower could've been hotter but that's my only complaint. Everything you need is under one roof, so you don't miss out on being on the Strip. At any rate, you're only a few minutes from the Strip. I would definitely stay at the Palms again.

reviews.title: Bad Experience
reviews.text: Came to Palms Casino on a comp from my neighborhood casino. (Bally’s - they’re messy too) I’m disabled and was offered a king bed room by the elevator during booking. I received a 2 full beds room the farthest from the elevator for myself and my husband. (Only key to be found for a room) The mattress was slanted and lumpy so, I kept sliding towards the floor all night and waking up stiff and in pain. Comp came with $50 per night food credit, which no one seemed to know anything about. Like I was only person using this comp. (Buffet food was TERRIBLE and EXPENSIVE anyway!) False charges for the mini bar (sensored for theft), lost thousands in 2 1/2 days because the slots were awful. (came Sunday after 8 and left Wednesday morning) and the room cleaner threw away my shower cap!!! Probably the worst mini vaca I’ve ever had. And on my last morning there, I met Paige (Front desk rep) and I finally felt like an invited guest. Paige fixed EVERYTHING!!! She fixed it without breaking a sweat, without getting angry over my meltdown, and with knowledge and class. Paige should get a promotion because she “Stands on Business”  5 stars for her ONLY. Because of Paige, I actually had a peaceful breakfast on my last morning there. Thank you everything Paige 💜

reviews.title: Top notch concierge at VIP Registration
reviews.text: I have stayed at Palms Resort and Casino several times since the reopening in 2022. At the beginning of each stay the first person I meet is either Charlie or Alexis. I love how welcoming both of them are by recognizing me each visit. They handle the logistics of handling the check-in process flawlessly and make sure my needs are met each time. The professionalism just sets the tone for an enjoyable visit each time. A++ I highly recommend staying at Palms to people I know. There are many others that serve their patrons beyond normal expectations.

reviews.title: The Palms is amazing!!!
reviews.text: I never write reviews but just wanted to say how much I love the palms and just a few reasons why They have all the latest slot games They always have great concerts with current artists they have the best players club value (free gifts weekly free food weekly and easy to win free buffets for two way more free play than most hotels and great comps on rooms too) I feel like I have more fun at the Palm's bars than most others I've been to in Vegas That's all thanks to their amazing bartenders I loved talking to all of them Tracy at the sports bar was my favorite with her friendly attitude and adorable smile I wish I remembered everyone's name because they were all so super cool!!! Even the security guards would stop by the bar and chat a little from time to time Everyone there just seems to have a super good inviting attitude I highly recommend the Palms and look forward to my next visit hopefully soon!!!!

reviews.title: Where have you been Palms?! Wow!
reviews.text: I’ve been coming to LV for 20 yrs and although I’ve gambled at Palms, I’ve never stayed in one of their suites — and it is absolutely perfect. Check in was so easy, friendly and efficient. Was able to check into my room an hour early to wash up and take advantage of all the amenities and casino - the art and personal touches are outstanding, huge Cali king bed with tons of pillow options, large marble bathroom with soaking tub… This suite has it all and I’m just bummed and didn’t make this my home resort years ago. Beautiful spa, tons of restaurants and almost walking distance to Las Vegas Chinatown. It’s a perfect spot! And the band is setting up! Special thanks to Kimi for the welcoming smile and above and beyond attitude. Really appreciate you!

reviews.title: JERRY!! A true asset!!! At the rewards desk he came through like a total champ when I needed some assistance!!
reviews.text: JERRY!! A true asset!!! At the rewards desk he came through like a total champ when I needed some assistance!!

reviews.title: Velma Husic is a jewel 💎
reviews.text: Palms is always clean and inviting environment. There’s a lady who is always warm and friendly when providing service, Velma Husic. She’s always smiling and very pleasant. Others don’t compare to her… she’s a jewel. 💎 I’ve been coming for years and each time recognize her. I hope she gets to train others!

reviews.title: The best staycation!
reviews.text: We had the best experience at the Palms. We started out the day with playing the slots and winning, then went to the lobster buffet and used our reward points for most of it, and then spent a luxurious night in the room. Great views of the strip and very comfortable beds. Great service all around!

reviews.title: Fantastic property!
reviews.text: The Palms is our favorite hotel in Las Vegas. It is off the strip but has beautiful views of the more iconic hotels on the strip without having to deal with the traffic. And Free parking! As a resort it is not equal to the premium properties like the Fontainebleau: but the Palms is every bit as elegant and professionally run as many of the famous hotels owned by MGM and Caesar's.

reviews.title: Top Casino Ever!!!!
reviews.text: Once you're at Palms Casino, then you'll be stucked there the whole duration of your stay as they're just Awesome. Service is top 1 especially Des and Anna at VIP lounge. For gaming benefits, you sure get a lot of those free food and free play that goes on weekly. Keeps me coming back.

reviews.title: Awesome time!
reviews.text: Earned points to get a complimentary 2 nights. Stayed from a Sunday - Tuesday..had an amazing time! Compared to where we stayed before at Gold Coast, (their rooms you could hear everything in the halls and next door, very upsetting) this was a major upgrade. Thought we were being treated to a suite. Turns out these are the regular rooms. Love them!!! Did not hear a thing around us. We got a good nights sleep. Even if we didn't get comped, these rooms are easily affordable. Yes I checked! We met so many great people, a lot of whom worked there. My buddy on the casino floor was Ranko, who always stopped to say Hi! and was always welcomed because he was my good luck charm while playing the slots. We finally ate at A.Y.C.E Buffet and it was worth every penny. Our server Salvador and staff were on their toes and constantly on the go, clearing tables, serving tables and checking in on you to see if you needed anything. We had the great opportunity to meet Sou Chef Carlos Vejar. Super sweet and generous person who gave us tips on what to taste in the buffet. We met the Housekeeping Supervisor Paco who made sure our room was up to par. If we stayed at Gold Coast we would hit all the nearby casinos. This time we stayed the whole time at the Palms. SO much for us to do. We went to the movies, we earned points to get a Emeril Lagasse cookware giveaway, we had good luck on the slots on Sunday where they multiplied our points by 5X, we had breakfast at Serrano Vista Cafe and ate lunch at the Palms Pizza place. I wish we could go back for the holidays. They were in the middle of decorating the casino and hotel for Christmas. We asked to speak to a manager before we left. Manny came out to chat with us thinking something was wrong. We actually just wanted to let him know we loved the Palms and we were so comfortable there. Everyone made us feel so welcomed and to thank his hotel for a relaxing experience. Hope everyone has a great experience just like us.

reviews.title: Very pleasant
reviews.text: Jacob G was amazing. He was so helpful ensuring my 30 relatives were all on the same floor and had an easy check-in after a long road trip. I had called several times and no one could assist me but Jacob made the experience better. He was patient, kind and considerate while training Victor C and Andrea T who were also very friendly.

reviews.title: Lovely hotel but sewage issue
reviews.text: I love the Palms casino. It's a beautiful space and has excellent staff. We stayed in a King room in the Fantasy Tower. Again, beautiful hallways and room was sparkling clean. Then, around 3 pm the next day we heard a gurgling sound from the bathroom, then another, then something like an explosion of water from the bathroom. Then the smell of sewage hit us. We walked into the bathroom and saw all kinds of purple particulate in the sink, like an ink pen had exploded. The smell was god awful and unmistakably sewage. My toiletries were on the counter and I was certain they had been in the range of the sewage geyser. We called front desk and they said they would send an engineer up. We had to leave the room immediately the smell was so bad. We also explained to housekeeping what had happened. We returned that evening and the bathroom was sparkling clean, like nothing happened. So housekeeping saved the day! But there was no further response from management. No offer of any comps or discounts. That is the reason why I will sadly not stay here again. When something like that happens, amends need to be made financially. Period.

reviews.title: Recently renovated facility, casino and pool very nice.
reviews.text: The room was very large on the 11th with a beautiful view. We spent a half day in the pool which has all the facilities (towels, bar, various food, music with DJ set) but you can not bring anything from outside even water.The casino is very nice and not shabby at all (as we found others from Las Vegas) with minimum wagering acceptable to all types of players (even $15).We liked the attention of the staff in always requesting the card key for the rooms before accessing the elevators and the room top of ghostbar where we went on Friday night

reviews.title: Good, but Michelle the waitress above all.
reviews.text: I had a wonderful morning breakfast at their Serano Vista Cafe, food was good but Michelle our waitress was above & beyond other employee there we intertwined with during our stay. Hardworking with a smile as an individual overall it made our stay at the Palms much better even after finding out about a few "mini bar" extras we didn’t use and this added $42 "resort fees/ plus tax total of $47 above the hotel room per day added cost, much easier to swallow.

reviews.title: Meily Rocks!
reviews.text: Meily(cocktail waitress)was really welcoming and outstanding.  Great customer service from her. Nice and friendly and took great care of us. It's  people like her that makes me want to keep coming back. Thank you Meily! Keep up the good work.

reviews.title: Best server in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Totally enjoy going to the Palms to play the slot machines with my roommate!!! Amanda Gutierrez is a phenomenal server!!! She remembered me even after being gone for two months!  Best server and service ever!!! I give Amanda a million star review!!!

reviews.title: Dirty rooms and rude, passive-aggressive bellhop
reviews.text: We went for the American Film Market and stayed a full week at the hotel. Our experience was mixed and I kind of hope they change hotels next year. We wouldn’t stay there again either way. The rooms were spacious, but not very clean. There was food or blood on the corner of our bed when we arrived and there was actual poop on the outside of our toilet—again, on arrival! 😱 One day, we came back to our room and found housekeeping had left the minibar open and left our trash bags outside the room. I had to call the desk as the minibar has some kind of sensor and I was worried they’d try charging us.Serrano Vista Cafe has great oat milk cappuccinos and avocado toast, but expect to pay Vegas prices, of course. Staff were friendly and helpful there though! Meanwhile, some hotel staff were super helpful and friendly too, while others were average,  but then there was one bellhop who was shockingly rude and passive-aggressive, even going so far as to lie to us tonight about where our Uber driver would pick us up, trying to get us to carry our luggage across the hotel without a trolley. Thank god, I called the driver first. Living in Europe, we weren’t aware of certain tipping customs and didn’t even have many USD on us when we landed anyway. We had to look up the norms after we arrived. While we gave the bellhop what would’ve been a normal tip in Italy or the UK when we arrived, it was apparently less than recommended in Las Vegas. Upon leaving tonight, he commented about “remembering us,” while being extremely rude. The irony is that I tipped his colleagues this morning for the luggage storage (the morning bellhop was super lovely all week!) and I planned to leave the rest of my USD to him tonight ($20) when collecting the luggage. His appalling behavior meant I left him nothing and had a very happy Uber driver instead. If PCR reads this, whoever the head of your bell desk was at 5pm on 11/11/24, he needs a different line of work. Your morning guy though is ace—super smiley and kind!

reviews.title: Serrano Vista Cafe
reviews.text: Serrano Vista Cafe is the place to go for Breakfast at The Palm! Mary Ann is just fantastic and runs the floor with energy and a smile!  You get a very good variety of food. From anyway you like em eggs to pancakes, French toast and waffles. Health conscious? No problem! Oatmeal, fruit parfait and avocado toast. And the coffee is good and strong and lest I forget the bakery items!  Donuts that'll carry you over through lunch. You're at the Palms for a convention or to gamble Serrano Vista Cafe is a very good way to start your Vegas day.

reviews.title: Club Serrano, Reward Center. Kindness!
reviews.text: Can’t say enough about Jan Jan (Janise) and Jerry of Club Serrano. They both were totally awesome! They were so nice, patient, kind and knowledgeable. They took the time to help my self and Ersel. We learned so much from both of them. They represent some of the very best at the Palms Casino! Great job you two. Thanks again for everything.Regards, Vikki & Ersel

reviews.title: Amanda G. The G stands for Great!
reviews.text: Amanda G was the absolute best! We have never had such great service from a cocktail waitress the whole time we have lived in Vegas. She was so kind and thoughtful and was the reason we stayed and gambled longer than originally planned. She deserves a raise!

reviews.title: Palms is The best !!
reviews.text: Palms is the best !! The hotel room , comfortable , clean , perfect , food delicious wherever you eat in there, cafe salmon the best ! Ghost bar , ladies night , like a dream , dancing , laughing , great crowd , DJ, best views ever of strip and Vegas , outside patio , I love it at the palms , thank you Michael at front desk for all your help , you are awesome personality   , professional , kind , excellent customer service , always smiling , very helpful . Thank you Nicole at front desk , sweet , great customer service , help with a great room , and thank you Tavaris ,  you are professional , great personality , always helpful , awesome, you are  a great team at front desk , great assets to palms , each deserve a big raise , they were all definitely part of my perfect , great stay at the palms , I will be back , thank you I highly recommend the palms !!!!

reviews.title: Stay elsewhere!
reviews.text: Awful! Run-down and dirty property. Stayed in the Ivory tower as part of a conference group. Unfolded the bath mat to find several dead bugs in the towel. Antiquated heating/cooling controls so it made it very difficult to regulate temperature. Extremely uncomfortable bed and pillows

reviews.title: Nice rooms, but...
reviews.text: I stayed here for the last night of my USA trip. My room was large and comfortable, with amazing views, and I had a great night's sleep. The only disappointment was the restaurant. I decided to treat myself to their upscale Italian restaurant, Vetri Cucina, on the 56th floor. Unfortunately, half the restaurant was partitioned off by an (open) glass door, with an extremely LOUD corporate drinks reception on the other side. Imagine music thumping away and 40 or 50 people talking over it at the tops of their voices, just feet away from where you're trying to enjoy your meal. The waiter and I had to shout at each other to be heard. Why they hadn't warned me about this when I booked, or even just closed the restaurant for the evening, I don't know. The food itself was reasonably good, but nothing like as good as the prices might have you imagine - clearly priced for the location, rather than the quality.

reviews.title: STAY AWAY!!
reviews.text: It is absolutely ridiculous that not only did I not get the hotel I reserved, but also did not get the room type I reserved. I had to go to two different places to get checked in. When I arrived at Palms Place, their front desk first said that they couldn't find my booking. Then I proceeded to call Expedia, but no one answered the phone. The only response I received was through the chat. The rep in the chat said my booking was fine and asked me to try again. The front desk finally found the booking using a name instead and gave me the 5 digit confirmation they kept asking for, but couldn't be provided by Expedia. Then they proceeded to tell me that my hotel got switched from Palms Place to Palms casino and asked me to go over there to check in. They assured me that the 5 digit confirmation number would be correct. When I got to Palms casino, I had to wait in line again to only have their front desk tell me that the 5 digit confirmation from Palms Place was actually wrong. They were willing to give me a room in the Fantasy Tower, so I figured that would be comparable to the Studio Suite that I booked originally. The Studio Suite was supposed to have amenities like refrigerator, microwave, cookware, and utensils. The casino side claimed that they didn't have such a suite type of room but it would still be a two queen. After an hour of back and forth trying to check in, we went up to our room only to find out it only had one king rather than two queens as promised. I called the front desk and they said they would have someone bring me the room keys for a two queen in the same tower. I waited another 20 minutes and no one came. They called saying they didn't have a room in Fantasy Tower anymore and only had a two queen in the Ivory Tower, which is the old tower. We didn't want to wait anymore and we told the front desk that we would just go downstairs to get the new keys. We entered the room at the Ivory Tower and noticed that the A/C was super loud. We requested to switch to another room and this time the A/C was normal, but the bathroom tub was horrifying with paint peeling and rust. It was like a tub you'd get from Motel 6. By that time, we had no more energy to tell the front desk anymore. Also had to call housekeeping to get a DND tag. On checkout day, housekeeping freaking knocks on your door with the DND tag hanging and it was before checkout time at 11am.  This stay has to be the worst ever we've had in Las Vegas and we come here quite often.

reviews.title: Gambling Cocktail Service
reviews.text: DeSantis was  wonderful casino floor  waitress!  She paid attention to us and was a joy to have serve us. We have had her service  many times while gaming and always does a great job.  Looking forward to  seeing her the next time we come in.  She brightens our nights.

reviews.title: Overall good stay but needs improvement
reviews.text: This is a nice place to stay on Vegas off the strip. But there were a few things that need improvement. I waited 30-45 minutes for check in at around 7 pm. While two female employees were trying to check in 15-20 people as many as four other employees stood around the bell desk doing nothing for the entire time. As most of the front desk staff were women it looked like gender discrimination problem in addition to resulting in unnecessary waits for guests who were exhausted from travel. Also I like that they offered veggie options but there were not enough and they did not taste good. Clearly no vegetarian cooks ensuring it actually tastes good. If you’re going to do it do it right. Also I would never bring family here because no fridge in the rooms and big fine if you put your stuff in the minibar. Last they need a year round pool.

reviews.title: Great location. Room is better than most. Some opportunities for improvement
reviews.text: Large room, well maintained and clean. Good customer service. Lots of food options at the hotel. Parking is a bit sketch.  One of the largest rooms that I've stayed in Vegas. And, had a nice view of the Strip. Close to Chinatown, which is where I eat often. Check-in and out was quick and efficient, however, when I checked-in, there was no one at the front desk. After about 5 mins, one rep finally stepped out. The biggest challenge is parking. I stayed in the tower on the east side of the hotel. There is a parking lot directly adjacent. Even though there are multiple floors, there are only a small number of spaces available, if you're not a casino VIP.  It's quite dark and I didn't see any security in the lot, during my 3 days in the hotel. I would recommend parking in the large parking lot of the west side of the casino, but it's a considerable walk from the hotel towers.

reviews.title: Palms Rocks!!!
reviews.text: Danny is by far the best bartender in town!  The staff at the Palms is on another level. I will be back soon!!  Great experience!  The spa is also a must when at the Palms!! Fine dining at both scotch and the Italian restaurant were on point!  Pool was also a great place to chill!

reviews.title: Summary of our visit
reviews.text: The rooms were beautiful, so were the pool and the casino. The service was amazing - Rean, our receptionist was kind, polite, helpful, and he even upgraded our room for free. The hotel was really clean. The breakfast at the casino restaurant was super delicious!

reviews.title: Great hotel away from the bustle of the strip
reviews.text: We stayed in an Ivory Deluxe room. Very comfy bed, good space and spotless. It’s a 10 min cab ride or 30 min walk from the Strip which makes it a little less busy . Busy enough, good vibe and atmosphere but not as rammed as the Strip casinos. Pool area is excellent, food options ranging from McDonalds, BBQ joint to fine dining. It’s an LV casino, so nothing is free (actually parking is), but being off the Strip makes it noticeable cheaper. $10 for a G&T is half the price of Caesars or the Belagio, etc. The Ghost Bar is worth a visit with a view of the LV skyline that you just can see from the Strip hotels. My only gripe was the lack of a late checkout option. Would stay again.

reviews.title: Great Customer Service
reviews.text: MARY ,friendly employee at Players Club was soooo helpful & nice.I hope they give her a raise.Every time we go there & she is working she is always sweet & even if it's busy she has a Smile on her face.The employees at the Players Club really work hard !

reviews.title: The palms remodel is awesome
reviews.text: Jessica at the front desk went above and beyond to get me a room in new tower. It is a real Fantasy being in the Fantasy tour. I won't stay anywhere else.
