I was upset with my stay last time here but I'm very happy this time. I was also very impressed with tim ho wan restaurant for the dim sum meal.

reviews.title: Amazing trip to Vegas!
reviews.text: Maria at the front desk was amazing!!! We had so many different request for her. She was so accommodating and was able to achieve everything that we asked of her! She also was so knowledgeable! The hotel stay was great but I would come back because of Maria and how nicely we were treated! Everyone should have a Maria at there front desk!

reviews.title: Nice place away from the main strip
reviews.text: Really nice restaurant, away from the strip, nice city views and amenities. There was a spa however due to busy period I was unable to book treatments at the spa, which was disappointing, there were great bars and food places with good choice. Nice place to relax after being at the strip

reviews.title: Our housekeeper Sarah made our trip exceptional!
reviews.text: Sarah Alcantara was our housekeeper and she was exceptional. She was very kind and was always on top of whatever we needed for our business accommodations. She is the type of person you want taking care of things. She deserves a really good review.

reviews.title: Decent hotel and value
reviews.text: This is a lovely hotel off the Strip. It's not too big so quick and easy to get to your room. We stayed in the Ivory Tower and the room was good. Bed very comfortable and we had a great view.Drinks and food were reasonably priced compared to other hotels on the Strip.Biggest complaint was that they shut one half of the pool area in the week with no explanation, in fact reception staff pleased ignorance to it even happening! This meant guests were squashed into one part of the pool that went into shade by 2pm.Uber / Lyft to Strip ranged from 8 to 18 dollars which got expensive when we were going in and out day and night. We chose to get the bus on a number of occasions which was right outside and much cheaper.

reviews.title: It was a great and fun experience.
reviews.text: The services and amenities are excellent. The place is clean and well kept. It doesn’t smell smoke like in some hotel casino resorts. It has  beautiful views inside the hotel. I recommend the place and would like to come back to stay for a vacation.

reviews.title: A petty bs extravaganza.
reviews.text: Skip this place. They will nickel and dime the hell out of you. They won't even let you take your little water bottle to the pool that they just charged u $5+ dollars for at the kiosk next to it, despite the fact that your group has a whole pool booth booked. It's the type of petty bs that will annoy the hell out of guests. Do better!

reviews.title: Best Experience at the Palms
reviews.text: The best service!  Got aconplimentary rooms and Alexis at the VIP Lounge got me an uograde.  She is as nice as she is beautiful 😀The Fantasy Towers was my room.  The executive suite looks brand new and modern.  has a huge window, dining table, a room with a king bed, and the couch outside that turns into a bed.

reviews.title: Excellent Stay Off-Strip
reviews.text: The Palms has quickly become our go-to Casino and Resort to play and stay at when we make trips to Vegas.Location-wise, it is off-strip but a very quick drive if you need to head out that way for a show. There's a really nice view of the strip from Ghost Bar, too.The rooms are relatively clean and updated. I would recommend staying in the Fantasy Tower over the Ivory Tower if available as they feel a bit "fresher" and have larger TVs. Security always checks your room key so you feel secure. Dining options are fantastic here. Scotch 80 is an incredible steak house and a dinner favorite for us. I still hope they will bring back the scallop crudo - one of the best bites I've ever had. You can't go wrong with the bone-in filet mignon and all of the appetizers and sides are fantastic, too. Tim Ho Wan is great for dim sum, and there's also an Italian restaurant, 24 hour cafe, pizza place, and fast-casual restaurants like McDonald's and Panda Express. They also have AYCE, a buffet with lobster special on Wednesdays and Thursdays.There are plenty of slot machines and they change up the layout and add new machines frequently. Table games are also solid with a good variety of baccarat, blackjack, pai gow, ultimate texas hold'em, craps, roulette, and more. We always have a good time, win or lose.Shout out to our host, Erno, who always takes care of us and is just the best host ever! We wish he could be our host everywhere. We also adore Velma on the casino floor, who is super sweet and friendly. She makes sure we stays hydrated so we can continue gambling ;)

reviews.title: Palms Has Gone DownHill. Not Resort Vibe. No Shopping, Pool Sucks, Vibe Sucks, Has Gone Downhill.Ghostbar has same music
reviews.text: Palms Has Gone DownHill. Not Resort Vibe. No Shopping, Pool Sucks, Vibe Sucks, Has Gone Downhill.Ghostbar has same music

reviews.title: Convenient location
reviews.text: It’s a very nice hotel with spacious clean room. The location is convenient- not far from the main strip but we still took a taxi to get there as it is bit too far to walk.  There is a casino on site and a lot of restaurants to choose from but is also a pharmacy and shop nearby. The staff is helpful and polite. Unfortunately due to the windy weather the pool was closed. If you enjoy night life than this hotel with casino is definitely for you!

reviews.title: Liberty at the Palms!
reviews.text: The Palms is an amazing property as they've persevered and flourished. The staff is amazing especially Liberty who is quick with the drinks and always with a smile. Great dining options, pools and theaters. So many reasons to just stay on property

reviews.title: Kind customer service from Haben!
reviews.text: Haben (at the front desk) was such a kind person and he went the extra mile to get me a complimentary upgrade for my birthday! I was so happy and surprised! His effort made all of the difference in my trip. Instead of being in the old tower we were able to go to the new one.

reviews.title: Tracey at the Tonic bar was great!
reviews.text: At the tonic bar near the sports book, Tracey served us. What a great personality, so sweet and bubbly and funny. She took such great care of us, and had everyone at the bar laughing and happy. We will definitely come back to see her when we visit Vegas again!

reviews.title: Cocktail server
reviews.text: Palms Casino is great. I have to say Liberty the cocktail server is the best. She is on her game and always giving the best service. Every time I have got to see her she's running around with a smile and always so pleasant. Thank you for doing a great job

reviews.title: Outstanding service
reviews.text: Amazing service from Liberty,Dee Dee, Kim at tonic sports bar ! Cyrus. Britney always a pleasure to have them take care of us . We’re regular guest be back in September for a concert. Look forward to seeing them again. Your casino is blessed to have them

reviews.title: Chic & Peaceful Vegas Style
reviews.text: From the time I arrived, Michelle at the front desk was super helpful and accommodating in the most professional way. She was a welcome experience after a long drive from Pasadena. Our suite was spectacular—spacious and with everything we needed. Including an ice maker! Loved our space and the shared spaces throughout. I especially loved walking over to the adjoining Palms for a more expansive Vegas vibe: casinos, food courts, movie theatre etc, and being able to retreat to our cozy spot at the end of long days of basketball games. This is our preferred space when we travel to Vegas.

reviews.title: Nice Property but poor service
reviews.text: Nice property but no service. Room was not cleaned once during a 2 night stay.Nice food court with a McDonalds and Earl of Sandwich which I liked and used a few times. Had $50 food credit but didn’t use it as preferred to pay for the restaurants I liked in the food court.Checking was easy and quick.Room clean on arrival. Wi-Fi didn’t work and shower water pressure very poor.Nice TV with YouTube.Check out took ages as only one member of staff on duty.

reviews.title: Very nice hotel & casino
reviews.text: I decided to surprise my husband with a belated anniversary staycation & dinner at AYCE Buffet. I reserved a comped king room in the Fantasy Wing. I received a notification that our room was ready a few hours before check in time so we arrived earlier than expected. Paige greeted us at the front desk. She was so pleasant & very professional. She offered us an upgrade to a corner suite for a few dollars more. Except for a few housekeeping & maintenance issues, the suite was nice. Views were great. Wish I had booked it for more than just an overnight stay but I really just wanted to have a room to sleep in after overindulging at the AYCE lobster & crab buffet! LOL We will definitely return in the future.

reviews.title: GREAT HOTEL AND CASINO
reviews.text: GREAT HOTEL! CLEAN ROOMS! STAFF HOSPITALITY WAS EXCELLENT! POOL CABANA IS A MUST! VERY RELAXING. EVERY RESTAURANT AND THE FOOD WAS AWESOME! SOME WILL SAY VEGAS NEVER PAYS. PUT MY PALMS CLUB REWARDS CARD IN THE SLOT MACHINE. WON SOME $$$.... I WILL ALWAYS STAY HERE IN VEGAS...DON'T STAY ANYWHERE....SEE YOU NEXT MONTH PALMS!

reviews.title: $7.77 Breakfast is GONE! NOOOOO!
reviews.text: We came to the Serrano Vista Cafe for the special breakfast $7.77, affordable, great quality and quantity, only to find out they stopped the special on August 6, 2024. So disappointing, the cafe is now empty with servers just waiting for customers. Palms was finally a place that felt like old Vegas, total let down. Won’t be back. We did stay and ordered the cheapest meal, porridge for $9, boring. Our server Michelle was great, super friendly, observant and kind.

reviews.title: OUR DAUGHTER BIRTHDAY CELEBRATION
reviews.text: NICE HOTEL DID NOT LIKE NOT LIKE  HAVING NO DOORS ON THE SHOWER OR BATHROOM AND THE ROOMS ARE WAY TO SMALL BUT THE ROOMS ARE CLEAN AND POOLS ARE VERY NICE THE KIDS ORDERED A CABANA AND THEY LOVED IT!!! THE FOOD WAS REALLY GOOD ALSO BUT I DONT THINK WE WILLL RETURN BECAUSE OF THE SMALL ROOMS .

reviews.title: Outstanding Customer Service
reviews.text: The check-in line was long on Sunday August 18, 2024 and my wife was waiting for assistance. Charlie from the VIP area came to help move the check-in process. Charlie showed my wife to the VIP area and when I arrived she was sitting comfortably and checking in. Charlie fixed us up with a beautiful room and we had a great stay. Also this was my wife's birthday and we played and enjoyed the dining venues too. Thank you Cherlie for your professional and friendly manner.You are a credit to the Palms organization

reviews.title: Sammy's Island Sundaze
reviews.text: returned to Island Sundaze at Sammy Hagar's pool at the palms.  I finally ordered the nachos which are more than enough for 2!  We also indulged in the chicken tenders which came with a variety of fried potatoes, including tater tots and french fries.

reviews.title: Best hotel for kids
reviews.text: Best resort for kids.  We are used to the Wynn where there is not much for kids.  We booked a room and cabana this trip.  From the dining venues to the pool my three kids, aged 8, we were welcomed with opened arms.   We have been here without kids and had similar awesome experiences.

reviews.title: The casino a dangerous place caused by security
reviews.text: Be careful and my suggestion would be never to set foot in the palm's casino resort I've gambled there . loss Lots of money and I thought that I would be treated with. Respect. But the security are overbearing Thugs They are Beyond rude and they bully everybody There are numerous other casinos that treat people with the utmost respect. So there's no reason you need to go to the palms and put yourself in that Environment

reviews.title: Don't do it.
reviews.text: Staying here and all the pools are closed. Ridiculous. They have 3. One closed high winds, the other a jud pooped in, the 3rd has been blocked off for no reason. It's 100 degrees. Everyone is pissed. Also got here at 5 since that's when its bearable to be outside. Just found out pools close at 6. The whole place is tired and ghetto.

reviews.title: Great to see Tracey back at the Tonic sports bar
reviews.text: I visited the Palms on July 23 and 24, and it was great to see your bartender, Tracey, back at the Tonic sports bar.  She is consistently friendly and attentive to her customers, including a lot of regulars who stopped by.  She makes great cocktails and she has a great sense of humor.  She works very hard but still takes the time to be attentive to her guests.  I'll be back in August -- can't wait to see her at my favorite sports bar in Vegas, the Tonic!

reviews.title: Clean,  friendly,  convenient.
reviews.text: Eat at the Serrano Vista Cafe! Delicious food. Our server Michelle B. Is incredible and provides exceptional service.  Super friendly and polite. A+ . Hotel is clean, good food options,  night life, etc. Staff is friendly,  nice bars and lounges.

reviews.title: Best Sports Bar in Vegas!
reviews.text: Visted the Tonic Bar at the Palms Casino today and luckily the fantastic bartender Tracey was working!  She does an outstanding job with a smile on her face and makes you feel at home.  The staff there is awesome and total pros, thank you Kim, Omar, and Brittany, all of you rock!  This is the best sports bar in Vegas and I can't recommend enough.  Can't wait to go back and see staff, they are the best!

reviews.title: Love Serrano Vista Cafe at Palms
reviews.text: We ate at the Serrano Vista Cafe in the Palms Casino and the food was delicious. Their menu had such a great variety from Mexican, to Asian and traditional American meals.  Server Michelle was so friendly and courteous. She made the experience so enjoyable .  I would recommend this place to anyone as it is the best experience of any I have had in Vegas for dining.

reviews.title: The Palms Rock
reviews.text: Staying with family and enjoying the hotel and all its amenities, including the pool. Great place to stay for the weekend! Tracy at The Tonic Bar made us our yummy favorite drink with a friendly sweet smile, would recommend the Tonic bar to chill and relax .

reviews.title: Excellent 5 STAR 🌟 customer service!
reviews.text: Today I had an amazing experience at the Tonic Bar with great customer service provided by bartender Tracey!!She provided excellent above and beyond customer service!!Five Star 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟!!I highly recommend stopping by and saying hello!

reviews.title: Clean resort and nice staff
reviews.text: We had a pleasant stay at the Palms resort. The rooms were clean and the resort was well-maintained. The staff was friendly and thoughtful. Oscar, one of the staff members, was very helpful and contributed to a great experience during our stay.

reviews.title: You won’t be disappointed!!!
reviews.text: Everything about staying here was amazing starting with Ana she was amazing!!! The room was immaculate and the bed was just what I needed!!! The Shaggy concert was perfect!!! Can Yall please tell me where the Nachos we ate at the pool came from lol This will be where I stay anytime I’m in Vegas!!!

reviews.title: Never a dull moment
reviews.text: The hotel was beautiful, the restaurant had great food and the staff was very friendly. Especially Ana McIntyre, she was very attentive and made everything so smooth possible for us.  Her recommendations made our trip worth wild and highly recommended. Her service was immaculate.

reviews.title: Great! stay at the Palm
reviews.text: great stay at the palm! we came from the UK to Vegas to get married and the Palm is where we decided to stay for five nights. we came in August and it was very hot. we stayed on floor 18 of the ivory tower. the room was very spacious and clean and the view from our window was amazing. you could see Vegas part of the strip and mountains. the only downside to the room is that there was no tea and coffee making facilities and the mini fridge that is in the room is full of stuff that you have to buy, being from the UK. I would like a kettle to make a cup of tea in the morning, it wasn't the end of the world. casino grounds itself are amazing and huge. all the staff are really helpful and friendly. there are lots of slots and games to play and there are a variety of food and drink places within the casino to eat breakfast, lunch and dinner. we only briefly went out to see the pool area which is a nice size clean and look like a good vibe. but unfortunately since it was 45° here there was no chance we were sitting out there as it was too hot. the only thing to moan about is when the cleaner came in and cleaned our room. they didn't empty the bins which was slightly annoying but again not the end of the world. the rooms are fully equipped with irons and hair dryers which is a bonus for our skills so we don't have to pack it. they have vending machines and ice dispensers on every floor which was a lifesaver in this weather. the hotel itself is off the strip. I'd say it's a 45-minute walk or a 5 to 10 minute Uber journey. wear it slightly more out of the way it is quieter which we enjoyed. would definitely recommend booking this hotel.

reviews.title: Great food Great services
reviews.text: Had amazing lunch today at Serrano Vista cafe at the palms food was amazing and our server Aquila was great and friendly.  Aquila recommend the mimosa flight omg delicious. Thank you for amazing time we will definitely be back best cafe. Thank you

reviews.title: Kindness
reviews.text: Joanna was kind, friendly, and professional, helping us have a positive check-in experience. The bell staff was accommodating and quick. Now my mouth is watering, we just got in the room and we are all excited to eat a juicy steak at Scotch 80!

reviews.title: The Palms cars
reviews.text: The staff here really cares about their guests. I’ve been staying here now for years and they are always accommodating and always try to make sure that it’s a pleasurable experience. Thank you to Michael and Muhammad for doing such great work.

reviews.title: Rooms need attention
reviews.text: I love the Pearl, and the free parking is a nice perk. I stayed in the hotel for the first time recently and my experience started to decline. The front desk agent was nice and the room was big and quiet. Unfortunately the room left much to be desired. The shower was dirty, the thermostat was so old you couldn't set the temperature, the mattress was hard and the room had a smell I couldn't place. I'll definitely be back for concerts, but I don't think I'll be staying there again.

reviews.title: Excellent. I can't wait to come back
reviews.text: We loved the room service rendered by this employee Sarah Alcantara. She was very sociable and kind. She kindly attented to our inmediate needs and left our room very cleaned. I would love to come back to this elegant and pleasant room 17205.

reviews.title: Outstanding service and excellent experience
reviews.text: The room was extremely clean and the bathroom was exquisite. The shower had a lot of power and all the amenities. The room was very clean and the view was great. The room attendant, Jenifer.O., was outstanding and clean the room very professionally. She worked extremely fast and hard. I was very impressed. The casino is very organized and clean and all the help very accommodating. The restaurants are all very good. Getting ready to go down to the pool area for the day, I would highly recommend this place as one of the top places in Las Vegas. The machines are much looser than the casinos on this trip.

reviews.title: New Home in Sin City
reviews.text: We have been staying at the Palms for our last seven trips to Vegas. We love it!  The entire experience is consistently great. Awesome restaurants, friendly employees and wonderful accommodations. If you gamble they have the best comps we've seen. Check it out...

reviews.title: Very nice, but we did have one problem.
reviews.text: We stayed at the Palms last summer. It was very nicely laid out, very clean, and the staff we dealt with was friendly and helpful. We did experience one problem. The mattress in our fantasy king room was extremely soft. It seemed to be worn out. Very uncomfortable. I placed a call to the hotel after returning home. We are booked there again, so hoping that we have a more comfortable bed to go along with the otherwise positive experience that we had in our first stay.

reviews.title: Comfortable stay
reviews.text: Great very spacial room, nice views and convenient location. Hotel was very clean and had all the amenities. The staff members are nice and professional. Special thanks Manny (at the reception) for the service! Very reasonable price for what you get.

reviews.title: Great vibes
reviews.text: We were here to celebrate my husbands birthday and 4th of July. After much research, we decided to book Palms because they had great amenities and prices for the rooms was great. I had a very pleasant check in experience with Oscar, he advised on the best ways to enjoy the property. Sadly, the 4th of July rooftop fireworks was sold out, we should’ve booked it when we booked the room. But the rooftop bar was amazing, and so was playing at the tables. The dealers made it really fun, and responsible gambling is emphasized here. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and we will be coming back.

reviews.title: 30th Anniversary Trip
reviews.text: We are annual Vegas travelers who have never stayed off-strip but often visited the Palms and wanted to give it a try for our 30th wedding anniversary. After a rocky start (room keys not working, assigned an occupied room, and a broken television), Krista at the front desk absolutely made our trip amazing! She upgraded us to a corner suite and made it even more special with decorations, wedding cake and champagne! She was absolutely a joy to work with and made this a special and memorable vacation! The only reason that I'm rating the Palms four stars is that the air conditioning simply couldn't match the Vegas heat. Both our room and the casino just didn't cool down enough to be totally comfortable. We will definitely return, and our most heartfelt thanks and appreciation to Krista. She is awesome!!

reviews.title: Looking forward to returning to the Palms
reviews.text: The Palms is my new favorite place to stay! Far enough away from the overloaded strip, but close enough if you want to venture out that way! The hotel amenities are great as well as the cleanliness of the well appointed rooms. All the staff members are on point. Special shout out to Loreto at the Serrano Vista Cafe. She was very sweet and helpful and a delight ! C Sweikhart

reviews.title: Joanne was amazing!!
reviews.text: Joanne Who was working at the front desk was so patient and kind with me as I was trying to figure out my Charges to my room on my credit card. I was worried because it looked like there was a lot of unauthorized charges. She went above and beyond to break down the bill and explain to me what the charges were and how I would be able to get my deposits back she even even rode everything down on a card line by line. She was so amazing. I just really wanna make sure that she gets credit for what a great job she did.!!

reviews.title: Sammy's Island Experience
reviews.text: My family rented a cabana at the pool.  I just think it could have been cleaner for how much $$ we spent.  The cushions were all over the place and dirty with crumbs and hair from yesterday's guests I suppose?  We were there at 11:30 am so I think we were the first of that day to use the cabana.   On a good note:  The staff were friendly, working hard and so were the bartenders at the Tequila Bar!

reviews.title: Wonderful Vegas Resort
reviews.text: This resort was fantastic! Clean, great food, wonderful room (we got the strip view rooms) and even better staff! We made it a point to mak it to the Seafood Buffet and it was DELUXE! We had great food, wonderful company and truly enjoyed our time. We will definitely be back!

reviews.title: It was a great stay. I want to acknowledge one particular staff who stood out (Paige at the front desk).
reviews.text: It was a great stay. I want to acknowledge one particular staff who stood out (Paige at the front desk).

reviews.title: Great Saturday
reviews.text: Had a great time at palms pool.  In a time where local resorts are getting greedy with covers and such, palms offers free pool days on weekends.  Reasonable drink prices.   Awesome staff.   Shout out to Patricia @the unknown lounge for being absolutely amazing.  Will for sure be back!

reviews.title: Got a penthouse, I left being accused and charged with stealing.
reviews.text: After getting a Penthouse for my girlfriend's 50th, the trip went downhill. We were ready to leave, and I noticed all these bogus mini bar charges. After clearing that up and leaving for home, I noticed a charge for $150. I called and the lady at front desk told me "I see here in the notes you stole a Keurig Machine, so there's a charge for room damage of $150." I couldn't believe it. Instead of enjoying my time and celebrating a birthday, I was forced to be on the phone with agents who got worse and worse. After TWO DAYS of getting home and trying to clear these charges, I got a call that they were. No apology, no remorse, nothing. I was accused, insulted, charged and stressed. I tried emailing and telling them about my experience, and I got no response. This was all I needed to know. I'm a big spender, and they lost me over $150.

reviews.title: Great off strip propery
reviews.text: I really enjoyed my stay at the Palms. The room was clean and comfortable. The casino is clean and has a nice selection of slots, VP, and table games. Mabel's was closed which was a bummer. The brunch is definitely worth the $33 price, especially with the bottomless mimosas!Shout out to Paige at the front desk for being so friendly and helpful. Also, Pam at the VP bar who got me well prepared for my flight (scared of flying) with a few stiff drinks. All of the staff was friendly and helpful.

reviews.title: Look no further book here.
reviews.text: This is the spot!!! It was our first trip to Vegas ever! This was a family trip and we couldn’t have ask for a better hotel or area! The staff was very tentative. Our sink in the bathroom stopped up and they immediately came to fix it. When they finished they made sure housekeeping came to keep it up. The pool hours are kinda odd 10-6 I would suggest they be longer due to the heat. You aren’t allowed to even take water in the pool area. To me that seems a little bit too much. They will give you water at the bar but it gets hot before you can even drink it. The parking is free so that was a plus. The only negative thing I have to say is the AC in the room would no go below 68. We kept it set to 50 at all times. But 68 seemed to be its peak. I guess that maybe due to the extreme heat there. Also if you book through TripAdvisor/Expedia the rooms are much cheaper!! Over all it was a wonderful stay off the strip but close to enough. I would give it a 10/10 for cleanliness in the rooms.

reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: The palms really delivered! It was a great room, Check In experience, and the shower was fantastic.  The pool staff was extremely friendly the food and dronk selection was on point.Rean at the Front Desk was quick, efficient,  and thorough. Really great job Palms.

reviews.title: Alexis is the bestest
reviews.text: Alexis in the VIP Lounve checked me in, she is very Profesional. I really appreciated her help today, super sweet and kind I will definitely be coming back to the palms! Not to mention  she called my host and got me an upgrade!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text: Amet was amazing! He helped us upgrade our suite to start off our honey moon perfectly! It was a smooth and excellent check in experience because of him. The room was fantastic and had an incredible view of downtown Vegas strip and the mountains surrounding. Thank you!

reviews.title: Awesomeness
reviews.text: Tammy at Reservations was AWESOME..  TAMMY PROVIDED Great Service. SHE Got a Great room. THANK YOU.. I WILL DEFINITELY BE BACK TO STAY AT PALMS In LAS VEGAS.. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.. ROOM WAS AMAZINGLY CLEAN.. ABSOLUTELY NO COMPLAINTS...CAN'T WAIT TO BE BACK

reviews.title: The New Boss of Vegas
reviews.text: If you are looking for an off strip property that treats you like a family member do not hesitate to book a room here.Everyone on the property from the housekeeping staff to security to the cocktail servers on the casino floor were friendly and inviting.The Hosting is old Vegas where you are a person and not an offer number. Matt could write a book on how to host a player and his boss Greg could edit it and do the forward! Engaging and hospitable, and made you feel like you were welcome visitors in their home. Even the Casino Manager Ray stopped in at dinner to say hello. World class all the way around.The room was a suite on the 33rd floor…Spacious, spotless, with a connecting room booked to accommodate my teenage girls so they could have some privacy (thanks especially for that). Bathroom was well appointed and housekeeping was on the spot.The Steakhouse was WORLD class with impeccable service and offers some of the best cuts in a town where great meat cuts are standard. The buffet was excellent and my only complaint was they didn’t have twist ice cream on the desert bar (should’ve been a one star yah lol).The cafe had great service and good food for the price point. Dining is AAA+.The casino is well stocked with all the latest and greatest games. I have played in places with higher payback but for Vegas the casino was very generous and I had a great time playing there. Cocktail service was outstanding and EVERYONE I encountered on the gaming floor was incredibly friendly and helpful. They do have a download system that allows you to turn handpays into tito’s instantly. I got to use that feature a lot so yay for loose machines! Thank you to the slot manager Brittany for her help with that!I have played and stayed in casino’s from Macau to Manila to AC to California and everywhere in between… this is by far the BEST venue I have ever had the pleasure of staying and playing in. Thank you to Ray and his incredible staff there for a world class time! We have a new favorite venue in Vegas!

reviews.title: The Palms Las Vegas
reviews.text: Located just off the strip, a decent hotel with all amenities accessible.Large rooms.Good pool area only negative is the pool restricted opening hours which were 10-6. Should be 8-7 in our opinion. Very strict security.Plenty of restaurants and bars on site.

reviews.title: Stoked to come back.
reviews.text: A great off the strip hotel/casino. Can’t wait to come back. Great food options. A lot of different games. Clean and feels safe. Good energy, a lot of people and plenty of space as to not get kicked around. If you need help with something, talk to Jerry… he gets it done!

reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: the service , the room & friendliness  that Raquel Caldo that she show are so excellent, I can't wait to get back soon again, wishing it will be the same kind of service & hospitality that she show me. looking forward to reserve a room again in the future,will want to make business with you , thanks

reviews.title: Horrible customer service!!
reviews.text: The worst Customer Service!!! First and foremost they NEVER pickup the phone at the hotel. The reservation desk is overseas and they have no idea of anything “at the hotel”. I have been on hold for over an hour on 2 occasions!! Just awful!! The Air conditioning in both rooms made this loud noise that prevented us from getting a good nights rest (we were attending a convention and had business meetings the following day and had arrived at the hotel past midnight on Wednesday). The front desk staff said they would only remove the resort fee on both rooms, nothing else. Now when I see my credit card charges they only removed the resort fee on one room, not both and they still do not answer the phone at the hotel. Horrible!!This time around the “operator” could not put me through to someone who could help with this and again put me through to the front desk at the hotel. The hold is FOREVER, nobody answers the phone.

reviews.title: Beautiful inside and throughout
reviews.text: Ari at the players club was very sweet and helpful she even complimented me on my nails .We all had a blast and can’t wait to go back and actually book a room there and try their buffet. Also slots paid out and even though it was a Friday night I was still able to play my favorite machine fire link.

reviews.title: Thee best hotel in  Vegas
reviews.text: I will never be able to get over the professionalism Paige has shown any time we decide to stay at the Palms. She goes above and beyond to ensure we’re comfortable. She definitely deserves a raise or three! We will always make the Palms our first pick when vacationing in Vegas because she’s made the stay so pleasant.

reviews.title: PAIGE is the best! ❤️
reviews.text: I love The Palms and my stays  are always the best experiences, especially all the great dining available. But what makes this experience most importantly are the employees. They are all wonderful but one that really shines way above is Paige at the front desk. My first encounters with her was so delightful and welcoming. Her smile was warm and friendly. I was attended with such professionalism and I left feeling like she was my best friend. Each trip I always jump for joy when I see her at the front desk. I did once have a problem in my room and she solved it so smoothly turning   a bad situation into a happy one for me in no time. I always look forward to seeing her on my visits hoping she will be there that day to greet me at the front desk.

reviews.title: Outstanding
reviews.text: We arrived 6 hours early for our reservation. We were greeted at the front desk by Ms. Paige! Paige was excellent, she accommodated our time difference with checking in and ensured we were able to access our room in a timely manner while also enjoying the amenities the hotel has to offer while waiting. Paige gave my party and I several suggestions for the hotel and surrounding areas for entertainment . This was our first time in Las Vegas and at the Palms Resort and she made my party and I feel extremely welcomed and comfortable. You all struck GOLD with hiring her! The Williams Party thanks you Paige!

reviews.title: Amazing Night Out
reviews.text: Beautiful casino with great food, friendly and helpful staff and amazing entertainment options. My family and I wanted to see a comedy show and eat at the seafood buffet and was unable to find where to purchase tickets. Paige  was able to help us get our tickets for both the concert and to the restaurant. Paige was very patient, attentive and friendly while helping us navigate through this process. Paige is a reason we will come back again

reviews.title: Alexis @vip
reviews.text: Alexis was amazing we really appreciate her checking us in in VIP we love coming to the palms!!  There is no one else we would rather have check us in. We will definitely come back to the palms!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.title: Five Star Experience
reviews.text: My family stayed at the Palms recently, and we had an amazing experience. Everyone was so nice and helpful. Paige at the front desk was very attentive and made sure all of our needs were taken care of. She gave us great recommendations for restaurants and entertainment. She made the experience a great one. We'll definitely be staying here again before the summer ends.

reviews.title: Paige Palms Place
reviews.text: Paige per usual always goes above and beyond! I have worked with her many times and she treats each time like it is the first connection, it makes it a truly exceptional and seamless experience. Whether it is transportation or just a general questions she makes it happen at the drop of a hat. Palms is lucky to have someone like Paige, a great representative for the brand and culture. If you have a chance make it a point to ask for Paige on your next visit to Las Vegas!

reviews.title: Best experience ever
reviews.text: Paige was bery awesome! She rocks!!!! I love how she handled my reservation. Everytime im in Vegas, i will always choose Palms!  Paige and host Vai Thai!! Kudos to you and everyone else. The experience is always amazing! I love coming back to palms! I will surely come and visit whenever

reviews.title: Thank You Paige
reviews.text: I was at the Palm Hotel Last month. I was there with friends for a meal. We went up to the Front Desk to ask questions about what was the best place to eat. There Paige greeted us with a smile, ask could she help us. We told her we looking for a place to eat lunch. She told us about the different choices and directed us how to get there. We thanked her for her help and told her how much we appreciate her helping us. We chose the Buffet it was wonderful. Thanks Paige for a wonderful experience.  Arnez.

reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: We were helped by Paige at the lobby. Felt very welcome, great service! Very impressed by the hotel too: the casino is very large downstairs. The pool is impressive with music and bars. So far, really impressed even though we only just arrived.

reviews.title: Best customer service in a long time!
reviews.text: Paige was amazing and very accommodating! I always stay at the palms and always have an amazing experience! I have been coming to the palms for years! I got in a little earlier but they were able to get me in a little early! I would definitely recommend 10/10!

reviews.title: Movies and buffet
reviews.text: Shout out to Paige! She was so helpful during my visit! This place definitely is a one stop shop! I ate at the buffet with my husband and we received a coupon book with 2 free movie tickets at the theater from the front desk. Will absolutely be returning!

reviews.title: Local friendly
reviews.text: Visiting the palms for a staycation and planned to go to the pool. I stopped by the front desk & spoke with miss Paige. Little did I know that locals receive a free cabana. She was able to assist with all the questions I had and gave me great advice. Will definitely be returning with more friends and family.

reviews.title: 100% awesome 5stars
reviews.text: Signed up for player card with Jerry he was awesome, super helpful and accommodating. I will come back next month to build up my points. We plan to come back next i loved the food and hotel pool and the sports book area was nice also we took a uber out front also it was very easy

reviews.title: Great Front Desk Check In!
reviews.text: Absolutely delighted with the exceptional service provided by Justin at the front desk! From the moment we walked in, Justin greeted us with a warm smile and a genuine willingness to assist. His professionalism, efficiency, and friendly demeanor made the check-in process smooth and enjoyable. Justin went above and beyond to ensure our stay was comfortable, offering valuable recommendations and promptly addressing any requests. It's rare to find someone so dedicated and personable in customer service and we look forward to returning because of his outstanding hospitality.

reviews.title: Top quality stay not to far from the strip
reviews.text: Our 4 day stay was excellent! When we got in the front desk clerk Paige did an amazing job with assisting us with our stay, was very courteous and even gave us several recommendations on things to do and places to go! The hotel was busy but not as crazy as most directly on the strip, definitely staying here again especially because the prices were very reasonable.

reviews.title: Great experience, will go again.
reviews.text: Paige at the front desk was a great help in getting us a room and cabana and explaining all the amenities at the Palm's. Our time at the pool and cabana was wonderful. Our children loved the private pool and it was easy to keep an eye on them. We will definitely go back for future staycations. 5 stars all around.

reviews.title: Paige at Front Desk
reviews.text: Paige at the front desk provided exceptional service. She provided hotel information, accommodated our requests, and provided insight as to how to maximize the hotel services and benefits as Las Vegas locals. We stayed in May 2024 and again in June due to her great assistance.

reviews.title: Go Paige!
reviews.text: Paige at the front desk was amazing! We arrived way earlier than initially planned and she was incredibly accommodating! Love the room too! We opted for an upgrade and let me tell you it was way worth it. Please see photos below for a reference :)

reviews.title: The best service in Vegas
reviews.text: The Palms has been close to my heart for many years. This trip didn’t disappoint. Paige took the best care of me as always and it was overall an incredible experience. Will be back soon! The renovation of the rooms turned out amazing and the restaurants are so good!

reviews.title: Business trip
reviews.text: Paige was so kind and accommodating in getting me another room for one more night!!! I highly recommend this hotel for your travels to Vegas. I had never stayed at this hotel and she did such a great job finding me a room at a reasonable rate!! This was such a pleasant stay

The hotel was everything we expected and more ! But the highlight of our trip was having Paige decorating our room She was very informative, she stayed in contact with me to update me on everything she made everything so easy I felt at ease I honestly will recommend her to anyone She’s amazing

reviews.title: Great customer service!
reviews.text: I had a great experience booking my future stay. Paige was super helpful and friendly. I had so many questions and she answered every single one with excitement and enthusiasm. I appreciate this kind of customer service and look forward to my stay for my husband’s 40th birthday!

reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.text: We had a really great stay at the Palms! From the moment we stepped to the counter we were greeted by this wonderful young lady Paige. She was very helpful and answered all our questions about entertainment. The casino was world class and the food was amazing! Highly recommend! 10/10

reviews.title: Friendly staff
reviews.text: The property looks really nice and modern.   The staff is friendly.   Paige at the front desk was super friendly, knowledgeable and offered an upgrade for a very reasonable price.  The restaurants were amazing, reasonable and loved the main bar. I can't v wait to come back.

reviews.title: Amazing stay!!
reviews.text: I want to give a shout out to Paige at the front desk who was super friendly and went out of her way when we arrived early! We appreciated be welcomed by such a friendly face and enjoyed our stay! The rooms were clean and pool staff were fantastic too!

reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience at The Palms NV. I was there celebrating my birthday and Paige Davis greeted me with a warm and friendly welcome as soon as I entered the Hotel. She was polite, charismatic and knowledgeable, Paige is superstar and I appreciate her for making my stay at the Palms home-like. Thank you Paige!

reviews.title: Awesome Service!
reviews.text: A Very Excellent stay! The customer service around the hotel was stellar, help was always there when needed. We had to add one more night for a late flight out, and Paige at the Front desk was super friendly and Happy to help! Best choice for our trip to Vegas.

reviews.title: The Palms is great and Meiley is the best!
reviews.text: We have been going to the Palms frequently for the past year. We are locals and Palms is the best of both worlds, a strip property with a local feel. The Palms has great restaurants, bars, rooms, pool & spa. The employees really go out of their way to treat everyone special. We especially want to mention cocktail server Meiley Motta. Meiley is the most attentive, friendly and helpful person we’ve ever met anywhere. She is a one in a million! We Love Meiley!

reviews.title: Great turn around trip
reviews.text: I was surprised to be upgraded to a VIP when I checked in. We had a lovely corner suite and it was awesome! Alexis at the VIP center was so nice and made sure I had everything I needed. Every employee that I encountered was nice and always willing to help. I will definitely be returning to the Palms!

reviews.title: Disappointed. Didn’t live up to online description.
reviews.text: The Palms Casino Resort, Las Vegas “looked” nice online. It was okay, but doesn’t live up to the hype. I stayed there for the show. Let’s start with the hotel room. The room I stayed in was on the Ivory side. The room needs to be taken out of guest rotation until work is done on it. (Tip: I was told the rooms on the Ivory side are older than rooms on the Fantasy side.) What was wrong with the room?  Lots. Lighting in the room was inadequate, actually poor. When I had to close the curtains or night came, it was too dark in the room,  even with every light turned on. HVAC system was old, loud, and barely working when set on high. Mattress was uncomfortable and flimsy (no support).  Food was okay—most of the time, but not consistently prepared over the time I stayed at Palms Casino Resorts. This is a hotel for those whose primary purpose for staying is gambling and the condition of the room is secondary or doesn’t matter. I wouldn’t stay at the Palms Resort Casino again or recommend it to anyone.

reviews.title: Nice casino
reviews.text: Our first tripm to the Palms.  They suprised us and made us VIP's because it was our anniversary.  Balloons in the room and discount coupons for food and drinks.  IF we ever come back to Las Vegas, we would consider staying here again.  Maybe for our next anniversary?

reviews.title: Sammy’s Island at Palms Casino is open!
reviews.text: We attended the grand opening of Sammy’s Island, the new themed pool collaboration at the main Palms Casino Pool with Sammy Hagar.  It really adds a fun element to the pool and there are several upcoming concerts this summer, so be sure to check it out.  Our stay included VIP check-in, which is for turquoise and diamond members and is very nice to have. We were treated very well and felt like a VIP by Charlie Buduan and I definitely wanted to recognize him for his excellent customer service. We stayed in the Fantasy towers which is a little bit more roomy than the Ivory towers and loved our room, our bathroom, and our gorgeous view.There are lots of really good restaurants right there at the Palms Casino so you don’t even have to go anywhere,  We enjoyed a delicious dim sum meal at Tim Ho Wan, a late night slice of pizza at the pizza place, and also enjoyed the AYCE buffet which has different theme nights. In addition they have a regular restaurant that has a great breakfast deal Monday through Thursday mornings only $7.77 and they also have a late night steak and potato dinner, which we were not able to take advantage of that looked like a great deal. We attended the Sammy Hagar concert in the Pearl Theater, which is a very nice venue to see all the up-and-coming artists that are playing there, the venue only holds 2200 so every seat is a great seat in the sound was fantastic when we saw Sammy.The new Sammys island themed pool is really nice and you can also rent Sammy Hagar theme bungalows, and the food and drinks are good too. There is also a secondary pool in a different building, which is also a nice pool and has a restaurant next to it.We used Uber a couple days to go down to the strip and it was only $10-$12 and one morning we just walked down to the strip. It was about a 15 minute walk.

reviews.title: They weren’t kidding about the pillows
reviews.text: I thought the reviews about the pillows were just for fun but they were so right! They were literally the softest and fluffiest pillows, plus amazing and wonderful staff. I came with friends to celebrate my birthday and everyone was so welcoming. Definitely would recommend this place to all my friends and family.

reviews.title: It’s a crime, not choosing Palms.
reviews.text: I LOOOVED it here at Palms. Everyone was so helpful during my stay, going above and beyond my expectations. If you’re visiting Vegas, Palms is the best resort you can choose. I’m definitely gonna come back here next time I’m in Vegas. It’s a 10/10!

reviews.title: Amazing service
reviews.text: Karrie, Renee, and Lia did an excellent job decorating for my birthday! They went above and beyond. The customer service at Palms is unlike any other. The staff was extremely accommodating to my party’s needs. We were extremely satisfied with our stay!

reviews.title: Celebrating a Birthday an Paige led the way in a great experience with the palms
reviews.text: Paige was flawless in the execution of her check in. Offered a great upgrade for my stay. Unfortunately I couldnt take advantage of the great deal. Paige also broke down all my dining options recommended  Ayce buffet which I'm going to take advantage of tomorrow.  Paige thanks again for your help I'll definitely be back!

reviews.title: FUN IN THE SUN ⛅️ NEW COLORS AND GREAT FOOD SAMMYS ISLAND 🏝, revolving music for all crowds !!!
reviews.text: SAMMY’S ISLAND !!! 🏝 what a FANTASTIC new pool resort and new pillows cabanas and paint job ! BRAVO 👏🏼 sound system is spectacular and drinks 🍹 (thank u carissa at bar ) and service at registration Mr. Peet and Travasal (sp? handsome polite african american at registration and maria and the other gentleman w long hair very groomed w beard forgot his name ) extremely attentive and courteous !!!CANT WAIT to go BACK . “ayce” buffett STILL has it !!! DELISH DISHES !!! And look forward to trying Sammy’s Island dishes . CLEAN POOL 🏊‍♂️ CLEAN HOTEL 🏨 CLEAN FREE PARKING !!! YOUR SUMMER OASIS !!!

reviews.title: Serrano Vista Bar Tender
reviews.text: The bar tender Michael at Serrano Vista Cafe this morning was great.  Went above and beyond offered something off menu.  Genuinely wanted to know a little about us.  No rush to get us out of his way. I would  return to the restaurant just to be served by Michael again. Also will recommend this place to others.

reviews.title: Great service by Michael
reviews.text: Fantastic service from Michael.  He was very responsive to my nitpicking requests and very pleasant.  He also provided very fast service.  Food selection is good if you’re looking for a solid traditional breakfast after a late night.  Coffee hit the spot.  Nice to have usb chargers at table too!

reviews.title: VIP Experience
reviews.text: We go back to the PALMS frequently. And every time, the experience is pleasant. Last trip, we had a VIP experience and was working with Alexis Ridgeway. She was very helpful, kind, quick to respond to our needs, and very professional. She made our stay wonderful!!! I want to give kudos to all the staff (bell boys, to drivers etc) but especially to Alexis. We will be back!

reviews.title: Terrible front desk customer service.
reviews.text: Stayed from 05/16-05/20. Everything was okay except our bathroom sink in the room was not draining. I called early Friday morning and the maintenance man came in an out for hours but could not get it fixed. Eventually they had to call a plumber. We didn't want to leave our room open to strangers so had to stay until it was fixed. The plumber had to take the sink fully apart and snake the drain. There was a huge mess in the bathroom and smelled of sewage. This went on from 9am until about 3pm. During this time, we were unable to use the bathroom. Waste of our day. They would not let us switch rooms. The mantainence man said he would talk to the front desk about compensation.The morning of check out, I called down for a late check out. They did not accommodate. I mentioned the plumbing issue and they said a manager would call me back. I did not receive a call.When I went to check out at the front desk, Oscar assisted. He was extremely rude and unpleasant. When I mentioned the plumbing issue again he said there where no notes and became upset and asked me what I wanted for compensation. I told him I wasn't sure. He then said he would take off one day of the resorts fee. After handing me the final invoice, I asked to clarify the authorization on my card and how much I would get charged. This really seemed to set him off. He became upset and was short when explaining. I told him to have a good day before leaving in which he said nothing and walked the other way. I came back to the front desk to ask his name. He turned to me and pointed at his name tag. I've never seen a grown man throw a temper tantrum.This type of service is unacceptable. I was very understanding with the plumbing issues and could have cause a big fuss.The maintenance man, Carlton and valet were great. Front desk definitely needs some retraining in customer service.

reviews.title: Highly recommend!
reviews.text: I wanna start by saying Stephanie the hotel director is Amazing. Back in march I ran into a very unpleasant situation with the palms hotel. I was wrongfully put out of my hotel room at 1:30 am. After calling for a few days straight A security guard by the name of Mike Valdez found the problem & immediately turned it over to Stephanie. She then gave me call & went above & beyond to fix the problem! Here in may I returned to the palms hotel & they did everything in their power to make me feel welcomed. From the second I walked in to the second I left everything was amazing. We stayed in the fantasy suite that was very nice , spacious, bed was soft & housekeeping kept the room clean. I highly recommend the cabanas they are very relaxing. Also, the ghost bar has an amazing view & outstanding vibes. I’ve stayed at many hotels in Las Vegas & I must say the palms is now one of my favorites. I will most definitely be returning.

reviews.title: Beautiful views and great customer service
reviews.text: We stayed at the Palms place penthouse. The place is gorgeous and had everything we needed. The views were breathtaking. Oscar made this experience extra nice. He was so kind and helpful. His bright attitude made our trip start of right. Amazing customer service!

reviews.title: The best experience
reviews.text: This weekend I attended the kountry Wayne show and I had the best experience with a janitor name Larry he will go over and beyond for good customer service real nice guy it was the best customer service I ever had when it comes to being in a Casino when I come back to Vegas I will be staying at the Palms

reviews.title: Palms ruined my Mother’s Day Weekend of “Relaxation” with a bowling alley above my head
reviews.text: Huge disappointment! For Mother’s Day weekend, I was “treated” to a weekend in Vegas. iI’ve never stayed at the Palms before and was so excited to check it out. As a mother, you can imagine how much I was looking forward to this weekend.  One of my favorite parts about staying at a hotel is in/room dining. The first night, I got in late after a big dinner and wanted some tea. I called down to order tea and asked the girl to bring up a large pot. In every single hotel I’ve stayed in, the tea is brought up with an insulated silver tea pot. I was told they do not have large pots and that their tea only comes in one size, 16 ounce container. I asked the girl to bring up 2 containers instead and went on to ask “it will stay hot in there anyway right?” And the hotel rep said “yes”. The tea arrived in 2 paper cups!! When I told the server to take one of them back and credit me, he said he could not and that I “was already charged”. That isn’t true - in room dining is charged at the end to the CC on file. I called the next morning to order some coffee and asked the supervisor to credit the $10 paper cup of tea from the night before as I had not touched the second cup and that there was a misunderstanding about how the tea would be served. I had to talk to 2 agents and a supervisor to finally refund that $10 tea in a paper cup. When I asked to order coffee, an espresso or Americano (strong), I was told the whole hotel only serves “pike’s place” a very watered down American coffee. I opted out of ordering in room dining thereafter from this hotel. At around 1am, as I put my head down to sleep, I was constantly startled by HORRIBLE LOUD SOUNDS on my ceiling and could not sleep- sounded like furniture being thrown against the floor and moved around. I could not sleep and called down to see what the issue was and if they can help me out. The first rep told me there is a BOWLING ALLEY INSIDE THE ROOM a couple floors above me and they can’t do anything about it. I asked a supervisor to call me - as this was ABSOLUTELY RIDICULOUS. I had to wait for a Supervisor to call me back to “help” but she ended up repeating the same thing - told me “those guests paid for that room and we can’t tell them not to use the bowling alley. There are rooms with bowling alleys floors 19-25, we can move you if you want. I don’t agree with the construction either but there is nothing we can do about it but move you or give you ear plugs.” Mind you this was 1:30 am already and I happened to be on the 18th floor directly below these TERRIBLE rooms. WHO DOES THAT?! A BOWLING ALLEY inside a hotel room placed ABOVE regular rooms? When I went on to tell the supervisor that I should’ve been warned and given the option of a different room in ADVANCE, she said “well that room wasn’t rented yet when you booked your room”. That does not matter. The mere chance of a bowling alley being booked directly above your room is enough reason for a GOOD HOTEL to give their guests a warning like “hey there is a BOWLING ALLEY above your head while you try to sleep in your HOTEL ROOM. Do you like 50 lb balls being tossed on the hard wood floors above your head or would you want a different room?” Absolutely HORRIBLE “guest service” agents all around. Every single person I spoke with regarding the tea issue and the bowling alley, were not equipped to handle any guest service issues, let alone one as ridiculous as finding out there is an entire bowling alley above your head in a hotel room for a weekend when all you want as a mother is some rest and some good treatment. HORRIBLE HOTEL. Will never return.

reviews.title: Cool place, fun entertainment
reviews.text: Came to try our luck on the slots with some friends that live in Vegas. Wasn't too successful but still had a great time. My partner and I ate at Scotch 80 which was phenomenal and then went to the yachtly krew concert at the pool. That was definitely a good time, fun energy. Cool place, will for sure come back!!

reviews.title: Oscar my man
reviews.text: A nice hotel and casino that has nothing to envy from the strip. Strong all round. Personnel was really kind and friendly. Oscar, at the reception was mindful of our well being. He answered all our questions and was very helpful. Definitely recommend

reviews.title: Nice Resort with Amazing Views from your room.
reviews.text: Original tower is comfortable with an amazing and unobstructed view of the city and mountains.  'So pretty at night!  Room is large and bed was comfortable.  Maid was amazing!!!!   Wish the shower had a door on it   Nice to have so many good restaurants on site!

reviews.title: Horrible housekeeping service
reviews.text: I have traveled a lot in my life and I have never had worse housekeeping services. Not only was our room dirty upon arrival ( counters and used glasses) but it continued to be bad. Housekeeping never emptied our trash over a 4 night stay despite it being all in the receptacle. Ultimately I had to go ask for a trash bag to fill it up with three days worth of trash. Drains in the bathroom did not work properly and the housekeeper did not ensure her hairs were gone after replacing our towels ( I say this as floors were not cleaned ever). Also, our room was under a bowling suite. Which as a family traveling was the worst location as we would go to bed early. Lastly the manager said I would get a call from the housekeeping supervisor and I never did. I sometimes have to stay at low caliber hotels on road trips and those have been far cleaner than the Palms.

reviews.title: All around BAD!
reviews.text: Where do I start?  Was it the condescending attitude of the VIP host who checked me in?  Was it the pungent smell of carpet fresh that made it difficult to breathe in the room?  (Our last day we encountered the stench they were trying to mask) Was it the lumpy mattresses?  Was it the fact they informed us the water would be shut off the first morning of our stay?  Was it the rough crowd?  Was it the non-existent entertainment on the slots?  We’ve decided this will be the property of last resort for our stays in Vegas from now on. We’ve tried it twice now and it’s just NOT the place for us!

reviews.title: This place sucks; don’t book it
reviews.text: Stayed for a family wedding. Booked an ivory suite. Smelled like someone smoke 10 packs of cigs in our room. Asked to be moved and was moved to standard room in palm palace. Asked for a new room and they tried charged to up charge me $500 per night. Place is a joke I highly recommend booking anywhere else

reviews.title: The Palms is not friendly to Diamond players
reviews.text: Yaamava top management needs to get much more involved with the Palms, if they plan to keep this property long term.Palms does NOT recognize or take care of Diamond Players coming from Yaamava. I know, I’m one of them.Palms could have cared less about me being a Diamond player. I had to even go to a supervisor, just to get cleared for late checkout. And beyond that, they displayed zero regard for me as a player.Overall Palms staff is NOT friendly. Most of the workers there acted robotic and not friendly.The opposite is true at Yaamava, where the vast majority of team members are friendly and accommodating.Yaamava has a problem. They need to clean house at The Palms, and get management in there that treats us players well, like Yaamava does. And Yaamava has a much, much, much better selection of slot machines than The Palms.

reviews.title: stayed once for a show at the hotel/casino
reviews.text: Ther Hotel was ok but the staff were horrible! no help at all with the deposit on the room, I wound up having to dispute the charge on my credit card. definitely won't stay there again!

reviews.title: terrible attendant Oscar
reviews.text: I'm staying here until the 23/04, today I went to check in and the receptionist Oscar treated me terribly, the hotel is wonderful, it's a shame to leave such an arrogant and stuck-up guy at the hotel reception, the last time I'm staying.As for the gentleman who carried our bags, he is 1000% more polite than the attendant Oscar, he should be working at the hotel reception.

reviews.title: Excellent service and accommodations!
reviews.text: We came for our Anniversary and had a wonderful time. We had excellent service at Tonic Bar by the bartender Angela while watching the NCAA final. Very good upbeat atmosphere and she gave us recommendations on the restaurants also. We ate at Mabel’s BBQ, Scotch 80 & the AYCE breakfast all delicious. Our room had a fantastic view of the strip was clean and very spacious. Definitely coming back soon!

reviews.title: Wrong charges without any information
reviews.text: Unfortunately the hotel wrongfully and without any information charged me for the minibar to my security deposit. It took a long, annoying exchange of e-mails to get the hotel to at least agree to refund.  It seems based on other reviews that's not the first time they're doing that. Also no signs outside where to park and where to check in, check in is very slow, parts of the bathroom were very dirty (see pictures).

reviews.title: Exceeds expectations
reviews.text: I’ve been visiting Vegas since I was a young child, stayed at plenty of hotels/casinos over the years but the palms by far was the best. Great customer service, beautiful rooms, excellent food and loose slots. Me and my family enjoyed our stay very much and will back very soon.

reviews.title: MARY Ann
reviews.text: I had the best experience my waitsteess  Mary Ann is the best me and my husband sit in her section just  because of her I really appreciate  her kindness and smile everytime we are here. Mary Ann knows what drinks we like and even have them ready before we sit down at out slot machine. Palms casino you need more waitstees like here.

reviews.title: Sarah Alcantaro
reviews.text: Sarah Alcantaro with guest services was incredibly sweet and helpful during our stay on the 17th floor during the Cheer Choice Awards. She gladly offered help with our multiple trips up and down the halls and genuinely cared to make our stay enjoyable and carefree.  Thank you!

reviews.title: Musty rooms...
reviews.text: Musty, worn room with carpet that looks like it's alive. In general, the cleanliness leaves a lot to be desired, especially in the bathroom, especially for this price! You can hear every noise from the room next door through the connecting door! It takes 30 minutes to walk to the Strip, we wouldn't stay here again!

reviews.title: Memorable times at the palms!
reviews.text: I give this resort a  five star review from the hotel staff, restaurants, and  casino floor. Had a great time! I will definitely be back! I would highly recommend checking this hotel out. Very relaxing!  Free parking and many new casino slots to choose from.

reviews.title: Best customer service
reviews.text: Planned on taking a trip to Vegas, but I mixed up the dates and it turned into a real mess. I was really stressed out but Debra helped me fix everything. She was very kind and understanding. If you ever need any help, I highly recommend speaking with her.

reviews.title: SUPERB!
reviews.text: Upon check in Oscar was very pleasant and accommodating to begin with. The room is very clean, new and perfect size. Plus they have a food court that is open for 24 hrs, plus the buffet that also has unlimited crab legs and the kids got to enjoy the pool and theater. We loved everything in Palms Casino Las Vegas and we will definitely comeback!

reviews.title: You must visit!
reviews.text: Beautiful place to stay with a great location, clean room with a lot of space and friendly staff. Most of all the beautiful view! Thank you to Osear for welcoming my family and making us feel special! Can’t wait to come back! Must visit PALMS resort.

reviews.title: Loved it!
reviews.text: We loved staying here!! Oscar was super friendly at the front desk. Great restaurant options, reasonably priced drinks, clean bathrooms, and the room was huge!!! And for such a great price. I think we might have been upgraded?? Idk but it was amazing. We will definitely be back.

reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, Professional
reviews.text: Great Resort, thank you to our housekeeper Sarah Alcantara who was very Professional, our room was immaculate when she was done , Thank you  Sarah we will be visiting Palms casino again in the future, we had a great time here with our family on spring break 😃

reviews.title: Amazing service!
reviews.text: The Caker and Bellmen made our trip amazing! They were so attentive and accommodating. Always professional and a smile on their faces no matter how busy they were. I'd like to give a shout out too: Oscar, Teddy, Nyan and Noah. I felt like a true VIP and they made sure that we truly enjoyed our trip! I would stay at the palms hotel based on this customer service!

reviews.title: Awesome service
reviews.text: We had such a super  good time here, the staff is very friendly and the rooms are clean. Desanka was our server the first night we were here and she was super quick and friendly! I definitely recommend coming here and I would totally stay here again!

reviews.title: Beautiful Veiw.
reviews.text: The beds were comfy. The room also had a chase lounge that could be used as an extra bed so note of that! slept really well overall and for me, that's not common at hotels! The coffee was very good and the running/walking path was very nice and useful after a long day. The room was also very clean. Interesting decor though. Minifridge was very useful and clean. It had a variety of alcohol and was fully stocked up. Nice view too. I recommend this resort.

reviews.title: They Got It!
reviews.text: Rudy (valet) was the best ever!  Calm, quiet , confident.  Under control.Tavares (check in) was cool, calm, and knowledgeable.  Never got frazzled…even with a long lineWorth the trip to watch these professionals!One can tell this was not their first day!

reviews.title: Salon suite must be updated
reviews.text: We booked the Salon Suit for almost $800 / 2 nights and were hoping to get a luxury suit. However, when we arrived I realised that this is not luxury just a suit. I called to ask to be moved in the nicer suit and away from the elevator and has been transferred 3 times. Finally Nina the hotel manager got on the phone but didn’t really want to help at all . When I asked her if you can move us to much better suit she said sure we have a very nice room available for $5K if you willing to cover the cost …. Nice going Nina! Helped me a lot …not at all . And the only good thing In the suit it’s a nice and quite large bathroom.the next day at 6 AM noise was coming from downstairs since  number of gardeners were using the saw cutter and made lots of noise . Not the greatest experience  .

reviews.title: So basic! Here for business & quickly leaving. Won’t be back.
reviews.text: Here for business meetings being hosted in the hotel and stayed for convenience of location for early morning meetings. I feel like I landed on another planet. In no way the Vegas experience we are use to. No one to greet you when you arrive. I asked a security guard, “ where do I check in”,  and he just pointed down the hall. There is a bell desk but no eye contact or welcoming. You walk right into the casino which well it’s Vegas so that’s normal but it has no feeling of a hotel. The rooms; I’ve stayed in Sandman’s that are way nicer. So basic. Bed is uncomfortable. Grout in bathroom looks dirty. No coffee in room. Arrived at about 9pm and walked around trying to find something to eat. Aside from the buffet it’s like a mall food court. There is a bbq and a steak house that perhaps we will look at tonight but they were empty and did not look inviting. We also took a walk to check out where the meeting rooms are located to meet up in the morning. My husband walked through two sets of open doors to read the screen with all the meeting times and rooms on it. A security guard sitting up in his podium started whistling and yelling at me. I actually looked behind me thinking he must be yelling at someone else. He kept whistling and yelling so I asked..,”are you talking to me!?” He said yes we had to get out of the ballroom entrance. I told him with are here for a business summit and reading the  board. At that point he gave me a thumbs up. No class at all! I felt like he was a prison guard. The vibe here is an affordable place to stay if you are simply wanting to play slots and smoke! Very smoky in the casino. Not my vibe at all. We booked the Bellagio for the remainder of the week and I am so grateful I went with my gut on that. Palms is too far from the strip as well. We will not be back. The board room set up was good for our business part of the trip but if it’s hosted here again we will stay offsite.

reviews.title: Ellein Lam is the best host
reviews.text: Ellein Lam is the best host she is always very prompt and always very helpful Me and my wife are very happy with her service she always responds to our requests properly She makes it a pleasure to stay at the Palms We are so happy with everything especially with Ellein that we go there almost every month We also recommend the Palms to all our family and friends Shan Hacco

reviews.title: The best Casino in Las Vegas
reviews.text: The Palms is one of my preferred destinations in Las Vegas. The main reason why I choose The Palms is because of the staff, everyone is so friendly and accommodating. My casino host Elaine Lam , does such a tremendous job. She is always on top of things and making sure that we have a great time while on property. Also while I am away, she is constantly contacting me with upcoming events and fun things going on to plan future return visits.She is truly an asset and a big reason why I go to The Palms all the times for our Vegas vacations also Shirley at the rewards center always very polite and professional, Kenny in the cafe always happy he make the whole place happy even when he is not are server we enjoy our meals  Thumbs up for this stuff 👍👍👍👍👍

reviews.title: Great expierence at The Cafe with Larry
reviews.text: We arrived at The Palms from a horrible plane ride in.  We want to the cafe at the bar and the bartender Larry turned our trip around. He was funny so personable and gave us directions around Las Vegas and great places to eat at The Palms.Food and drinks excellent as well.Cheers,John, Wendy, Al and Chris.

reviews.title: Exceptional First Experience at Palms.
reviews.text: Oscar at the front desk was amazing! Great room, spotless! Beautiful casino, excellent food at Mabel's and the café. Love the free parking, love the off strip location, love the whole place! We came one night to gamble and check the place out. We loved it so much that we moved the rest of our stay to the Palms. Give this place a try.

reviews.title: Fantastic employee
reviews.text: Sarah Alcantara is the best housekeeping person in maintaining the cleanliness of my room. She is very meticulous in maintaining the tidiness and comfort of the room guests.  She's also courteous, kind and respectful to the guest. She goes beyond  the call of work to please her guests.

reviews.title: Exemplary service to its finest...
reviews.text: I visited club Serrano and was greeted by one of their amazing employees Gina Aragunez....She took the extra time to make sure my issue was resolved for my Super bowl big game party...I was elated and will definitely return ...Always incredible...

reviews.title: The best, the staff, specially the room cleaner, Sara. The worst the expensive it is.
reviews.text: Very expensive and with added costs for everything. For example, they charged us $27 for putting a small bottle of water in the room's refrigerator. A theft.However, the staff, especially our room cleaner, Sara, were delightfully helpful and did her job very well. The room was very clean and all the details were well taken care of.

reviews.title: Special Guest stay.
reviews.text: Kevin Glass and Alexis @ VIP.  We Thank you for you kindness and patience and for making me a Special guest with and unexpected upgrade. You made our stay so special. We can't thank you enough. We hope we see you soon.All the best to you, for a great experience with Palms.

reviews.title: Best Bartender
reviews.text: Tracey at the West bar was the best bartender I’ve had in Vegas .  Amazing service, great to talk to and a huge asset to the Palms.  I sat down and was immediately greeted and treated like a regular and not just a tourist passing through.  Rare to find such great service in Vegas anymore

reviews.title: Reasonably priced.
reviews.text: Stayed here for a conference and the rooms are very nice. The conference center is large and they provided good food and service for our group.  The casino has some reasonable limit options. It's off-strip and walking over isn't really an option given how busy the street is, but other than that - nice hotel, reasonably priced, with good service, so I would stay there again.

reviews.title: Bed Mattresses are worn out.  Time for a refresh of the beds
reviews.text: Our company conducts client meetings in Las Vegas every year.  This year we rotated through the Palms and I have to say this was some of the best food provided at each meal.  Very good attention to detail in preparation and staff were always courteous and friendly.Few opportunities for improvement though.  The beds are terrible and not comfortable.  They are dished out with a hump in the middle of the mattresses.  Stayed here the past two weeks and both rooms had the same issue.  Also the curtain and curtain pull in my room was unattached at the top of the curtain and I could not get total darkness in the room at night.  This is a problem when the adjacent tower is shining neon lights all night.Upon checking into the room this past week i walk into the bathroom and find the key card holder for the last guest who was in here.  More attention to detail needed in room servicing.  Makes me wonder what else was missed or not cleaned up.You really need to place a lamp on the desk.  I could not use my computer to book reservations as it was too dimly lit to see keyboard.  Had to open the curtains all the way open to let in light to see my way around the room.Little things here but they add up when I can't get a good night of rest or complete a few simple tasks like looking at email on laptop before going down to gamble.

reviews.title: No Coffee, and rude security staff.
reviews.text: This is the first hotel I've been to that didn't have coffee in the rooms - no coffee maker either.  So I go down to the cafe in the morning to get coffee and the lady at the counter says that she can get it, but I'll have to wait to pay.  So she makes it and it's sitting on the other side of the counter, but then she goes into the back and nobody's there!  There are 8 other people also waiting to pay, and no one behind the counter, so 10 minutes later I walk into the cafe to see if I can find someone and a security guy (with an earpiece)  yells "Back away sir!!!"  Mind you, I wasn't behind the counter or in the back, I was just near the entry to the back but still on the right side of the counter.  I explain that I just wanted to find out how long I was supposed to stand there and he again yells "Back away!!!".  I told him he was an idiot and walked out without my coffee.  So, IF YOU DRINK COFFEE, DON'T STAY AT THIS HOTEL!

reviews.title: Great last minute trip
reviews.text: Had a last minute trip. Hotel staff was amazing! Took care of all needs and made suggestions to make the trip so much easier. Room was comfortable and check-in was quick and easy.  Dinner at Mabel’s was set up for us and it was delicious. Will return many times!

reviews.title: Cash machine
reviews.text: Factory hotel, no consideration for customers.No bottle of water in the room, no mini bar, the floor dispensers are all empty or “out of order”When I talk to reception about it, they tell me there’s nothing we can do 🤷‍♀️

reviews.title: Won't be back !!!
reviews.text: Ok, so I'm not trying to be a grumpy ole man, but after a 3 hour trip, I arrived at the Palm via self parking and was informed I was at the wrong check-in location, no worries, I needed the walk after sitting for 3 hours behind the wheel. So after checking in and walking into my room, I noticed a strange oder which smelt like cigarette smoke.  Ok, no biggie, I'm tired lets keep it moving. While in the bathroom I noticed spots (Stains) on the floor, soooo at this point I was like, ok let me check the other areas in the room, hmmm, it appears nothing was cleaned properly.
