So I called house keeping and asked if I could get some wipes or something to clean the room with, she stated they didn't have anything BUT I can purchase wipes from the shop in the lobby. Soooo, I went to Walgreen and purchased alcohol wipes and lysol spray to do a once over. Now the room smells and feels fresh. If I could check out tomorrow I would BUT this was paid via reward points. I'm not here to stay in my room but when I do I would like to feel like I'm sleeping in a clean space. The Palm has missed the mark, for me !!! won't be back !!!

reviews.title: BAO PIT BOSS IS A GOOD MAN THANK YOU SIR
reviews.text: Bao, floor pit boss wonderful guy. he has excellent personality and good energy. Bao thank you for taking care of the casino floor. we need more pit bosses like you ! Bao always make sure everybody is having a good time.  May more blessings come your way

reviews.title: Shout Out to Alexis
reviews.text: Walked in VIP check-in room around 5pm and was charmingly greeted by Alexis.  Her beautiful bright smile warmed the chilly Vegas evening.  Professionally handling all check-in processes, she asked if she could be of more service and provided helpful information about the the Lounge and direction to the tower elevator.  Want to shout out to Alexis as that short check-in really lights up my evening.

reviews.title: The best casino in Vegas by far
reviews.text: Once again another great experience at the Palms Casino. Avoid the strip and come here instead, it’s the best casino in town. The Tonic Bar by the sportsbook is the best. I visited the best bartender in town Tracey Lall again, she is amazing and always makes you feel at home. This place is the best, I highly recommend it and ask for Tracey if she is working. Another great experience at The Palms, this casino is by far the cream of the crop. Thanks again Tracey!!!

reviews.title: Palms review
reviews.text: Safe to say I’ve spent a considerable amount of time at almost every casino in Vegas at this point. With that said, Palms casino/resort is easily my favorite. Enormous shoutout to Bao, the most welcoming Pitt boss I have gambled with. He will make sure you have a great time!

reviews.title: Always have a great time!
reviews.text: Love the hotel’s environment. We have been returning customer’s for over a year. Shout out to Fahima at the black jack tables that taught me much and now I enjoy playing the game. We also love how clean the place is.

reviews.title: Adeye was amazing!
reviews.text: Stayed at the Palms for a conference. While I was playing at the craps table, Adeye was my cocktail waitress. She was amazing! Friendly, good energy, and super attentive. She’s probably been the best cocktail waitress I’ve had since going to Vegas, and I’ve been many times. Kudos to you Adeye! Thank you!

reviews.title: Excellent place, many restaurants inside and around, good buffet, very nice and clean rooms @100% the best.
reviews.text: Excellent place, many restaurants inside and around, good buffet, very nice and clean rooms @100% the best.

reviews.title: Erno
reviews.text: The Palms is one of my preferred destinations in Las Vegas. The main reason why I choose The Palms is because of the staff, everyone is so friendly and accommodating. My casino Host, Erno, does such a tremendous job. He is always on top of things and making sure that I have a great time while on property. Also while I am away, he is constantly contacting me with upcoming events and fun things going on to plan future return visits. He is truly an asset and a big reason why I go to The Palms over other resorts.

reviews.title: Erno Mabini is an outstanding casino host, very responsive.
reviews.text: I was playing at the Palms Casino in Las Vegas, NV, during Thanksgiving week, and I was assigned to a new casino host, Erno Mabini. Erno is a nice, easy-going fellow who is courteous and professional. Erno is very responsive when you need to book a room reservation or a special event. I was staying at the Fantasy Suite, and Erno VIP team members reached out to me to see if I needed to change rooms because of the moderate musky smell. I have had several casino hosts throughout the years, and so far, Erno and his team members are doing a great job ensuring guest satisfaction and a more enjoyable experience in Las Vegas, NV. If you’re a Yaamava club Serrano avid gamer that is racking up a lot of points, I suggest you get in touch with Erno, and he can make your trip to Las Vegas more enjoyable. Also here at the Palms Casino, they offer free parking, and you're less than 5 to 10 minutes away from one of the best restaurant eateries near China Town.

reviews.title: Scotch 80
reviews.text: I went to Scotch 80 with my wife and friends without disappointment. The atmosphere is perfect for a steak house and the food is amazing. The Scotch 80 burger is one of the best tasting burgers I've ever had.

reviews.title: My amazing new years stay at the palms with the best help from Ella
reviews.text: My experience here at the palms casino resort is wonderful . Ella was so helpful and thoughtful, she made sure I got the greatest customer service the palms could give me im thankful for her she is the best …thank you for everything Ella I will definitely be coming back and bringing my family and friends

reviews.title: ERNO … The Outstanding Palms Host
reviews.text: We’re celebrating my Mother’s 90th birthday and I called Mr. Erno for reservation, and he didn’t fail me. Palms hotel is meticulously clean with outstanding amenities. AYCE lobster Buffett is incomparable, the  best in Vegas. Spacious casino floor. The outstanding accommodation by Erno was truly exceptional. He made our home away from home!

reviews.title: Good time at palms
reviews.text: Recently went to see ClayWalker,after having dinner at the buffet with friends.Great show.All the people at Palms were very courteous. Didnt do to bad in the casino either.Great entertainment, will be back .Randall&Sheree H

reviews.title: Erno
reviews.text: The Palms is the greatest and made all the better by my AWESOME host Erno!  From the fun atmosphere to the great restaurants to the unique experiences they offer, it's become my go-to place for fun in Vegas.  Can't recommend enough, and a LOT of that is thanks to Erno!

reviews.title: Outstanding services & The best executive host: Erno
reviews.text: Love Palms! The range of amenities offered at the casino hotel was impressive. The facilities, coupled with the amazing service provided by the attentive staff, especial the executive host Erno, made my visit truly exceptional. His professionalism, attention to detail & genuine care for ensuring an enjoyable experience were truly remarkable. I wholeheartedly recommend Erno to anyone seeking a top-notch VIP experience. Easy parking, easy check in/out, the dining options were outstanding such as lobster buffet, steakhouse, Chinese Dim Sum..Strongly recommend!!

reviews.title: Holiday travel
reviews.text: My stay during the holiday at  Palms Casino and Hotel was made possible by  Casino Host Erno who made the stay fun and enjoyable for my family and I. Between the excellent food and exciting games there was something for everyone to enjoy.

reviews.title: The room is big and clean, the service is very good
reviews.text: We checked in on Christmas Day and the room was not ready when we checked in. Alexis told us there would be a 1-2 hour wait but soon she told me she would upgrade us to a penthouse and the room was very clean. Already prepared. The room is huge. It was clean and we enjoyed our stay. Alexis is very friendly and kind. It was a very busy day but Alexis still provided a very good service. Thank you Alexis.

reviews.title: Great customer service.
reviews.text: Rich at the front desk was great.  We haven't come across too many kind people lately on our trip.  He checked us in and gave great instructions on parking and finding our room.  Great customer service.  Our room was great, it was bigger than we expected.  Rooms are clean and quiet.

reviews.title: Best cocktail service in Vegas.
reviews.text: Great hotel, resort, casino.I had the best cocktail experience at Palms. Yara is the best cocktail waitress I've had the pleasure to order a drink from. Not was she very timely with the drinks but she had the best attitude of service. I ALMOST didn't mind losing as I had a great time. LOL. Thanks to Yara.

reviews.title: Very impressed
reviews.text: My sister and thought we would take advantage of a Vegas trip over the weekend since we both had free rooms. Since we are both diamond members. We were escorted to the VIP check-in  lounge (very impressed), where we were greeted by Alexis. She was very personable, made us feel welcome, but most of all made us feel like we were VIPs. Check-in was very easy quick and painless. Lastly, they had cookies , coffee, tea, soda, water for your liking, while you’re here staying at the Palms Casino Resort.Thank you Palms Casino Resort /Yaamava Casino for making our trip that much more special for the holidays.

reviews.title: Best Employees at checkin
reviews.text: Checking in at the VIP LOUNGE was a breeze with employees like ALEXIS & DESI.They always have a Smile on their face & are happy to help.They make check-in at the PALMS a HAPPY occasion.Great Customer Service.! Please give them a raise!!

reviews.title: Top favorite hotel
reviews.text: Rean was so helpful with check in process, it was quick and easy. He was very efficient. The hotel itself is very clean and nice smelling. Not crowded and the floors are sparkling clean. So is the room, it’s clean and reasonably spacious. Lots of dining choices. I’ve been here a few times. And each time has always been a pleasant experience.

reviews.title: Great vibe and fantastic staff
reviews.text: Our cocktail server, Marinne, was fantastic! Even when we weren't winning at slots, she made sure we were having fun and enjoying ourselves. The casino had a good vibe, and it smelled wonderful. We will stay here in the future.

reviews.title: Great Stay at Palms Las Vegas!
reviews.text: I booked a room for one night during a December weekday and wow they put me on the 53rd floor of the Ivory Tower. The view was spectacular. The room was very comfy. I love the high ceilings and modern decor. Clean and secure. The A.Y.C.E. ("Ace") Buffet was excellent. The Casino was alive with great slots. All the latest games. I joined the Serrano Club for free and won freeplay, a dining voucher, and a travel bag. Lots of fun!

reviews.title: Dealer
reviews.text: Was  at the palms last night experience the worst services ever will not be going back . I had the black jack table me and guy we loosing the dealer Efren going to say what about the dealer when we won 2 hands . Smh soliciting all night saying no tip and we was even winning shift manger did nothing want be going again if I do want play the tables

reviews.title: Another Fabulous Stay
reviews.text: Another great stay at Palms Las Vegas. I stayed Nov 29 to Dec 3 in the Fantasy Tower. The Fantasy Tower rooms are beautifully decorated and comfortably appointed. The dining options at Palms are varied and fantastic. Even the more casual option, Serrano Vista is fabulous. The staff at Palms stand out as the stars of the resort. Every staff member I encountered was friendly and helpful. A special shout out to Gayla, server at Serrano Vista. Gayla is always a delight and I look forward to seeing her during our stays. Another special shout out to the fabulous bartenders at Tonic, Kim, Tracey, Eli, Danny, Ari. The Tonic bartenders make guests feel welcome and are the friendliest!  I missed seeing Omar and JoJo this trip. The downside was the most abysmal luck I have ever had in a casino…..nothing was paying and I honestly didn’t hear many big wins happening.  It would be great if the strip shuttle was brought back. Uber serves the purpose though.

reviews.title: Bedbugs
reviews.text: This hotel has bedbugs. I stayed in the fantasy tower 35th floor this past weekend 11/30-12/2 and woke up with tons of bedbug bites and actually saw a couple of the bugs crawling on my bed. Although they switched my room swiftly no one apologized or showed concerned nor offered a full refund. Don’t stay here.

reviews.title: RED FROM THE PALMS IS AMAZING
reviews.text: RED from the bar downs stairs was beyond amazing. We are from Australia And it was shocking to us how rude American people were. Because every interaction we have had people have been so rude for no reason and act like they hate their lives. But red from the bar at the palms was so so refreshing and sweet. So obsessed with her. Please give her a raise :)

reviews.title: Never again.
reviews.text: I will never again spend a dollar here or attend a work conference (at the negative cost to the conference) at this selfish property. I have been to Vegas easily over 30 times and this is the worst resort, by far. Unfortunately, the hotel cares only about profit and not the customer. I attended a multi-day work conference. Unbeknownst to attendees, and I believe schedulers, a live event was scheduled on the property. The event was live until 2am with no warning while the entire east side of the building was reverberating with bass, sound, and noise for hours on end, at the sacrifice of every other hotel occupant. Really pathetic. Never again.

reviews.title: Expect your room to sound like you are standing next to a DJ’s speaker until 2 am.
reviews.text: I understand hotels have noise in Las Vegas. But a loud DJ lead party at the pool has been going on for the last three hours. It is now one am and the front desk told me it will not end until 2 am. I feel like the speakers are in our room. Front desk said they could do nothing and neither could security. Do not come here if you expect any semblance of sleep. Some visitors to Vegas are here for important meetings or events and were hoping for a good night sleep.

reviews.title: Great venue
reviews.text: Very enjoyable stay, Room was big clean and great night sleep , staff all around the hotel were very good , from the time we arrived and checked in until we left , we were treated great , Would reccomend a stay here ..  Free parking too which was a plus .

reviews.title: ERNO MABINI, MY CASINO HOST
reviews.text: My stay at Palms in Las Vegas is extra fun and truly enjoyable because of my very efficient, personable, prompt, warm and friendly casino host, ERNO MABINI!! Thank you so much ERNO for immediately taking care of my needs whenever I stay at your beautiful casino!  Service is SUPER EXCELLENT!  Hats off to you ERNO!! More power to you and Palms❤️

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: This is my first time staying off the Strip. A few of us from our company stayed and attended a training session here. First, the hotel room was great. I stayed in the Ivory Tower room. The room was large. It was clean. I ordered room service which was good. I also ustilized the Bell desk and they were friendly and helpful. All of the staff throughout all areas in the hotel, from check in to the food court and the bars, were friendly. There are a good amount of slots to keep one busy. There were many nice sit down restaurants, but i did not get a chance to try them. There are many bar options. Go to the top floors for excellent views of the Strip. The meeting dacilities were nice and there were other sessions going on at the same time. They provided refreshments and drinks throughout the work sessions. I would like to give the hotel another chance during vacation time.

reviews.title: Excellent stay!
reviews.text: My daughter and I had a great weekend at the Palms.  Excellent service started as soon as we checked in with Alexis with VIP service.  We later met up with the host Johnny Kincaid who made our trip more memorable.  The BBQ at Mabel’s was so delicious.  We had the best server-Jenna!  The food at Send Noodles was mediocre.  We stayed in room 27226-bed and linen was fluffy and luxurious - had the best sleep.  There was some dirty spots in the sink and the floor near the toilet.

reviews.title: Good food and service
reviews.text: Serrano Vista restaurant has simple and yet good food. The service is great. More recently I had Brandon Pixter as a server cool personality, attentive and nicely packaged my leftovers to go. Overall palms is a cool vibe.

reviews.title: Serrano Cafe @ Palms Casino
reviews.text: My dining experience is and has always been exceptional at the Serrano Cafe.And bartenders/ servers like June have gone above & beyond their responsibilities towards customers like me.June is personable and is always motivated to ensure your dining experience is the best that it can be.Locals and tourists should include the Serrano Cafe on their list of restaurants when visiting Sin City.John ForbesLas Vegas, NVResident for 25 awesome years!

reviews.title: Check out this hotel for your next trip to Las Vegas
reviews.text: We stayed here for a birthday celebration. From the time we drove in to the valet parking area to the time we left, we had an excellent time. Free valet parking or free self service parking if you want. Great selection of food, lots of different types of gambling options. Swimming pools a big movie theatre (for when you’re not winning). Very clean hotel and friendly staff everywhere. Off the main strip , which has been very overpriced since Covid. We also caught a cult concert, that was excellent. They have a extremely large buffet and everything was great. We stayed in a king fantasy suite on the 28th floor, great views. Would definitely recommend checking out this place. Will stay here again next trip.

reviews.title: Check in service
reviews.text: Oscar helped us check in and when I said he helped he helped. He was so friendly and kind and helpful. We asked him questions about Vegas and directed us to the right place he even told us to find a host that can help us more. Oscar you rock!!!

reviews.title: Ms. Gayla at the Serrano Vista Cafe Outstanding Service
reviews.text: Ms. Gayla at the Serrano Vista Cafe was and is the BEST waitress we ever had. She interacted with us throughout the entire time explaining our order and her interaction with our sister who has mental retardation was priceless!!! She is an asset to the Palms and should be commended for her professionalism!!!!

reviews.title: Lack of accountability and disregard for guest safety is UNACCEPTABLE
reviews.text: I am deeply disappointed with my experience at the Palms Resort and Casino. My friends and I stayed at this establishment from Wednesday to Sunday in a standard double Queen bedroom. While the weather was beautiful and we enjoyed our time by the pool, the incident that occurred during our stay has left a sour taste in my mouth.In an attempt to avoid carrying all my belongings to the pool, I made the unfortunate decision to leave my wallet in my suitcase in the room. Little did I know that this would be a grave mistake. Upon returning to the room on Friday to get ready for the night, I discovered that my wallet had been tampered with. Shockingly, $200 bills and one of my credit cards were missing. It was evident that someone had entered the room and stolen these items from my suitcase.Disturbed by this violation, I immediately checked my credit card app and found that unauthorized charges totaling close to $500 had already been made. I promptly disabled my credit card to prevent further misuse. Seeking assistance, I reported the incident to the front desk, but to my dismay, they did not escalate the matter to the manager. Instead, I was directed to speak with security and asked to fill out an incident report.Throughout my stay, I diligently followed up with security, hoping for some resolution. However, when I checked out on Sunday, I was informed that I would be contacted within 24 to 72 hours. Regrettably, no one reached out to me during this time. After two days of silence, I took the initiative to call them myself, only to be told that nothing would be done about the situation. Security claimed to have reviewed the surveillance footage, but conveniently found no suspicious activity in the hallway. Well, of course, there wouldn't be any activity in the hallway when my belongings were stolen from inside the room!Furthermore, I must express my utter disbelief at the treatment I received from the security personnel at the Palms Resort and Casino. In addition to the distress caused by the theft, I was subjected to unnecessary questioning regarding the possibility of me misplacing the missing credit card myself. This insinuation was not only insulting but also completely unfounded. As a guest, I expected to be treated with respect and empathy, not met with baseless accusations.It is disheartening to see that the Palms Resort and Casino not only failed to address the theft adequately but also attempted to shift the blame onto me. This level of unprofessionalism and lack of accountability is simply unacceptable. I implore anyone considering a stay at this establishment to think twice before entrusting their belongings and personal safety to a resort that displays such disregard for its guests.To add insult to injury, I was informed that according to Nevada law, the hotel is not obligated to return lost or stolen items. This revelation is deeply concerning and raises serious doubts about the security measures in place at this resort. I urge anyone considering a stay at the Palms Resort and Casino to exercise extreme caution. It is evident that they currently have a thief on their staff, and the hotel management seems unwilling to take any action to rectify the situation.I cannot stress enough how disappointed I am with the Palms Resort and Casino. I will never be staying at this establishment again, and I strongly advise others to think twice before booking a room here. The lack of accountability and disregard for guest safety is simply unacceptable.

reviews.title: Erno Mabini
reviews.text: Erno my host is super awesome. Great customer care and attention to details so I can enjoy my stay and the amenities the casino/hotel has to offer. The food is amazing at the buffet. The hotel is clean. The room is super nice. My niece loved it as well.

reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: Mary Ann on the casino floor just out from the box office made a special day out of ordinary. Her attentiveness was perfect, her drinks were tasty and she kept me feeling cared for. It's a tough job to perform at her level due to so many people and their individual needs but she gets 5 Stars from me! Thank you!!!

reviews.title: A little bit of Heaven☁️
reviews.text: I just love it here!!Rooms are great sizes. The beds Definitely felt like Heaven. Slept like a baby & I'm a light sleeper lol They have a lot of varieties of restaurants, & a great selection at the food court. Not to mention the movie theater if you want to catch the latest flick.Love the atmosphere in the Casino. Also has different varieties of games. Love that they still have a little section of old school slots.Close enough to the strip but far enough away to enjoy it from afar. Not to mention great views in all the rooms we've stayed in of the strip.Overall, I've just always loved the vibe at the Palms. I consider it one of my homes away from home✨️

reviews.title: Wonderful stay at the palms
reviews.text: Our room at the palms was wonderful! Great view of the vegas Valley. We had 2 comfortable beds. The room was bright & airy with a high ceiling. The bathroom was spacious. The only disappointment was the shower head. There was hardly any pressure. The shower head looked as tho there were lime deposits. Also,  there were 3 of us & only 1 glass. But the casino is big with large selection of games. We ate at the Serrano Vista Cafe for breakfast both mornings. The food was wonderful as was the service.

reviews.title: Erno Mabini a great host!
reviews.text: Palm Casino Resort is one of my favorite casinos in Vegas. I love the appearance, the restaurants and the people. My casino host Erno Mabini is wonderful. He provides me with personalized experience and makes my stay more enjoyable. It is always good to have a host who is reliable, helpful and caring. Erno is someone who takes good care of every guest.

reviews.title: Palms!
reviews.text: We stayed here for two nights in June during our tour of California and Nevada, as we were getting married at The Little Church of the West. Having never been to Vegas/the States before we were amazed by how huge and slick the hotel was. It was very busy but we checked in and out with ease. Not sure about other Vegas hotels but there was free parking. We had a king room in the Ivory Tower. Great view, very spacious, lots of amenities, very clean and a great bathroom. While it’s off the strip, it’s in a good location and a short taxi ride to the strip. Having a 24/7 McDonalds downstairs was amazing… having a breakfast McMuffin while I did my wedding makeup was great. Sadly didn’t get to check out any of the restaurants/pool due to our short stay. I can’t comment on the gambling as believe it or not, we don’t gamble haha. Loved it though! Recommend!

reviews.title: Marvelous!
reviews.text: I stayed at this hotel in Las Vegas and was very happy. Clean, elegant with a nice mess. The suite was large with a view of the entire city. Really amazing! The only thing to consider are the taxes you have to pay for your stay

reviews.title: Amazing housekeeping
reviews.text: I was staying at the Palms , I love it!  Sarah Alcantara’s my house keeping lady who’s even also made my trip wonderful, knowing this was a business trip. She was beyond amazing throughout the entire trip. She kept my room nice & squeaky clean everyday for my 7 day trip. Please request for her she’s the best. 🙏🏽❤️

reviews.title: Penthouse experience
reviews.text: Rich at Registration was so kind by letting me stay in the Penthouse for a night because I told him I had a horrible Uber driver. It was an incredible experience! I even had a butler who came by to check on me.

reviews.title: Extremely loud music kept up awake.
reviews.text: We stayed 3 nights.  On the second night extremely  loud music blaring from the pool area was too loud to sleep and the hotel was of no help.  They just let the music continue until the party was over.  On the third night the same thing and the music did not stop until 1 am.  Terrible experience.  And management was of no help.

reviews.title: Rosita is the BEST
reviews.text: My first time visiting the casino. I went to the rewards station to get a players card. Rosita helped… my goodness! She is the best, we joked and laughed. She explained how to use it and wished me GL!

reviews.title: Rosita is Awesome
reviews.text: Rosita was the best person here!!! Like if she’s not helping you you’re probably not getting good help. She is AMAZING!!! 10/10 highly recommend. Definitely would come back just to see her. She was professional and funny!!!

reviews.title: Best Bartender in Town!
reviews.text: If you are visiting The Palms Casino in Las Vegas you have to go visit the best bartender in town, Tracey Lall.  She is amazing and has the best personality ever, by far the best bartender I've ever met in my life!!! She works at the Tonic Bar by the Sportsbook and also works at the West Bar sometimes which is by the escalators.  She is great, always fun to be with and talk to, I love coming here to see her when she is working.  So make sure to ask if Tracey is working when you go visit the bars at this casino, she is the best!

reviews.title: Great Cafe experience
reviews.text: First night at the Palms Casino resort and we went to the Serrano Vista Café for quick bite. Gayla was our server, and I have not seen such great customer service in Las Vegas in a very long time. She was fast, friendly, very upbeat, and lots of fun. Very professional and we will return again and again. thank you Gayla

reviews.title: Smooth check in
reviews.text: Oscar has been a great help and a very funny man! Thank you for helping us have a better experience at the resort! We re still at the hotel and can’t wait to see what other experiences we’ll have here!

reviews.title: Ask for Gayla
reviews.text: 5 friends went to the Serrano Vista Cafe for lunch & our Server was GAYLA.  She thought of everything to make our meal a very delicious & happy experience.   I will request her the next time we go back to The Palms.

reviews.title: Gayla was a FANTASTIC Waitress!
reviews.text: Had dinner at Serrano Vista Cafe in the Palms Casino in Las Vegas. Gayla was our Waitress. She was was WONDERFUL!  Before we could ask for anything, she had it at the table. She has a great and engaging personality. She made the dinner a fun experience. Can’t want to go back again!!

reviews.title: Great Service
reviews.text: Good food, great service!Gayla at the Serrano Vista Cafe was amazing. Our service was superb, and kept us coming back for several meals during our stay. Highly recommended during your stay there at the Palms.

reviews.title: Pleasant Stay At The Palms
reviews.text: We stayed at the Palms to see the Yachtley Crew show which was fantastic fun. Even the cheaper Ivory tower rooms were perfectly fine and comfortable. We did a limited tour of the casino which was fairly smokey.We had a good casual dinner in the Serrano Vista cafe. The food was a good value, but the service by the ever popular Gayla made our experience memorable.

reviews.title: They'd Rather Snub You Than Serve You
reviews.text: My husband and I are locals who used to enjoy visiting this hotel.  However, with the new ownership at the Serrano Cafe, we won't be going back to The Palms any time soon.To our shock and surprise, when we approached the hostess at the Serrano, she refused to seat us!  She said there were no tables available.  When I pointed out the place was half empty, she said, "Those tables are all reserved for other people."  Really?  So where are all these people?  Then she showed me her reservation sheet--and there wasn't a name on it!We had no choice but to leave, but I don't see how a hotel can operate when the breakfast cafe's motto is:  WE'D RATHER SNUB YOU THAN SEAT YOU!

reviews.title: Unscrupulous billing practice
reviews.text: I rented a room on 10/1 from the Palms for a friend. Checkout was 10/2. I put a deposit on the room for $100. I paid for a suite upgrade. After checkout, I was supposed to receive a refund of $95. Instead they charged me for the deposit, the upgrade and an additional $88. When we called to complain, they reversed all of the charges. Then 2 days later they charged me again for the upgrade and charges not made during the visit. I went up to the hotel and spoke to a manager. He informed me that my friend who stays there weekly had charges from August that were outstanding. So they just transferred them to my card for payment. I told him that that was not my problem. I only authorized the October charge. I asked them how come they didn't say there was an outstanding balance in over 2 months. He said they tried reaching him and couldn't. This was obviously a lie since he stays there every week while here on business. They couldn't tell for two months that there were charges. The manager told me that the charges will stand because I didn't specifically say that I only authorize the October charges. Why would I say that when they didn't provide information related to outstanding charges? They didn't care whose card was on file. They were going to charge it. The manager ended up being rude. I warn everyone who reads this, they are thieves and will charge whatever they want to your card and not care. Now I have to waste time contacting my bank to dispute the charges that I was never informed of prior to giving them my card information.

reviews.title: Stay away
reviews.text: Was not a pleasant experience. The main pool was closed for the 4 days during our stay. Charity event, so the the pool, in the building palms place, not the casino hotel, had no place to sit, even along the pool edge. Small pool with horrible pool service for drinks and food. Had to get my own. No place to sit poolside on one day of our stay. My wife and me went to Vegas for a Friday and Saturday night shows. Thursday night was our bar night. Left on Sunday. Upon checking out I asked for a reduced rate, due to the whole pool area was closed. I explained to him, we didn’t come to gamble, but relax by the pool and enjoy the shows and nightlife. He told me no, with a smirk  on his face, stating it could of rained and you would have not been able to use the pool. Well it was 90 degrees and sunny everyday. Wow, it rains 15-20 days a year in Vegas. I guess all the families that come with kids, don’t use the pools, kids come to gamble. There was no posting stating the pool was closed prior to my booking. The staff was rude, except for the housekeeper. Wonderful young lady. On the last day, I went down to the casino level to get a coffee, and as I got to the elevator a security, asked me for my room key. I said to him, for the previous 3 days and nights nobody ever asked me for a room key. He then proceeded to point his finger and pound his hand on the podium showing me a sign that says security and I take my job seriously. Well, I’m 61 years old, in a tee shirt and gym shorts with a coffee, and you just saw me get off the elevator 10 minutes ago, to get my coffee. Do you really think I’m a threat. What about all the drunk people taking the elevator Thursday night, and nobody asked for proof of a room key. My wife was taking a shower, what if I left my key in the room. Would it be a 20 minute deal, to wait for my wife to answer the phone? The guy was a jerk. The young lady serving sandwiches in the food court was unfriendly to my wife.maybe they should hire people that give a crap and our professional. I would recommend staying on the strip , at one of the many happening hotels. We are very laid back people, and I don’t like to confrontation and usually let things go, but wow, what a crappy experience.

reviews.title: Great management saved our stay
reviews.text: My recent stay at the Palms Casino Resort in Las Vegas was nothing short of amazing, thanks in large part to the exceptional service provided by Assistant Manager Shenetha Fuller. Our three-day vacation started with a few hiccups, but Shenetha's dedication and professionalism truly salvaged our experience and made it unforgettable.From the moment we arrived, it was evident that the Palms Casino Resort was a top-notch establishment. The modern and luxurious ambiance of the hotel, coupled with the dazzling views of the Las Vegas Strip, set the perfect stage for an unforgettable vacation. However, it was Shenetha's personal touch that truly made our stay exceptional.Throughout our stay, Shenetha remained easily accessible, and it was clear that she was genuinely invested in ensuring our stay was perfect. She followed up with us regularly to make sure everything met our expectations, and she was always ready to assist with any questions or requests we had.

reviews.title: Monday Funday!
reviews.text: Came for an IMAX film, stayed for the fantastic eating options and a little bit of gaming! Ramon at the rewards counter was so friendly and amazing and I had a blast all around. Thanks for being a stellar spot for locals! I’ll be back again soon!

reviews.title: Had forgotten how nice the casino is...
reviews.text: Even though I had been back to Vegas, I hadn't been to Palms to gamble since the US summer of 2019 before Covid struck.  The bottom line feeling from my gambling focussed visit again this time was that I had forgotten how nice the casino actually is.  Palms is a nice light airy property inside, and in the public areas is not yet showing any signs of aging, since the large renovation that was previously conducted just  before my last visit.  As Arnie once said, "I'll be back".

reviews.title: Erno Mabini is the BEST!!
reviews.text: Erno Mabini is one of the best Casino Hosts out there. He always keeps me up to date with special events  going on at the casino, and invites me to all the tournaments and offers the best accommodations whether it’s food rooms or FreePlay. I am always invited to the best concerts. He was so much fun on my last visit during karaoke what a blast, can’t wait to go back. I wish they had great casino hosts like him at Yaamava but you can’t beat his service at the Palms.

reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.text: The buffet was awesome and our cocktail waitress in the casino, Adeye, was super friendly and very attentive. Adeye was always smiling and really put out a good vibe. I will definitely be coming back the next time I go play.

reviews.title: thank you Ramon!
reviews.text: had a lovely time. staff was super helpful and kind.  Ramon was particularly welcoming and made fabulous recommendations for me and my quirky, nerdy crew.  THANK YOU RAMON!! haha i don't know if he will see this, but he went above and beyond and added a lot of joy into our trip.

reviews.title: ERNO MABINI/HOST
reviews.text: My sister and I did a short trip to Vegas. From start to finish our host Erno made sure that our trip was stress free. From check in to check out was as smooth as silk! He even sent us an amenity treat to our room! We felt very special, and I, for one appreciate these gestures of kindness! Most places are too busy taking your money that they forget about the personal touches that keep people coming back. Erno Mabini is the PERFECT Slot Host in every sense of the word!! Thank You ERNO!!!💜

reviews.title: Much better than I expected
reviews.text: We were supposed to stay at a hotel downtown but they had issues and sent us to the Palms. I had never stayed here before but was surprisingly happy with the change. It was a busy weekend in Vegas but the resort never seemed overly crowded as the strip hotels often do. Pool was beautiful and relaxing. We had a couple issues with the charges (original hotel was to be billed) but Paige at the check-in desk was wonderful and took care of everything quickly and professionally. Food at the Cafe was very good and reasonably priced, too. Mushroom toast at Mabel's was delish!Will definitely return!

reviews.title: ERNO MABINI

I always enjoy my stay at the hotel and always gives best restaurants inside the Palms Hotel.  We always the karaoke party that he host at Laguna that is nothing to compare with other places. reviews.title: Mr Erno Mabini

reviews.title: Erno Mabini Host for Palms Casino &Hotel
reviews.text: Our trip was totally fun.  Erno is a great host, there in time, reminder text, and super pleasant personality made us feel totally welcome.  We will be back again.  We totally enjoy the property including the Pearl Theater for concert.  Thank you Erno.

reviews.title: Erno Mabini
reviews.text: We love our host at palms! Erno goes above and beyond when we visit! I recommend going to palms to eat at their restaurants. They also have nice clean rooms with free parking. Both in the garage and valet!

reviews.title: Highly Recommend!
reviews.text: Had an amazing time at this hotel! My favorite place was the cafe because my server Gayla was amazing and the bartender June made the best long islands I have ever had. Also the hotel has everything and you never have to leave if you don’t want to! Highly recommend!

reviews.title: stay at palms
reviews.text: Ernesto our host is one of the best in las Vegas he really took care of us.  Great restaurants there as well especially Tim Ho Wan.  Great speciaals on all of the restaurants and great service must place to try.

reviews.title: Excellent stay! Excellent staff!
reviews.text: We attended a small family trip for my mother's 65th birthday and just a lovely time! She loves to play the slot machines so this was a dream for her. Ramon at the rewards counter was amazing! So helpful! We enjoyed our trip very much.

reviews.title: Excellent Service
reviews.text: The trip was amazing! Everyone was so kind, especially Ramon behind the rewards counter. I couldn't have asked for better service and I couldnt have asked for a better time. We went as a cpuple and it was perfect.

reviews.title: Erno Mabini at the Palms Casino
reviews.text: There is such a fun vibe in the casino along with the very best casino host, Erno Mabini.  We love coming here for the gambling, the food, the entertainment, the pool and the atmosphere.  Erno makes it a pleasurable time every time! Just had the lobster night at AYCE for my birthday and it was yummy. Plus a handpay….what could be more fun! A big thank you to the Palms and Erno Mabini.

reviews.title: Amazing personalized treatment..
reviews.text: My wife and I absolutely love Palms we are Vegas locals, I lived at palms place for 5 years and wasn't sure how it was going to be. I love to gamble and usually go to the strip at first no one at Palms would match my status, Erno Mabini our host at Palms approached me and my wife and acknowledged our play and matched us immediately, since then we go at least once a week, and Erno always takes care of us, he got us into the lobster buffet last Wednesday and we ate so much we needed a nap mind you we live 5 miles away, Erno got us a room to take a nap lol this guy is amazing and I wouldn't trade him for another host anywhere. The new palms is amazing our home away from home. Thank all of you

reviews.title: Erno Mabini our amazing host!!
reviews.text: My husband and I just recently started going back to Palms we are local and usually gamble at Caesars Erno saw the way we play and matched our status, palms is once again our home casino in 15 years playing on the strip we have never had the personalized experience we get at Palms and it’s only because of Erno. Thank you so much for always taking care of us and Ben if it’s needing a room to nap after eating too much at the buffet. We love you guys.

reviews.title: Erno Mabini

reviews.title: Rewards

reviews.title: Erno Mabini is the goat

reviews.title: Great service

reviews.title: A great stay
reviews.text: Was passing through last week and decided to stop for a last minute day of R&R at the Palms. Wasnt going to be anything special, but Ramon made me feel right at home. I could have stayed the whole week. I will definitely be back!

reviews.title: Great visit!
reviews.text: I’ll definitely be coming back. A fantastic stay and so much fun for a girls trip! Ramon at the rewards counter was outstanding! He made our trip even more enjoyable. It was one of our best trip to the strip!

reviews.title: Ramon was amazing!

reviews.title: Would visit again!

reviews.title: The best

reviews.title: Great place with super Host and Offers

reviews.title: First time and surely not the last
reviews.text: First time and came in for some dessert and had the “banana tiramisu” a divine mixture of coffee and sweetness and eye catching presentation. Loved the atmosphere and cleanliness of the restaurant. My lovely waitress Gayla was so attentive and friendly will definitely be back :)

reviews.title: Palm Casino - Las Vegas
reviews.text: The Palm Casino is part of the Yamavah group.  If you like Las Vegas and are looking for a nice property NOT ON THE STRIP you might want to give the Palm a shot.It is well appointed.  The rooms are spacious and include lots of amenities you would expect from a top resort and casino.

reviews.title: Nice place for business conference
reviews.text: Nice rooms, but could use coffee maker. Housekeeping only comes when called but Luz Lopez showed up in minutes & took care of the room quickly & was so nice!Business center was also very helpful. Overall good place for a business conference!

reviews.title: Tracey Lall at the Tonic Bar is the best!! 🍹
reviews.text: Vegas is a wonderful place to visit!! 🎉Thank you Tracey Lall at the Tonic Bar for making it extra special!! You have an amazing smile and really know how to welcome your customers. You are appreciated!!🍹 Looking forward to seeing you again soon. Keep smiling!! 😘

reviews.title: Great customer service

reviews.title: Thank you to Tracey lall @ the Tonic Bar🥤
reviews.text: Tracey made our visit to the Palms casino Resort a fun & memorable time. Thank you Tracey for the delicious drinks, 🍹🍺🥤friendly smile and warm welcome at the Tonic Bar. Look forward to seeing her again soon. What a fun time.

reviews.title: comedy show
reviews.text: Took a trip here to see a comedy show  we stopped by the rewards center and ramon was very helpful not only did he help us with directions o our show he also let us know about all the perks of the rewards program i was shocked at how much they had to offer he was nice and very respectful i will be back for fun

reviews.title: Front desk service

reviews.title: Rosita at rewards center is the best!

reviews.title: Great place to spend an afternoon!

reviews.title: Best night out

reviews.title: Amazing service amazing fun

reviews.title: Serrano Vista Cafe

reviews.title: Birthday surprise

I used to go to Brendan for the IMAX years ago but hadn't been in since the pandemic but I wanted to watch Blue beetle "which was aweful by the way" and asked the people at the rewards where the theatre was.Veronica and her two counter people Rain and Ed told me it was behind the food court but they also signed me up and gave me a rewards card and even gave me free slot play! Well, they directed me to a kiosk to play a game where I won $40 for being my birthday month 😁.Will be coming back for some more movie nights!

reviews.title: Hanging at the sports bar with friends!
reviews.text: Im a local and I went to the sports bar with some friends to watch football and met Tracey!  Fun, incredibly friendly, recommended some interesting drinks and gave us an incredible experience!  Would come back just to visit with her!  Tell her thank you for being so friendly and making us feel welcome!

reviews.title: Sports bar

reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: Visiting for my birthday… had a great meal at Serrano Vista Cafe. Our waitress Gayla went above and beyond to give us a great dining experience. Had the t bone special… it was excellent!  Will for sure be visiting Gayla at Serrano Vista Cafe again soon during our stay

reviews.title: Great meal at the Serrano Vista Cafe
reviews.text: Gayla at the Serrano Vista Cafe was awesome! Super friendly and gave us a great suggestion! We had the brisket fried rice, and the poke nachos. Gayla was quick because we were trying to eat and head out to drive to LA.

reviews.title: Wonderful and memorable trip
reviews.text: Our host Erno made this trip very memorable for us. He was attentive and made sure our experience was an incredible one. Weve been to many hotels but this one was clean and fun. We are already planning the next trip and can't wait to be back!

reviews.title: Great to stay at Palms (Thanks to our host Erno Mabini). Always happy to stay at Palms
reviews.text: Our host Erno Mabini, made sure that we have good and fun time when we stayed at Palms. He is so professional and friendly person. Palms is the best casino to stay. Thanks Erno, you are the best!!!!!!

reviews.title: Palms host Erno Mabini
reviews.text: If you're planning a trip to  the Palms you should seek out Erno Mabini,top host and probably the best host you'll ever get anywhere.He's always letting you know of fun things to do at the Palms.He's a great guy and a real pro.You'll get the most out of your experience with Erno as your guide.

reviews.title: Great time
reviews.text: I been there with my family. We had amazing time. We really like this hotel, friendly stuff. Specially my host Erno Mabini, he’s a great host, we always appreciate him . He’s taking good care of us. 5 STAR to him 🙏

reviews.title: Great Customer Service
reviews.text: I signed up for a players card and was helped by a super helpful gentleman. His name was Ramon. I was looking for a bite to eat and he recommended Mabel's BBQ and the Stoner 2.0 burrito. Best burrito I ever had. But the real hero is Ramon. He was kind and very knowledgeable. I would have never checked Mabel's out if it weren't for him. Thank you Ramon!!

reviews.title: Can’t beat our host
reviews.text: Erno Mabino is a great host. He knows us and always checks in with us when we visit. He helps us with reservations and cares about us as people. Thank you to Erno for being a great host and friend. We also think the rooms are always nice and clean.

reviews.title: I'd give 10 Stars if I could...
reviews.text: We live in Cali, and stayed for my birthday in June. What happens in Vegas should stay in Vegas, but Ramon A. in the Guest Rewards Center really took care of us, and made my birthday all the more special. So our sitter flaked and we had the kiddos and had to change plans a bit. He was so friendly and very knowledgeable on all the things to do and see during our stay that was kiddo friendly. He saved our trip. We will definitely recommend. Everything was so clean and comfy. Totally going to do this at least once a year. We ended up having a blast!

reviews.title: Robert Plant in concert!
reviews.text: Love this casino! Everyone is so friendly and service was great. Rooms were clean, bed was so comfortable! I hated to leave. I most definitely will be back! The concert was amazing! The restrooms were beautiful and so clean. We had dinner one night at Scotch 80 Prime and were treated like royalty and the food was spectacular! This is our go to hotel when we come to Vegas. I’ve stayed at the Palms at least 6 times in the last few years. The price of rooms is very affordable as well.

reviews.title: Great recovery after a rocky start, thanks to Paige!
reviews.text: Initially, this stay was a complete flop - the room type I ‘reserved’ several weeks ago was apparently not set aside for my arrival and we ended up in a 2 bed room vs a king.  The room was dirty, missing several items and had used toiletries - not to mention hearing the elevator cables all night.  I decided to complain and, lucky for us, Paige was at the front desk.  She was able to completely change our experience and make sure that the remaining part of our trip was the best.  We got an upgraded room that exceeded our expectations.  Negative things can happen but it’s how a business recovers that makes a difference, in my opinion.  This was our first stay at the Palms and I had originally written it off as a place to not return to but  thanks to Paige, we will consider the Palms again.  The casino is great and clean!

reviews.title: Best Day Ever at the Best Hotel Ever!
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of staying at the Grand Corner Suite in the Fantasy Tower almost two weeks ago, I was accommodated by Paige in every way & she made my stay as seamless as possible, even with the heavy flow of people checking in due to the Beyoncé concert. Paige thoroughly communicated and made sure my needs were met the entire stay! Our room was exceptionally clean and every feature worked perfect. I ended up getting engaged and later found out Paige assisted my now fiancée in making sure decorations were properly set in place for the proposal. Easily one of the best days of my life!

reviews.title: We Love The PALMS
reviews.text: My experience in the Grand Corner Suite/Fantasy tower was more than exceptional. Paige met every need of mine from check-in to check-out. The room was clean and the view was breathtaking. The view outlooking the strip was amazing. Paige’s customer service was top tier, she was able to assist me in an elegant proposal to my now fiancée. I would definitely be booking at the Palms again and again!

reviews.title: Great place to stay in  Vegas
reviews.text: We stay in Palms almost every month. This time we celebrated my parents 50th anniversary at Palms. Great memories!!!We love everything about this hotel, nice and clean rooms, friendly staff. The pool is very fancy, they have very beautiful cabanas. We have a great host Erno Mabini, he always keeps us happy:)

reviews.title: Great host
reviews.text: I am so fortunate to have Erno as my host. He is amazing. So thoughtful, helpful, and available. I have had other casino hosts that I book rooms through that have never bothered to even meet me at other hotels- not Erno. Every time I am there he comes and talks to me and seeks me out. Simply the best. Thanks Erno Mabini!

reviews.title: Will always be my off strip place to stay!!!
reviews.text: Palms hotel is one of the best casino off strip that you want to stay to. Rooms are big with  comfy bed and pillows. We had an issue with the AC but they were prompt to fix it. The food is amazing, from the AYCE buffet, Serrano Cafe, Tim HoWan, Scotch 80, basically all their restaurants, has great choices of food!!! It’s a little bit pricey but you always get what you pay for. Erno Mabini, my host, super friendly, always go beyond to help guests and patrons. Always one txt away from his guests needs. Highly recommended place to stay and experience super Fun and safe stay in Vegas!!

reviews.title: Best host at Palms: Erno Mabini.
reviews.text: My host Erno Mabini arranged dinner for me and my nephew at Scotch 80. The restaurant was great. Erno, as always did a great job taking care of me like he does with all his customers. Erno is one of the best hosts in Las Vegas. I am glad I have him as my host.

reviews.title: Kudos to Palms - and host Erno Mabini!
reviews.text: Palms is great, made only that much better by my host Erno Mabini!  He's always there to help, provide exciting opportunities and just a great guy.  From simple restaurant reservations to some excellent and unique experiences, Erno has made it all happen and made me a loyal Palms customer!  And did I mention the theater?  What other hotel/casino in Vegas has an IMAX theater?  If you haven't been there, you should go.  Today.

reviews.title: Casino Host Erno Mabini
reviews.text: My Casino Host Erno Mabini is very accommodating and helpful he went above and beyond to ensure my comfort and satisfaction in all hotel accommodation and restaurant reservations and giving freebies as one of the VIP player of Palms Hotel and Casino.

reviews.title: Great host
reviews.text: Great restaurants and great employees especially our host Erno Mabini. Never had a host as attentive as Erno and we've been playing for over 50 yrs We're local so we know the resorts and we have been to most.

reviews.title: Wonderful stay at the Palms Casino Resort
reviews.text: The place was great, plenty of restaurants to choose from, lots and lots of slot machines, fast-food restaurants at the food court , movie theaters and FREE covered parking!!!!The room was well appointed, smelled fresh and very welcoming.The front desk person was so nice and resourceful.My host, Erno Mabini, was the best!  He made my stay a wonderful experience. He made sure that I was comfortable in my room and enjoyed my meals at the restaurants he comp me for my stay! He knows how to take care of his guests! He really makes you feel appreciated!Great fun place, excellent people, and the best host in Vegas, Erno Mabini!

reviews.title: Went to Tonic Bar every night!
reviews.text: Big shoutout to Danny at Tonic Bar! We went there every night to try different cocktails made by him. He really cares about his craft and his drinks are always so balanced.  Try the margarita, spicy margarita, Mexican candy shots— anything he recommends really!! We loved his drinks and service so much that we asked for his work schedule, to make sure we catch him next time we’re back.Also shoutout to Jeff who we met one night - we jokingly had a margarita showdown between Danny and Jeff and it was hilarious! Jeff’s margaritas are delicious too!

reviews.title: great vibe and restaurants
reviews.text: We had a great time at the Palms. They have a couple of the best restaurants in the city (Scoth80 Prime and Vetri Cucina, oh and the newly opened La Popular!!) and the whole staff was very welcoming and helpful. Our hospitality host Gabriel Swinn took great care of our group and made sure we had an awesome weekend. Thank you and we look forward to coming back! I hope they introduce an EDM night at Ghostbar, that would put it over the top!

reviews.title: Wonderful Time At The Palms Las Vegas
reviews.text: I had a wonderful weekend staying at the Palms hotel in Las Vegas. My hospitality host Gabriel Swinn did a wonderful job setting up my hotel room, dinners at Scotch 80 Prime and Vetri Cucina as well as an amazing cabana at the pool. If your looking for a great host that truly provides a wonderful experience, look no further than Gabriel Swinn at the Palms Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Customer Experience
reviews.text: Front desk management were awesome and extremely helpful.  Front desk staff, not so much.  Krista in the office was super helpful, and my housekeeper Melody was amazing.  My pool server Evelyn was the absolute best!  She’s the best server in Vegas!!

reviews.title: Nice for sleeping
reviews.text: The room is spacious and clean. The bathroom is sumptuous. The swimming pool is also very nice if it weren't for the fact that it closes a little too early (at 6pm). The flaws are the casino which I didn't like, the smell of oriental cuisine and the distance from the main road.

reviews.title: Soak Pool Cabana
reviews.text: Hello!!My husband and I were not staying at the Palms but we recently rented a cabana for the day on 8/23/23. We had not stepped foot in the Palms in about 7-8 years, the renovations were beautiful! Back to the cabana… we arrived and waited a few minutes before Sesen checked us in.I am a firm believer in the frontline is the face of your organization and it can make or break an experience with first impressions. Sesen immediately apologized for the wait and she was very  welcoming, sweet and had a sunny ☀️ and bright attitude.Sesen offered us an upgraded cabana due to the other side of the pool being closed. We ended up with a cabana with a private soak pool. We were most excited and enjoyed it immensely! Diane was our cocktail server for the day and Louis was assisting. Drinks were just okay  to me, but my husband enjoyed his cocktails and we both thought the food was AMAZING! We especially loved the Vegas hot chicken wrap!The bathrooms were incredibly clean, any staff members you encountered greeted you with a smile.At one point I had to run into the store to grab an essential, Sesen I turned security I was there for the day (no room key)and would be returning shortly. She made sure I wouldn’t have any issues. It was such a chill vibe, great music, and it was a very comfortable cabana! We will definitely do this again, we enjoyed it immensely.

reviews.title: Not for us SORRY!!!
reviews.text: Not so special for 2 nights with family, better go to other hotel a bit outside the strip when you have a car because this hotel is only meant for people who want to play. Las Vegas is nothing special just great if you’re a player, for a family trip avoid all cost this or other hotels near to the strip.

reviews.title: BEST WEEKEND EVER!!!
reviews.text: I went to Vegas this past weekend and it was such an enjoyable experience. Throughout my stay, my friends and I hung out at the "Tonic" Sports Bar and the bartender Danny was so warm and friendly. Was very knowledgeable on what his suggestions for drinks and whatnot and HE DID NOT DISAPPOINT!! So much fun talking and laughing with friends and Danny. BEST BARTENDER EVER!! If you ever stay or stop by The Palms, say hello to Danny and have him mix you a delicious cocktail or two.

reviews.title: Great Blackjack Dealer
reviews.text: Dennis on graveyard dealing blackjack was great. Entertaining and so courteous. Five stars. He acted like he was on your side. Great attitude and smile throughout. The pit bosses at the Palms are fantastic. Everyone is so courteous    Would recommend

reviews.title: Fun stay
reviews.text: Overall a good stay. Our room was tidied each day with fresh towels given. The staff were all very friendly and helpful! We ate at Mabel’s a couple of times which was very nice. The pool was nice although we didn’t use it (just sat by it for a while before we caught our flight home). The casino itself was good too. I think the rooms could have been “cleaned” more for example there was a lot of dust/grime along the skirting board. Having said that, it didn’t affect our stay and we still had a lovely time. We had an issue with being checked into the wrong room at first (which was sorted out very efficiently by the front desk) but the first room had coffee stains and hair in the bathroom too. The bed was huge and super comfy!The hotel is a 20 min walk or 5-10 minute drive to the strip. If you don’t mind this it’s a great hotel to stay at and a little more affordable than the ones on the strip. We ended up spending a fair amount of money on Ubers  as we didn’t want to walk in 40 degree heat! Something to bare in mind.Overall we had a great time, thank you!

reviews.title: Great hospitality!
reviews.text: Vegas was the destination of our mother daughter yearly trip! The room was great and house keeping even better! We were very needy but Yanitza was very pleasant and helped us immensely! We also had a great time at the casino!

reviews.title: Rude security and they kicked us out.
reviews.text: It started out nice, but then security for some reason denied my wife and child to come in. I was already in the room and they had been out shopping. And then I was told to pack up my things and leave the room.Just managed to get a room for usbat the flamingo by the strip.I would advice everyone to pick anything that doesn't have "Palms" in it for your stay

reviews.title: An Amazingly Fun Time enabled by the libationary skillz of two Mad Scientist Bartenders!!!
reviews.text: My Wife & I were in Las Vegas for business but made a bit of time to have a little fun. We did a lot of research before our trip on the best rooftop bars. After sifting thru a lot of YouTube Vlogs we decided to check out the GhostBar at The Palms. Well, it was....AMAZING! The view is by FAR the BEST view of the strip because you get to see the whole strip! The pictures simply do not do it justice! Great vibe outside too!Speaking of vibe, you go to say hi to Paul & Brian! Those two Bartenders are awesome man! I love champagne cocktails and we worked together to come up with what I call the "MarcoPolo" (MarkPaul)!!! It's Champagne, simple syrup, grenadine, and RUM. It got so popular that others took notice and started ordering it too! I will be going back in a month or so and I cannot wait to stop by to order another one from My Man Paul! Brian too! As for Brian? That dude reminds me of Nate Ruess from FUN. Super cool dude and a great Bartender as well! Eva & I had a GRAND time there! Oh! And let's not forget the DJ. That dude was spinning the platters that matta all night long! He played all our jams and got the dance floor going!Our only suggestion is that they add a more diverse set of alcohol choices to fully allow these talented Bartenders to explore their already formidable skillz! More top shelf items are a must. All in all Eva & I believe you will enjoy yourselves at The GhostBar at The Palms! I look forward to staying there too! It would be our first time! Hopefully we can review that as well! Can't wait to go back! Paul & Brian, look forward to seeing you guys....have that "MarcoPolo" waiting for me...

reviews.title: Las Vegas vacay
reviews.text: We have fallen to love the Palms but this last visit was extraordinary. Our housekeeper Sarah Alcantara went above and beyond to make sure our stay was comfortable and clean. Our family really  appreciated it. The only reason I give a 4 is because our bed was to soft for us and there were no bed swaps available nor roll away beds. If it wasn’t for the beds no doubt I would rate our stay a 5. Thank you Sarah Alcantara!!!you were awesome.

reviews.title: Read the fine print!!! Buyer beware!
reviews.text: Read the fine print very very carefully before booking here! I made a reservation 2 months in advance. Never received a confirmation email for my reservation. Cancelled via phone call it a few days later since I found a better price at a hotel that was actually ON the strip. The person I spoke to on the phone did not mention that I would not be receiving a refund if I cancelled.  Now they are refusing my refund saying it was a non-refundable reservation...?  I looked everywhere on their website for their cancellation policy prior to cancelling, nowhere did it mention non-refundable if it is cancelled so far in advance. In fact, the cancellation email I did receive says "cancellations are accepted up to 48 hrs before arrival with a full return of deposit". If the cancellation policy was any different than the standard, they should have at least sent a confirmation email at the time of booking to explain this.  Very deceitful tactics. Will not be staying here and will not recommend to anyone.

reviews.title: WSOP & Bacarrat & Black jack games
reviews.text: Elaine Lam (Sr. Executive Palms casino) is one of the best host that I ever have. I really appreciate her for accommodating booking hotels & buffet reservations & response back quickly even though she’s in the meeting. Overall she is the best host. Execellent host. I feel grateful and thankful that she is my host.  I feel happy & enjoying the palms environments & wonderful services. I will definitely recommend all my friends and relatives and families to enjoy the best buffet at Palms casino.  The rate of my host is 10 out of 10!  Way to go Elaine Lam & thank you making me for the great experience trip this year 2003. Excellent Host Elaine Lam for many thanks. Sincerely,Hong Minh TranKnownothing73@gmail.com

reviews.title: Racist guest.
reviews.text: I was born in the US. I was born in California and I experienced extreme racism At this casino the palms. The manager rather see me leave instead of the racist. Avoid here if you are against racism…..

reviews.title: Birthday at the palms
reviews.text: The place was very upscale and clean and the drinks were the best our  view was wonderful and Gabriel made sure he took the best care of me and my friends for her birthday we will definitely be coming back soon !

reviews.title: Amazing Weekend Getaway
reviews.text: One of my favorite and frequent weekend getaway destinations is Las Vegas. I spent over ten years living there so I know the city as a local and a visitor. I just had my second stay within a year at the Palms. I enjoy the Palms because it has so much to offer I can stay here for the weekend and continue to find new and fun experiences. I spent all Saturday morning at The Spa and had an excellent aromatherapy massage from Patrice.  I spent the morning relaxing and exploring the many rooms the spa had to offer. Beyond self care, I also indulged in some of the restaurants. Both La Popular and Scotch 80 offered excellent and attentive service but delicious dishes and  well crafted cocktails. Highly recommended, 5 starts and can’t wait to come back!

reviews.title: TIERRA!
reviews.text: Tierra was the best waitress. Even on a very busy night, she made us feel welcome and like we were her only table. She was attentive, kind, and efficient. If you stay at Palms, look for Tierra. You will receive the best customer service ever. Thank you Tierra!

Great atmosphere. Great service. Tracey the bartender is awesome. Great rooms. The people are great and make you feel welcome. Would totally come back again. I was only here for one day and it was a great day.

reviews.title: A great experience for getting off The Strip!
reviews.text: Had a great time at the Palms last week! The room was comfortable and clean, the pool was beautiful and relaxing, and the hotel's bars were lots of fun for when we didn't want to venture out on the strip. All of the bartenders were great, but Tracey was a treasure... She slung some delicious drinks and was just really fun to chat with.The casino was good, too! I didn't win, but I knew that going in, lol. Still had a good time with a good selection of games. I'll happily stay at the Palms the next time I'm down ol' Vegas way.

reviews.title: Great vip room
reviews.text: Best room ever i got vip with vip top took an elevator to the pool not the hotel elevators vip elevator it’s fast good my room is good beautiful get a patio get basketball room I did a back flip but nice bathroom love it recamend

reviews.title: Rooms need Renovation
reviews.text: Stayed here in July. Paid almost $300 for a night. These rooms need renovation. It is an older hotel. Our room smelled of smoke and sulphur/sewage.  Air would not get colder than 72. Not that clean, hair in the bathroom, the mirror had the metal backing coming off it was so old. This seemed like a $100/night hotel. The casino and shops below were fine.  When I checked out I mentioned the issues and they did nothing. Just said have a nice day.

reviews.title: A must stay
reviews.text: I had a blast staying at the palms with my friends and family! We had a great dinner at scotch80 and spent sometime at the Shark bar where summer and Ray took great care of us. We later ended our night at the Tonic bar where we also had great service from the bartender over there. We also met the bar manager working that night Casey she gave us some tips on where and what to do while in town. Overall we had such an enjoyable time. Will definitely be back!

reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.text: Great stay!  Kelton Simon took great care of us and made sure we had everything we needed. He was amazing and made our stay so comfortable. Highly recommend for families and couples. Great property, quiet and clean.

reviews.title: The Palms Experience!!
reviews.text: The Palms treated me like a King. VIP services were excellent especially Alexis @ VIP LOUNGE!! I really enjoyed my stay!! I will be returning in the near future!! The restaurants & food court provided an abundance of choices!!

reviews.title: Great location, Stunning Hotel, Beautiful Views
reviews.text: Beautiful, spacious rooms. The pool area was a blast! Get there early to book yourself a table with an umbrella. $200 for the whole day, which goes into your tab spend for drinks and food. There's a mini bar in the rooms. The hotel is slightly away from thr strip, which was perfect for us, but also easy to get to the strip by taxi. There's a pharmacy just down the road to buy water. The staff was also very friendly, was able to get a top floor room with stunning views upon request. Will definitely be coming back here

reviews.title: Fantastic Stay! Will be back
reviews.text: A real treat! From the arrival experience to our room was amazing. Stayed in the fantasy tower---very short walk from the front desk and most of the hotel amenities.  Dinner at Scotch 80 Prime was 5 star...we were decadent and shared a seafood tower...fantastic! Spent some time in the casino...employees were very friendly and engaged. Kudos to the leadership team. We will be back!

reviews.title: Next time you should look for the customer’s information first
reviews.text: I checked in with a lady and my room wasn’t ready at that time, I paid for a deposit and she said come back to get a key when it ready! I got a text that my room was ready and I went to get a key with another person at the counter and the gentleman who works there at the counter asked me to pay for deposit again even though I paid for it I told him for so many time that the lady charged me, he looked upset and didn’t understand what I say and he wasn’t even look for my information on a computer he just wanted me to pay! I decided to show him my bank account statements that I got charged and explained him! I’m so frustrated!! Finally after I showed him my bank account and he apologized to me!!

reviews.title: MUST!!
reviews.text: We booked and stayed at the Ivory Tower on the 25th floor with Double bed. The room is beautiful and roomy with a panoramic view breathtaking view towards the strip. We had VIP service and Desie was an angel! Overall, the hotel and casino areas are clean and smell good. We would recommend to everyone single or as a family trip. Can wait to make another trip and stay here.

reviews.title: Fascinating!
reviews.text: We booked and stayed at the Ivory Tower on the 50th floor with King bed. The room is beautiful and roomy with a panoramic view looking out to MGM, Mandalay Bay hotel and Allegiant Stadium. The living room separate from bedroom with its own toilet. Main bathroom is really huge and clean. The only minor thing is the small fridge not working, and the weather was hot in which we would like to store drinks. Overall, the hotel and casino areas are clean and nice since it was renovated recently. We would recommend to everyone. Next time perhaps we will try to stay at "Fantasy" Tower.

reviews.title: Ok
reviews.text: KENTON WAS THE HIGHLIGHT OF OUR TRIP. He was courteous and went out of his way to bring us pots and pans and condiments. The palms place owners need to UPDATE THEIR APARTMENTS. They have become pretty run down and housekeeping is not bad but it’s a hit or miss!! There is not STANDARD

reviews.title: The Best!
reviews.text: My favorite hotel as a local and to recommend to tourist friends and family! I love that it smells so clean in the rooms and in the casino! So much better than other hotels in town. I am a frequent visitor of the Palms. Beautiful hotel & amazing customer service.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Experience from valet to getting checked in and playing in the casino was phenomenal.Customer service here is great all smile and friendly. Experience a whole different vip check in, it was an awesome experience for my wife and I!Thanks for the great experience and see you guys soon!!

reviews.title: Go See Tracey at Tonic !!!!
reviews.text: Stayed at The Palms and had a great time for my first time in Vegas for my birthday. I was so happy to meet Tracey at Tonic. She was the best and made my birthday stay very special !!! Can't wait to go back

reviews.title: Exceptional Customer Service
reviews.text: Out of the plethora of hotel / casinos I’ve been to in Vegas (Strip & off) over the years, I have to say my experience at the Palms this last week was one of my best.   By and large from the stellar service provided at the sports bar by Tracey.  My friends and I were in town from Cali & the service she provided for not just myself, but my entire group was nothing short of exceptional.  Unfortunately my biggest gripe while visiting Vegas tends to be arrogant bartenders who rarely exhibit the endearing attributes of someone like Tracey.  I’m typically not one for reviews. However, I will proudly be returning to The Palms next time I’m in town & will look forward to hopefully seeing our new favorite bartender again!  Free parking & convenience to the amazing food in Chinatown was another huge bonus!

reviews.title: Great great hotel
reviews.text: Really nice hotel! Rooms was amazing. Food was really good we tried about every restaurant lol Our cocktail server Tiara was great as well she recommended some nice places to go! Will be back next year Thanks Palms

reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.text: Rich was amazing. Customer service was spectacular nonetheless. Rich was interested as to why we stayed and due to our marriage plans that week he went out of his way to ensure we were provided great service. The entire hotel was clean, amazing service and pleasant. I became a member that night and realized I would be staying at this hotel moving forward. I visit Vegas on a yearly basis and sometimes more and I can’t believe I haven’t stayed here. I’m impressed and I will definitely stay here again and recommend.

reviews.title: Great drinks and gambling
reviews.text: Came by the other night for some drinks and gambling and we had a blast! Met a lovely lady named Tracey and she really made our experience! Drinks are great fun gambling and clean atmosphere! Lots of great restaurants to Pick from too! We will definitely be back!

reviews.title: Don’t like it
reviews.text: Was on a trip. Lost 50 k and the girl made me to put another 40k. The service was worst to. I would rather go to another casino than this. The machines were so complex too. My friend recommended to go here but I regret going here. I will never go here ever.

reviews.title: Casino is pretty cool
reviews.text: Didn't stay at the hotel but did stop by the casino.  Modern and lots of promos available.  Buffet is probably the last affordable casino buffet in Vegas. Mostly writing this review as a shout out to Aaron our blackjack dealer. Got to be honest when you play odds are you're not going to make any money. When you have a dealer with less personality than a piece of cardboard it makes it an even worse experience. Aaron is what a dealer should be, sociable, friendly,  outgoing, just a good guy. I would have been happy to lose money at his table, but I actually won a few bucks as an added bonus. Gotta hire more guys like him.

reviews.title: Terrible experience
reviews.text: I play a lot and I'm  a diamond serrano club member . When I called vip services over the phone and representative was very rude with us and said that we don't have any offers and hung up the phone. This is was very sad experience with vip services at Palms Casino Resort.

reviews.title: Loved our stay at the Palms
reviews.text: Just returned from a wonderful stay at the Palms Hotel. Paige at the reception desk was so helpful and professional. James , manager went out of his way to assist us with some complicated issues and took the time to navigate us to a prompt and excellent resolution. Veronica, inside the Serrano cafe gave excellent service. We will definitely return to this lovely hotel.

reviews.title: Palms resort is a great experience
reviews.text: Went to Palms and was very pleased with all aspects of the resort..  Absolutely loved the ayce lobster (yes all you can eat lobster) Buffett and playing the slots.  Very clean well managed hotel property and amenities.  Off the strip so usually not my go to but because of this experience it’s now in my top 3.  100% go back on my next Vegas trip.

reviews.title: Worst experience at a hotel ever in my life
reviews.text: Worst experience at a hotel ever in my life, we were driving into the parking lot to check in and my girlfriend had drank to much and playfully dumped some water on me. We pulled too close to another car and didn't hit anything all in fun in Vegas whatever got to the hotel yay. No Security Superviser starts screaming in my face DO YOU WANT TO PRESS CHARGES DO YOU WANT TO PRESS CHARGES? While he waives a giant flashlight at us and calls all this other security. I dont even know what he is talking about. Then he gets us out of the car and explains he thinks my girlfriend hit me in the face not poured a little water on me for making a bad joke. Then proceeds to call the police and say that we are in a domestic incident, all while making my girlfriend and I feel confused and we just are tired and want to check into the hotel. This takes now over an hour and then he bans us from the property and tells us we can't check into our hotel. We then had to spend thousands more trying to find a hotel room last minute EDC Weekend in Vegas, worst experience ever with a hotel.On camera there was zero evidence of my girlfriend hitting me as the security supervisor accused and zero evidence of us hitting any other cars which was their other reason for escalating. Also not one mark on me or any car to support these outlandish claims from the security team.The Palms has a Security team looking for any excuse to call the police and get their own guests in more trouble instead of protecting them.
