reviews.text: We stayed there during Christmas holiday.Lots of changes from my last visit to the casino.Casino area seems double in size what used to be. Good casino atmosphere. We used the buffet for breakfast twice, with players card we had discounts. Room was very clean and indoor parking garage. Long Walk to casino area still was under renovation. Away from Vegas strip but walking distance to Gold Coast and Rio.Overall very satisfied.

reviews.title: Expensive, lots of construction = inconvenient place to stay
reviews.text: Pros:  Our room was nice and clean, great view of the strip, and the beds are super comfy.Cons:  There is no coffee/coffee maker in the room. The fridge is only for their drinks that they charge for.  If you remove anything, you get charged a $25 personal use fee.  There are fees for absolutely everything.  We were also charged around $42 a day for a resort fee, which covered valet parking we never used, wifi we never used, and the use of the pool, which was closed the entire time we were there.  The entire resort smells like smoke/pot.  There was a ton of construction going on.  We couldn't hear it from our room, but it was a pain to walk around.  Parking is difficult. There is ample parking in the garage, but it felt like a half mile walk to the room from there.

reviews.title: Horrible - must read
reviews.text: Worst stay I have ever had at any hotel. So many issues it is almost comical. I am a 45 yr old, married female from Georgia on a girls trip. First trip to LV and chose this hotel bc we were going to see Lady Antebellum in the hotel Saturday night. First impression was poor - no bellman to greet you and hold gigantic, heavy doors open for you while you try to maneuver pulling luggage through. Enter into a dark, smoky casino. Check-in is off to the left and had to wait in a long line for about 30 mins to check-in (ridiculous!!!!), whole process took almost an hour at 5pm - my friends room was still not ready and we were trying to figure out why. That evening one of my friends took her shoes off walking through lobby and was yelled at to "put her shoes on, this is a nice establishment." Well, nice hotels have bellmen! Got a violent stomach virus so lucky me had to extend my stay by one night. The front desk was insistent that I had to come down to the front desk to sign for new keys and cc authorization even though I couldn't lift my head off a pillow. Refused to send someone up for me to assist w signature. That was such disgusting customer service! A friend requested for some saltine crackers to be delivered to me so room service delivered a bowl of crackers with a $9.00 bill!!! Wow, that made me want to vomit again. When I finally emerged from my room 36 hours later, I went to meet my friends at the hotel bar and within 5 minutes was brought to tears by the silliness of the hotel policies. One of my friends had purchased a muffin for me at Lucky Penny to nibble on. I was told no outside food was allowed at the bar - even though the muffin was purchased within the hotel. I refused to 3 people to quit eating the muffin because it was so ridiculous that they cared so much about a stupid muffin. I was so frustrated with all the other hotel shananigans while I was sick that day that it brought me to tears. I am still seething with anger from my stay at this hotel three days post check out. Do yourself a favor and stay somewhere else.

reviews.title: Concert
reviews.text: Horrible experience and stay. This place is a joke and we will not be back. Be careful if you’re singing and laughing in a concert...if you offend the people in front of you and they go tell security YOU get kicked out!!! Seriously was booted out for that and did nothing to provoke or aggravate. I cried all the way out because I was soo upset. We were having the BEST night.

reviews.title: Nice place
reviews.text: We went last night for the Lady Antebellum concert. Got there early and gambled. Got new player cards at the rewards center and that was pleasant as no line, the guy was very friendly, great customer service. The casino floor was clean, cocktail servers come around quickly, and we won on the machines!

reviews.title: Enjoyed my stay
reviews.text: I stayed in the Ivory Tower. I arrived early and was able to check in at noon with no extra charge for early checkin. The room was nice, reasonably quiet. Comfortable bed with an assortment of pillows. Flat screen TV, desk and work chair. There is a nice lounging chair by the window to sit and look at the view. My room faced Flamingo Street and had a nice view of the mountains, and of course the Gold Coast and Rio across the street. The room had a safe, an iron and ironing board, and hair dryer. The room also had the usual mini bar with super expensive drinks and snacks. There's a gift shop inside the casino, not far from the Ivory Tower and Fantasy Tower, where you an get drinks and snacks at a better price - still expensive of course. There are several good restaurants and a food court for quicker meals.

reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: The room we stayed in was completely remodeled, and was lovely and spacious. Be warned, there are no coffee makers in the room - no doubt they want to get you downstairs with the slots as soon as possible. The food court was wonderful, with good coffee, sandwiches, breakfast, etc. The hotel restaurants were also excellent! Friendly, patient staff, too!  We did run out of toilet paper (three women in one room) and tissues, too.  Also, we asked for a rollaway bed and they wanted to charge us $30 but whatever. I would stay there again, although with so many amazing hotels to choose from, I think we'll try somewhere else next time.

reviews.title: Slow check in process, no value for money
reviews.text: There was a long queue upon checking in and only two staff available who were friendly by the way, but too much and too long talking instead of being efficient.Then there was a construction going on so noisy and messy, seeing that I don’t see how they still can justify the high room rates.The room itself was ok, but not more than that.Next stay will be away from the Strip where you definitely get more value for your dollars

reviews.title: Service is just lip service not practical service
reviews.text: Stayed at this hotel for an event. Due to the scope of the event other hotels on the strip were sold out. I gave the palms a chance although the price hike was absurd. The front desk was polite and attentive. I requested to be away from the elevator since I knew this week would be super busy. I was given a room. The view was amazing and the room was clean. Only issues were that it was 5 feet away from the elevator and tragically out of date. It looked like a scene from Scareface. I called down and was told the floor was empty and I should not have noise issues. I stated this room is out of date and is there anything better. I was told yes for $180 more per night. So that was hard past. Later that night after coming back to the room; I heard a loud banging. I thought it was construction on the floor. That would explain why it would be empty. However it was ropes outside left from the window washers. I called the front desk and told them about the noise. They said that they could move me but I would still here it on that side of the building. So the room was a major fail. There is a movie theater and lots of food choices should you remain on property. However, there is no poker at all on the game floor. Not sure how that is possible but it’s true. The maid service was excellent and the only bright side of the stay. Avoid this property if at all possible. It does not cost that much less than anything closer. Just have to plan ahead.

reviews.title: Basic/adequate
reviews.text: I stayed at the venetian for one night due to prices being really low before CES trade show. Then i decided to move a bit out of town to Palms as i was not really planning on attending the show much. Arrived to the Palms and got given a room in the Ivory tower. The room was basic to say the least, but it was a quarter of the cost of the Venetian. So i think if you want the epic experience that Vegas can offer. You need to take the mantra of in for a penny in for a pound. My room had a connecting room and it felt like the guy next door was pretty much in my room, and his lady friend. Also there are no main lights in the room......? Just lamps. I asked to be moved and there was no problem with that, but still the room had no main light. Weird! Anyway, it is cheap and cheerful.

reviews.title: Never again - two expensive and horrible sleepless nights
reviews.text: We got a room at the 20th floor for two nights, but it wasn't worth 205 $, The bed and room was clean for the first night, but the for the second night there wasn't any cleaning (no new glasses, no vaccum cleaning, even the bathroom wasn't done. But that wasn't even worst enough. At 4 am in the morning construction started outside. You hear the sound of the excavatours and trucks when they drive back. On the 20th floor it's a sound like an alarm clock which paused when they drived forward. It's save you'll wake up after 20 - 30 minutes and sleep is impossible. They told us we should have make a call in the morning and the workers would be informed to stop, but this is nonsense. We noticed no effects for the construction on the second night (Saturday morning 4.00 am). And even the time the workers act outside isn't comprehensibly, There's no construction at least after 5.00 pm.The miserable ridiculous service and help was topped when we checked out! They apologize for the construction, they said they would stop the work outside when we've called again, they told us, the guest can get the information about the work on You Tube (before booking) but they are sorry there's no mention on their own booking site. We thought we were in the wrong movie. We expected two refreshing nights in a clean hotel room, but for 2 nights in the first week of January there's a better chance to get a room at the strip for 205 $.Besides this we got luck in this bad situation that we didn't have to pay the 44 $ / night resort fee because our black Friday booking.Although we stayed in this gotel in 2015 and 2016 we would choose the Palms never again, it isn't even worth to stay off the strip with such complications!

reviews.title: All In One
reviews.text: Amazing hotel. You do not have to leave this resort if you don’t want to. Movie theater, club, bar, restaurants, a lot machines. Great staff, helpful. I cannot wait to return when they have the pool finished. Super happy we stayed here. It’s a 5-10 minute car ride away from the strip. Worth it!

reviews.title: Ripoff.do not stay here
reviews.text: Payed 250 for a lousy hotel on newyears eve. Worst service,Filthy,smelly, had to wait 60 min  to get a shower fixed, sheets, towels, and call reception 6 times, to find out there is no service call.Ripoff!

reviews.title: Hotel Guest
reviews.text: Elaine Gutierrez, Hotel Front Desk Manager, is a poor example of hospitality.  She is insensitive, uncaring and non customer friendly.  She totally ruined my family get away!!! I will never stay at the PALMS EVER AGAIN!!!  ELAINE SHOULD BE FIRED AND SHOULD BE BARRED FROM THE HOSPITALITY BUSINESS FOR EVER!!

reviews.title: stay at palms
reviews.text: everything was ok until we had to walk to spa, construction and con. workers walking around was a bit annoying,blocked window was a surprise,if not for those issues stay would been excellent.first stay for me there and it was ok even for those things

reviews.title: Won a complimentary night at the kiosk
reviews.text: My wife and I enjoyed a free night in the Ivory tower. Our room was on the 24th floor overlooking the construction being done looking south. Next to nothing heard from the construction site. The room was very clean and I was very glad to see that there was no smoking allowed. You find that out when you check into the hotel as you sign in. The elevator was quick to get to the floor. We checked in around 4pm and a maid was cleaning a room down the hall. She greeted us warmly and asked us if we needed anything just ask. The room was a premier king bed with a chaise lounge. It was very clean and after doing a bit of gaming in the casino the bed was okay. I had to turn off the heater because it was just a bit too much. All in all, this was a nice place to be in.

reviews.title: Good Rooms, Mediocre Staff
reviews.text: We stayed at The Palms last weekend for the first and it was good. The room was really pretty and clean. I enjoyed the room. The staff to say the least was just OK. Upon checking in I asked the guy if the rooms were nice and his response was "well you bought the cheapest room we have." I would think they would want their hotel staff to boast their rooms even if I bought the cheapest one available. Anytime we walked up to concierge to ask a question she acted like we were bothering her or taking her time from starring at the computer. The construction starts early so beware if you are wanting to sleep in you can not. The housekeeping does not pay attention to detail as they provided me a stained pillow case.

reviews.title: Good place and Spa was great!
reviews.text: Overall great place. The view on the 52 floors was perfect!  Cafe opposite spa had good food but unfortunately ended up getting a pretty dry salmon on my salat. Staff was helpful and friendly, especially in the bar. The spa was just what I needed to get all refreshed after a long work weekend! They had a sauna, steam bath, cold water pool, and hot tub. Free shavers, toothbrush and whatever you needed to get ready for a good day of work. Overall great experience, looking forward to being back again.  Cheers

reviews.title: Nice Stay
reviews.text: I stayed here last week and there was still construction. Don't let that deter you from staying at this beautiful hotel off the strip.The A.Y.C.E. Buffet is as a great value. Dinner was $21.99, but you get $2 off if you sign up for their free player's card. The Palms also has a mini food court with Panda Express and McDonald's. Rooms are clean and remodeled. They have one of the best player services in Vegas. The team is very friendly and helpful. Give this hotel a try and you won't be sorry.

reviews.title: PISSED
reviews.text: If you want roaches crawling up your bed this is the best hotel ! I’m pissed as hell we were doing so well and this morning we find a HUGE Roach crawling up our damn bed ... this is digusting and I’m utterly upset !

reviews.title: Love the redesign
reviews.text: Had a comp night with our boarding pass and decided to check out Stations newest hotel. They have done a fantastic job in remodeling the place. We parked in the east garage and they are staging their construction from there. Parking garage is a little tight, but had no problem parking our Tahoe.Had dinner at the A.Y.C.E. buffet and it was delicious. The food was hot and fresh even though they weren't terribly busy. We got one of the remodeled rooms in the Fantasy Tower and loved it. The beds were very comfortable and the room was well lit. Have comps again next month and might use it for the Palms again

reviews.title: Off-Strip, $20 Dinner AYCE Buffet, Free Parking, Free Wifi
reviews.text: We stayed in early November, and there was still construction in the front (they're building a pool and a couple of restaurants). It didn't bother us that much, and we didn't hear construction noise in our room in the Ivory Tower until mid week (Wed). Like almost all Vegas hotels, the Palms has a resort fee on top of the nightly fee. But, they also offer Free Parking anywhere on the property and Free Wifi, which was why we choose them. The best part of staying at the hotel was the A.Y.C.E. Buffet. It was a great value. Dinner was $21.99, but you get $2 off if you sign up for their free player's card. Best dishes were the prime rib, mashed potatoes, moqueca (clams and mussel stew), and smoked korean bbq ribs. It's not a seafood buffet, but they do have seafood dishes and these rotate each night so you can get a variety. One night, they had honey walnut shrimp, another night the moqueca. The Palms also has a mini food court with Panda Express and McDonald's.The Ivory Tower is nice and comfortable. They don't change bed sheets (just make the beds) for  multi-day stay, unless you ask Housekeeping to, but this is pretty standard in the industry. Housekeeping missed a few spots for vacuuming, but it wasn't a big deal. Generally clean. The only real bummer about staying at the Palms is they discontinued the free shuttle to the Strip. It's about a mile, and we didn't feel it was walkable because of the busy freeway interchange. If you head to the Strip, you can park for free at the Venetian. Hotel stay also included free entrance to their club. No pool except for the one at Palm's Place (you have to cross the casino to the other side to get to it).

reviews.title: Comfortable, clean rooms!
reviews.text: We headed to Vegas to see Blink-182 and celebrate my birthday! The check in process was quick and the staff was super friendly.The room itself was big, comfortable and clean! I would definitely stay here again, especially with the availability of the restaurants and fast food chains!

reviews.title: Enjoyable stay
reviews.text: We arrived at the hotel Sunday at noon and our room was not ready... was ok with that went to the food court which was pretty good and watched NFL in the sportsbook. Finally got our room at 3:45 lol but they were very nice about it and upgraded us to a resort room in the fantasy tower at no charge for our patience. Room was very nice big bed was comfy bathroom was large the shower was HUGE the water pressure good have been better but the water was nice and hot ... toilet door was weird though it was a sliding door lol and the flat screen TV on the wall was huge One of the best features was the A.Y.C.E. breakfast buffet for $10.99 which included your drinks for that price . The food was excellent and the selection was huge trust me check this out definitely worth the price Downside was there is no longer shuttle service from the Hotel to the strip so if you plan on doing alot on the strip you may want to avoid this cause although it's only like a 5 Minute ride to the strip the ride back after a long day was a bit of a pain. We were doing anything much on the strip so we found the break from the hustle and bustle a nice change of scenery . If you are a first timer to Vegas I would not recommend staying off the stripThey are doing massive construction on building new pools and hot tubs but it was not a distraction or nuisance Staff was excellent and polite and we enjoyed our stay . Recommend this hotel if you are looking for more of relaxed quieter trip to Vegas

reviews.title: A Maze
reviews.text: The room itself was great! It was comfortable and ideal. However, I think it is ridiculous that we can’t even have a coffee maker in the room. It is such a pain in the butt to not be able to relax in the morning and just have a cup of coffee without having to get dressed and go downstairs. Oh that’s right you can get it room service but it’s $20.00 (+3% tax and gratuity) for a 4 cup pot! The other pain was it was a maze trying to get to the pool! When you get there it is nice but getting there is interesting. You can easily get lost. It’s not a pool that you can swim in. Plus it isn’t on the strip which has its advantages but then its disadvantages. We had a great stay overall. Oh and we did see Owen Wilson there! He hopped out of his Uber!

reviews.title: roaches... move on
reviews.text: Stayed Nov 15 & 16.... roaches in room on day of check out, could not even put on make up without them crawling at my toes.  Flight was at 12 but checked out at 730 AM.... told front desk and showed pics... he said he would send housekeeping... really,,, I am checking out... Offered no customer service... home now in Monterey, another fine "manager" calls.. says all she can do is reverse my early check in (don't forget I did an early check out!!) and reverse the "resort" fee but no room charge adjustment cause I paid on Expedia... wow... Both "managers" failed, perhaps their new "gun" Jon the GM should spend more time on customer service training.  You know for every one roach you see there are 300 hiding.  They should have refunded the room charges regardless of how I paid.  So unless you want bugs crawling on you during the night and chasing you in the AM ... move to another booking.

reviews.title: We really enjoy this Hotel and Staff. Casino Host John is really great.
reviews.text: We usually stay here at least one or more nights when we come to Las Vegas. My Husband enjoys the table games in the Casino and I like to watch him play. Although the last two visits they still are under construction, we are really looking forward to returning to see it all finished.  ESP. The Pool area.  We have enjoyed the old pool area in past. Sad to see it not available but I bet the new pool will be Awesome! The rooms are always very clean and the staff always pleasant. One of these trips I would love to see a live performance in the Pearl Theater. We have eaten at several of the on site restaurants and enjoyed them.  Had some luck playing in the Casino as well. We used to rent a car in past visits but now find it so reasonably priced and quick to just take Uber if we go off site. Now that Palms is owned by the same group that owns the Station Casino’s we can collect more players points.  Highly Recommend The Palms.

reviews.title: A.Y.C.E. was the bomb!!
reviews.text: We were there for a concert but stayed at Palms Place. The casino was not very good to me but I had fun! The buffet was great and the price was reasonable. Very good choices. Will for sure visit there again we I return to Vegas.

reviews.title: Breakfast at the palms buffet
reviews.text: Went to breakfast at the new buffet at the palms and was very good , a lot of variety to choose from all the food was good ! The service was good the staff were all friendly definitely worth checking out even though it’s a little bit off the vegas strip!

reviews.title: Terrible customer service
reviews.text: terrible! terrible! terrible!stayed 2 nights, complained 3 times.  Complain #1 - 6AM, something banging on the window.  called the front desk, answer " very sorry, we knew about that.  A lot of people complain".  Complain #2 - 8:30PM, the shower drain clogged up.  Called the housekeeping, the engineer came right away (very good).  He spent 15 mins, couldn't fix it because the drain shared with the next room.  Another guy came, worked in the other room for another 15 mins.  still did not work.  But my whole room stink with the stuff they pulled out and the bath room and the carpet were disgusting. Called the front desk.  They are not willing to change room and said they will send somebody to clean and spray the room.  I insisted to change room.  They say they will send the bell boy up to bring us the keys for new room.  15 mins later (while we were still in the stinky room), nobody showed up.  i went down to the front desk and they told me nobody at the front desk talked to me.  I wanted to talk to the manager.  The lady at the front desk went to the back office and the manager came out 5 mins later and told me they are very busy and they have only 2 bell boys (btw, there were not a soul at the front desk) and the bell boy went up.  While i was arguing with them and my wife called me that the bell boy showed up.  She told me he was very rude.  Complain #3, the new keys did NOT work.  Oh, i was mad.  went back down.  Same answer, "sorry, we are very busy and fully booked tonight"  Will never ever stay there again.Terrible terible terrible customer service.

reviews.title: Nice Hotel, would definitely visit again
reviews.text: Stayed here for 3 days in October. I got a mailer offering free "comped" rooms so since my friends were also going to be in vegas that week I booked it last minute. There is major construction going in in the parking lot and casino, as of late October 2018. The parking lot construction was not a problem, you just have to walk a little farther if you self park to get to the casino. The construction in casino was a little annoying during the day; they was drilling sounds and and fire alarm type noise constantly going off. Night time was much better since they didn't seem to be working in the casino at night. They have a food court but everything was closed when i arrived except for McDonalds so I ordered room service, which was ok but it took 1 hour and 15 minutes for my food to arrive. Room was nice as usual, just wish they would put a small frig in there. Best part is they don't charge the resort fee if your room is comped, so all I ended up paying for was the room service. All the staff I interacted with was friendly.  The have a multiplex theater connected to the hotel off the food court that was great; I had to kill time so watched a matinee movie for only $6 with great reclining seats.

reviews.title: This place is worth a try
reviews.text: My boyfriend love this place.  The rooms are very comfortable and clean.  We usually stay at the Ivory Tower but we did get the Fantasy Tower with the jacuzzi tub once.  It’s worth the upgrade.  I enjoy gambling here too.  The buffet and little cafe is great and a surprise.

reviews.title: Blink 182
reviews.text: We stayed at The Palms because my friend and I took our two 15 year old sons to the Blink 182 concert.  We stayed here in hopes that we would just happen to run into the band members, and we did!  We met both Matt and Mark!  The boys we thrilled!As far as the hotel goes, it was pretty good.  Set quite away from the strip - 20-25 min walk to the strip.  It's walkable, but we mostly used Uber.I actually liked being away from the strip, the hotel is not super busy, the restaurants aren't really busy, it was relaxing.We liked the Pearl theatre, it's a smaller, more intimate venue.  Perfect seats pretty much everywhere.The movie theatre was good, reclining chairs and small theatres.We ate at both the Lucky Penny and the AYCE buffet. The AYCE was great for breakfast, good price and good selection.  We only had small snacks at the Penny, but what we did have was good, and everyone else's meals looked and smelled amazing! Our waiter was fantastic.The rooms were clean - I have really high standards and I couldn't complain.  There's always room for improvement, like getting in the corners and giving the shower a good scrub.The beds were super comfy and the pillows were amazing.  In room safe, hair dryer, iron - all worked well.  TV selection was decent, wifi speed was decent.  We moved a bunch of stuff out of the fridge so we could cool our own drinks - a guy came into refill the minibar and I told him we only moved stuff - we were initially charged for those items right away, but the front desk didn't hassle me at checkout when I told them we didn't actually use them  They took all charges off without question. I think that was my only negative - I will never pay the minibar fees, I'd rather have an empty fridge to house my own stuff than them stocking the fridge.We took advantage of the pool - it was a trek to get to, and quite hard to find, but once we got there it was great.  Very quiet and relaxing - very few people were there.  It was nice to be able to relax without all the drunk, rowdy people like you get at strip pools. The pool is great for kids, our boys loved it, but it would be good for little ones too - no partying and the pool is not deepI would totally stay here again.  It's far enough from the strip that you don't get the partying and the crowds.  You can walk places, but Uber is really your best bet because the walks can be very long.  I loved how quiet this place is compared to hotels on the strip.  You don't have to walk through crowds constantly within the hotel, the noise level is good - still a fun atmosphere, but not a big party place.Hotel amenities aren't abundant - one small store with a bit of drinks, snacks and clothes.  They had a great selection of Blink shirts! A small food court and just a few restaurants, but it worked for us.

reviews.title: Good rooms - currently under construction
reviews.text: We've stayed here before and enjoyed it.  You probably know it's off the strip (but close enough), so that's nothing new.  However, it is under construction/renovation, so many restaurants are not open, there is a small-ish pool located in a different tower which is a little bit of a hike.  The fitness center is there, too.  We found there wasn't much to do there.  The room was very nice, well-equipped.  We stayed here because we were seeing a show in the theatre there and the price was competitive.  But  it won't be our first choice again for lack of things to do.

reviews.title: The Pearl at Palms Casino Restort - Great concert venue
reviews.text: When to see Simple Minds and Blink 182 here this week while in Vegas.  Great concert venue - small and intimate but large enough (up to 2,500 people) to get some great energy in the room.    Close to all the main hotels so just a short taxi ride away.   I have been to concerts with 80,000 and much prefer the smaller venues - better experience overall getting to it and getting home from it and while there.  There are bars on every level here and it is a nice clean venue.   There is also waitress service during the events.   If you see an event you like, book it as I am confident you will enjoy the venue.

reviews.title: Over chargeing
reviews.text: I stay here before but KNOW plams casino  service has got tick of tack no one came to the room to clean it up an I call in to conform I'm leaving. came back the room was the same. bathroom has water the stay on the floor from shower uneven drain where water goes down if your in the bathroom LADIES make sure no eclectic core touch the floor?? The Wi-Fi should be FREE but their charging you after you log in / but what is the resort fee for as long as Palms casino has your credit card they can care LESS /an the Iron did not work

reviews.title: Impresive buffe
reviews.text: I was staying somewhere else but a friend wanted to meet at the buffet at the Palms.  I am so glad she suggested it.  The place is very nice and lots of seats.  As for the food, the selection was outstanding.  The fried calamari was spicy and great.  I'm surprised I didn't eat more.

reviews.title: Very Impressed
reviews.text: I just recently returned from a long weekend staying at The Palms in Las Vegas!  It was absolutely awesome!  They have made some very improvements to the property.  Fabulous new rooms!  Excited to go back!

reviews.title: Will not return....business traveler with car for two days
reviews.text: My experience:The positive:1) Comfortable bed2) Casino was not busy so access to tables was easy3) Free parking Cons:1) Toilet backed up first night2) TV remote control did not work3) Construction equipment and supplies stored in the parking garage which completely limited parking spaces4) "Free internet" charged to room when logging in and then had to request removed at check out. This is the "normal" process.5) Free newspaper - you have to go down to the lobby and wait in line to get from the front desk - it is not delivered to you6) Construction noise in the casino during the 7am-4pm hours so if you eat breakfast or lunch you hear banging and equipment moving aroundWhen I mentioned these topics to the front desk at check out the response was - "Would you like a printed receipt for your stay?"

reviews.title: Nearly Constant Construction Noise
reviews.text: I had never stayed at The Palms before this trip. Booked The Palms because me and my friend were going to a concert at the Pearl Theater. I thought the staff that I encountered at the Front desk, the restaurants, the lobby bar, and the casino, were all really friendly and provided excellent service. The hotel is clean and fairly nice, but the remodeling and construction noise didn’t make it very enjoyable. They are building a new pool complex onto the hotel, adjacent to the “Ivory Tower”. During my stay, the pool was closed. Apparently they were offering the use of a small 6th floor pool over at the “Palms Place”, but you had to walk down a temporary path to get to the other part of the property due to construction going on. On the last day of my stay, they fired up the grinders or whatever loud power tools they’re using in the construction at 6:00 am. As I write this review on the 10th floor of the Ivory Tower, there is the nearly constant sound of grinding or cutting coming from the area under construction. Not enjoyable at all.I had a “regular “(two queen beds) room. The room was clean and nice the beds were average, but too much remarkable about it. I don’t know if this is true of all of the rooms, however in my room and that of my travel buddy, there is no bathtub, just a shower. They no longer operate a free shuttle to/from The Strip, as of October 1, 2018. Not sure if this is a permanent change or not. Like many hotels, they charge a “resort fee” (around $26 during my stay) that includes WiFi and some other “nice to have’s”. Seems like they should have lowered this during their remodeling/construction, since the pool is closed and for the inconvenience of the remodeling process... I might consider staying here again but not until the remodeling process is complete - Apparently it’s going to last a year? (I did not verify this)

reviews.title: Love the new Palms and only getting better with construction
reviews.text: Stayed at the Palms this week after a 10 year absence from the property.  We didn't like the Palms before because it catered to the 20s crowd, and while it was great for those that admire the scenery, for the crankier older guys, it was just loud and obnoxious. The redone Palms is wonderful! Loved the laid-back vibe and great staff.  Let's talk about rooms first.Ivory tower is redone and standard nice; good job on remodel.  Room was clean, modern and did the job for me, staying alone.  Ivory is close to gambling and 24 hour restaurant.  Also, park in the east garage if you are staying there and have a car.  It isn't crowded and you are literally steps from the tower.  So nice not to have to walk or fight traffic. One complaint- wish they had USB charging for phones- come one Palms!! Bring adapter for cell charging. USB in wall did not charge phone. Some of my group stayed at the Palms Place and that was a huge hit! Went on the tour there and if you are staying as a couple, this is the place to be.  Pay a little more but get a whole lot more! Bit of a walk to main casino, but it's only 2 minutes so no big deal. Amazing rooms and definitely the place to be for me when I bring my wife back.Sports book is nice and found seats every time.  Spa/fitness very good.  Lucky Penny serves good food and large portions! Buffet was good value with Boarding Card and they do have continuing construction, but it is bringing additional restaurants, so that is a good thing. It was a little tight in the front, but no noise or other issues. Casino staff was awesome- Thank you to Snow, Lisa and especially Randy at the Ultimate Texas Hold Em table for making the experience great and of course, two 4 of a kinds in 2 days didn't hurt! Entire staff was excellent for the trip.  Love a friendly casino staff. Check in and check out took no time at all and housekeeping was good, although I'm so neat there really wasn't much to do. Can't wait for the finished product, but definitely my favorite right now and will be back with my wife to enjoy the Palace.  I don't stay on the strip any more, so this was the perfect spot for me.  So glad they changed their image. Even Friday and Saturday nights were very tame compared to the old MTV days! Only saw one kid in 4 days- so not really a family destination either. Thanks for a nice weekend Palms!

reviews.title: Mostly Very Nice
reviews.text: This resort has been undergoing a renovation that is still in progress so expect some noise during daytime - they are currently building what they say will be the largest pool in Vegas.  We stayed in the Fantasy Tower and the room was beautiful and well appointed - large TV, great shower, comfy furnishings.  The only issue with the room was trying to figure out the lights - they really need a guide just for the lights.  The casino looked pretty nice and it was large.  We do not gamble so cannot speak to the quality of the offerings.  Plenty of dining options, friendly staff at the front desk (although the music is loud enough that it is difficult to hear them).  You are just over a mile from the Strip and there is no shuttle service so be aware of that.

reviews.title: Solid 4 Stars
reviews.text: We stayed one night at the Palms Casino Resort and it did the job. This hotel is located 8 minutes of driving or 25 minutes of walking from the strip. The hotel is currently under renovation, so we got a really good deal with our room rate. The room itself was good. It was recently updated and the bed was comfortable. The casino on site is small and had small crowds. There’s a small food court and buffet and everything is within a short walking distance inside. I’m not sure if I’ll return again in the future, but I wouldn’t take it off the table. The area between the hotel and strip feels a little unsafe, so that would be my biggest deterrent from staying again.

reviews.title: Remodeling the hotel
reviews.text: Palms is going through overhaul in a better way. They are upgrading their rooms and casino area to make it more modern. Fairly decent dinning options. The only thing I noticed was it seems they are running very thin on staff. Most (90%) of the time calling to front desk or concierge service is unattended to a point we got frustrated and just went down but no one was available to attend us.

reviews.title: Great!!!
reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay here! The employees were always very friendly and would help with anything you needed! Lots of places to eat and open all hours of the night! Very clean and would stay here anytime I’m in town!

reviews.title: OCT 2018  UNDER MAJOR CONSTRUCTION BEWARE!
reviews.text: Palms Place Studio Suite is about 1/4 of a mile away from parking your car or walking to casino. So pack light and wear walking shoes.   Also no view of strip from our suite--so disappointed. Balcony doors are locked shut, so no point paying extra for that feature.  King size bed has sink holes, caved in--opposite of firm or comfortable--really bad for back support.  Bed comforter had a blood spot on it.  Recessed lighting in bathroom had bad bulb.  Check in at 3pm ended up being at 4:30pm with no apology or comps of any kind.  If you miss house cleaning, you are responsible to call them back up or your room will not be cleaned.  One night sheets smelled like mildew--awful.   We booked through  Tripadvisor via "cancelcom" and were tricked into believing resort fees were paid in advance.  $37 a night--ugh!  Gym was so small and depressing.  Crappy machines and small selection.  Elip and treadmills faced a parking lot so no view and no tv monitors to keep you from getting bored.  Go elsewhere this year.  The construction is insane and Palms is not worth the extra moula.  The slots are super tight--so we moved on to Palace Station and Fremont Street.  I never saw one strip shuttle from the Palms.  Gold Coast across street has shuttles pretty often though.

reviews.title: Not Strip, but fantastic!
reviews.text: This hotel looks a little ole on the outside, but major work is going on, and once you enter it is sheer luxury! High ceiling, modern and beatiful, and still very much Las Vegas! service great, room fantastic. What a surprise. I will be back in a heartbeat. Keep an eye on pool-work and things going on...it may take a while before everything is updated. But the hotel? GREAT!!

reviews.title: Modern room with funky decor and comfortable bed...but nothing more
reviews.text: We stayed at this hotel for one night, and after an uneventful check-in procedure we found that the room was spacious and the bathroom was clean an modern. We found a bar fridge full of bottled drinks,and since we needed refrigerator space, we removed the bottles. We had also two small cooling elements that need refreezing, but the fridge had no freezer compartment. As a result, we went back to the front desk and asked, whether they could possibly keep those small elements in a freezer overnight.On our extensive travels this has never been a problem, but here it was one:the person at the front desk said that they could not do it! This would involve extra charges. We were told that they would accommodate us in a condo unit of the same establishment at an additional charge. It reeked of revenue-generating, and we really did not need the space of a condo for one overnight stay! We have never experienced this type of attitude before. It sounds like: here is your room; don't even think of asking for any type of extra service! The room itself does not have any other creature comforts for the traveller, not even a small coffee maker. You also pay $36.00 in addition for their resort fee, which is a common feature in Las Vegas. As a result, anybody should think twice before booking here!

reviews.title: Awful Experience / Disinterested Staff
reviews.text: Room smelled strongly of sewage.  Toenail clippings on the beds and benches at the ends of each bed.  Debris elsewhere on the floor, including an unidentifiable prescription pill (photos attached). It was evident that this room was never cleaned or deodorized after the prior guest.  WiFi system denied access despite our confirmed reservation and the room phone could not connect to the front desk.  Made repeated efforts to go through the concierge to get someone at the front desk and waited on hold for 25 minutes across 4 separate calls, the first three of which ended by being forwarded to a voicemail box that was not set up.After a long day we wanted only to go to bed in a reasonably clean room; when it didn’t seem that would be possible we simply asked to have the reservation cancelled so we could book and travel to a different hotel for a better experience.  The front desk, when finally reached, refused to waive a cancellation fee of $415 and instead offered to move us to a different room with a $30 food credit.  Including the service charge and automatic gratuity of 21%, the $30 credit would allow for a single order of approximately 25% of all items on the room service menu.We refused the credit and will eat our meals elsewhere.  I will never set foot in this hotel after our trip is over and will ensure that everybody we know to be traveling to Las Vegas stays in another hotel.  We don’t scare easily and the room conditions were disgusting.  But for the bellhop who helped relocate our family the staff was inattentive, disinterested and/or completely disrespectful.

reviews.title: Nothing to fault
reviews.text: This is my third stay here gets better each time especially with new lobby and all.. stayed at most strip hotels but always drawn back here!! Would definitely  recommend also has free self-park which comes in handy.. thank me later :)

reviews.title: Very disappointed with overpriced suite!
reviews.text: Arrived Thursday & upgraded to a suite. Walked in to a room that had obviously not had the floors or furnitire vacuumed (all carpet except the bathrooms with a fabric couch) & reaked of stale cigarettes. Had the room cleaned during our stay, still wasn't vacuumed or thoroughly cleaned. Bar fridge had EXPIRED beverages... year old beer, juice, pop!! Also, barely kept our water cold. The curtains had unsightly stains on the bottom & all room items were quite weathered. One of the toilets ran all day/ night, without an offer to resolve. And, there was not one drawer or dresser to put clothing in to, we were in a one bedroom suite?! They also are undergoing renos, so everything was near impossible to access with no signage to PROPERLY guide the guests. Most staff were quite nice, however a few of their older front desk clerks could use some re-training in how to treats the guests (and their co-workers!!) paying almost $300/night for a suite with their "resort fees" that include nothing, that we could take advantage of, but wifi - which in 2018 is included at most places. Palms is also located a 5-7 min DRIVE from the strip so bargain for, a minimum, $20 drive to your hotel per day via Car Share options or a $30 taxi. Oh! There is no poker... at a Casino! And, next to no knowledge about where to find it in town?! We were sent to another hotel 5 mins away, only to be redirected to another hotel a 5 min DRIVE away.

reviews.title: 40 Yr Re-Union
reviews.text: Thank you to the Palms for giving us a night we will not forget! The experience was unbelievable! Bar for us with the nicest Bartenders with a beautiful Pool just outside the windows and Food I have never really enjoyed before! The Staff, Velet, Food service was exceptional. Thank You and we will be back!

reviews.title: Overpriced Tired Suite
reviews.text: We reserved a corner suite at the Palms for a special birthday getaway.  The entire hotel casino is going through a major renovation.  They evidently haven't gotten around to the suites yet.  At least I hope they haven't.  The room is not just tired looking, it is not in very good condition.  The walls and furniture have marks and gouges on them.  It is disappointing to say the least.  There is a desk with no chair and there are no dresser drawers.  The buffet however, is fantastic.

reviews.title: I would not do it again
reviews.text: I was given three nights and slot money in the Ivory tower from my casino in N.J. as a gift give away. I was given a letter at check in welcoming me and saying to speak to a host for concerns or comments. The woman at the card center reluctantly called Val Thai. I asked for a pass to the spa for my husband. Val explained he would see if I qualified for a comp when I left.My husband did not go to spa as he did not think that was an unreasonable request as we were given the stay at the Palms from my casino. I sent a text to Val as we were leaving explaing our only room charges were for food. He has never responded.                                                                                                      Our Suite was O..K. There are some shelves in the closet but no drawers. A small alarm clock but no radio. There was not a coffee pot  in the room so it was room service or get dressed to go to the food court. I was only able to connect my iPad to the Internet not my kindle. I was told we could connect up to three devices.                                                                 The pool was a trip to the other side of the resort and small. When the construction is finished I am sure this will be a better resort.                                                                     The casino is pretty limited as is the race book. You must make a $50 race bet to get a drink and my husband was closed out for a race because of a shift change even though  he should have had plenty of time.                                                                                        We ate at The Lucky Penny and the buffet. Both were reasonably priced and the food was good.The buffet had a nice selection. Not extravagant.                                                                  The shuttle service was easy and convenient. The driver was very helpful and pleasant as was Manny to and from the airport.                                                                                  All the wait staff on the casino floor and in the restaurants were friendly and efficient.            Overall I would say this is 3 star resort at best.

reviews.title: Birthday party gone bad
reviews.text: A friend and I decided to go "all out" for our birthdays this years. We decided to book with a resort where we can begin celebrating at the cabanas during the day and a club/lounge at night. We had been seeing a lot of advertisements on the remodeling that the Palms has been doing so we decided to seek out availability and pricing. We were then referred to an individual named Ahron Bragg to help us with book our party. Im not sure if he was a promoter (or what his actual title was) however, he gave us a tour of the hotel including the cabanas and nightclub (Apex). We were to have 22 guests that night, he painted a picture for us that sounded like our guests and us will be treated like VIP. The package was to be $1275. We were told we can either have bottle service or our guests can order their preferred drinks to reach a limit of 1275. So here's how the day went. We got to the palms around 11, checked in, we went to the pool, had our reserved cabanas and enjoyed the pool (really no problem there). Around 8 pm we started getting ready for our main event at the APEX, we had been looking forward to this for a long time. We head over at around 9:30pm, the security greets us at the door, takes our ID's and has us wait in line. Of course we're already becoming irritated because we had spent money on making sure this was a vip experience. I tried contacting Ahron, he said he was on the other side of the resort and wasn't going to be there so he was going to text us the number of the manager that night (by the way, he said that he was going to be there with us the entire night, making sure everything went smooth). 15 minutes later, he texts us the number of this so called manager. At the point, we were walked upstairs to the nightclub. The escort then starts walking us outside, we stopped him and advised him that we were promised a spot inside. He then leaves to find the manager, the manager returns with an attitude as if we owed him something. When we began telling him that Ahron told us we'd be getting inside seating, he says, "Ahron doesn't know what he's talking about." This is extremely unprofessional, this is an individual that is representing your hotel!!! After a few minutes, we were able to get a small corner (for 22 freaking people!, unbelievable). Then when our waitress came to the table, they were trying to charge us 1375 instead of 1275 (which was the agreed price). When we told her that we decided we wanted our guests to be able to order their own drinks instead of doing bottle service, our waitress told us "well, I don't think I can do that because it's a lot of walking back and forth." Our bill for that night ended up being 1800. I know this is a lengthy review, but I encourage you all to review it before booking your party at the Palms. If it wasn't for all our guests cheering us up this experience would have ABSOLUTELY RUINED MY NIGHT. It seems like you're saving money at a place like this but I promise it's not worth the trouble. I would highly NOT RECOMMEND this hotel for a special event.
